text: I ABSOLUTELY LOVE this game! It's art style is amazing, as well as it's story! BUT, there's this one issue I keep running into as of late (which gets fixed when I uninstall and reinstall it, but I REALLY don't wanna do that EVERY time I wanna play it): I keep getting a "System Error" message whenever I load up the game and try connecting to the/my server! Can SOMEONE please fix this issue? (I've also restarted my device along with reinstalling it, but I shouldn't have to every time I load it up)

I'm surprised how good this is. It's a mobile game. In app purchase prices are kind of high. But it's easy to roll along without spending a dime and build up over time. So much stuff to do, a surprisingly deep story. I love the action gameplay, the characters are endearing, and even the weird exploration puzzles of the Lost Sector provide variety. Always updating, always new events that reward generous upgrade materials and expand the lore or a character in ways big and small. Great game!

Its a great game,great graphics, and wonderful story. Charters are interesting and fun to collect. I think the leveling is kinda rough especially once you reach lvl 200. The camera seems a little tilted(on mobile)like your looking from the ground . Which makes seeing enemies hard sometimes. I recommend this game to all, though playing on PC is the better way. There is no catching up to top either. Why? Leaves new players out of any true competition. This game is killing itself.

NIKKE is a great game, the story is amazing and really gets you hooked onto the characters and into the world. The gameplay is kinda... meh and all the options to spend money are really expensive. It's not friendly to light spenders. Regardless the game is great. The gacha isn't too bad with the wishlist system and the game giving out free stuff a lot of the time. Highly reccomend playing through the first few chapters if you're interested but still on the fence!

Devs are very communicative- which is incredibly refreshing to see in the gacha market. Early parts of the story serves as a really long, drawn-out setup for extremely satisfying/intense payoff far down the line. There's a real grind to level up characters, but the resources (to include in-game currency) are generous. I despise the $60 tag on premium gacha skins, but I guess their generosity through other means balance it out... All in all, I'm currently happy with this game and studio.

Absolutely love this game! Has great character designs, outfits, and bosses. The main story is pretty interesting and continues to expand with every update and event. Not to mention, the "mileage" system make the gacha for new character pulls much less frustrating since you can save up and use the mileage tickets to get the characters or dupes right away. Honestly a great mobile game.

I think it's a fun game, and the graphics are good and it doesn't lag my phone or take up alot of space. I just wish the prices were cheaper but that's my only critique. | 2. I have progressed into the game, I realize they actually are fair and give you a decent amount of resources so you don't always have to spend money, changed my 4 star to a 5 😊

It doesn't give or sell enough stat rocks. Other than that, the game has answered a lot of gripes, from bringing back old collabs to og skins. This keeps me playing even after completing the story, along with the gameplay and team-building aspects. If I were to name one thing that could help keep players around, would be some kind of way for players to understand bosses without having to leave the game. For example, on mobile, finding out if a boss has a core isn't always immediate. Great art.

I've been playing for less than a week, and it's been fun so far. Gacha experience is typical, I don't see any hard pity system but there's Wish to raise probability of getting characters you want. Some of the enemies could be really hard to defeat. Can play in horizontal and vertical mode, which is kinda new for me. Graphics are okay. Music is okay. JP dub is awesome. Anyway, quite a satisfactory game to play on spare time.

Short review, the game quality is very high which I wasn't expecting. The animations are well done and events have a lot of fun content. If you like Sci-fi settings, give it a shot! Edit 1/29/2026 Almost 2 years later, I'm still playing NIKKE daily. I really enjoy the game as a whole, and improving my units bit by bit over time is very enjoyable.

Terrible game. It's all bait, and unless you're that desperate to play, it's not worth your time nor money. Once you fall behind, it's almost impossible to catch up because it's all server-based. Upgrade materials are limited and practically make it almost impossible to level up your characters entirely unless you spend for their deals— which are a complete rip-off. The outfits, though not necessary, are all just as expensive. All the QoL changes aren't enough to justify the problems it bears.

Playing for years, and plan on playing for years more. I don't mean this lightly when I say that the storytelling is peak fiction, and that's not even factoring in the music, which is amazing. I mean just listen to Lovely Lonely Cat or Moving Fortress and tell me otherwise. Gameplay is fun and can be downright challenging, though they've also added qol updates that can let this just be mindless button pressing if you don't care. Anyway, game made me cry, and I hope it will do so for years.

Came for the thighs stayed for the cries Honestly though, I've never been much of a mobile gamer, the character models reeled me I'm but the stories are great. I've been playing since last year. your absolutely not required to win. it's completely optional and it's mostly for outfits. The your chances of getting new Nikkes are more common starting out but gradually come down to very rare. Great community as well. I'll definitely be sticking around

Amazing! Stunning visuals! Fun gameplay. It's been awhile since I've enjoyed a mobile game. Definitely here to play more of it. I expect great things. Edit: Okay going almost 3 years now and I've gotta say the devs do listen to their audience and the game is actively being filled with new content and story. Update: Ever since the backlash with the controversy with CN, I believe the quality of global server contents have improved, but it's still not on par of what we see in the CN server.

This is by FAR the greediest gatcha game I have ever seen in my life. It is somewhat fun but offers almost no variety. provides "free draws" maybe once or twice a year which is a problem because level caps, personal gear which is needed to fully power some characters and much more is locked behind "over clocking" which requires you guessed it multiple copies of the same character. This game literally forces you spend money relatively early on. It's just greed in digital form. 🤷

files are too big. I spent half an hour, before i could play. just so that 2 days later I get to spend another half hour waiting for updates. a game that requires I open it before hopping in the shower, is a little too ridiculous. also, speech is wonderful,. SAME EXACT sound effect on every single button click is beyond annoying. they are two separate things. make them 2 separate things..

I used to love this game, and I will say the story unironically CLUTCHES this game. However, the constant pop-up deals, meta of Nikkes, and the awful PvP aspects that reward players who spend more than others absolutely RUINED this game for me. It's only a 2/5 instead of 1/5 for me because again the story *is* amazing, and they also make great artwork and bond interactions in the game. Gameplay was also pretty neat and enjoyable. Just the marketing aspect of this game killed it for me.

Visually stunning, unique gameplay and many different characters....but.... Game suffers from so many bugs and glitches, it makes it unplayable at the moments. Majority of the characters are of the highest rarity, with abysmally low drop chance. Game is really stingy with daily/weekly rewards unless you pay to get extra. And they ask a lot of money for being a new game. This game by far has the most pay options than any other game I played, and it will be it's downfall, unless they change it.

The game has a great story as well as an amazing ost. Would love to rate it higher but the game is still riddled with bugs and questionable design choices. Manufacturer molds being a 50/50 for an SSR while being a finite resource. There are also characters who seem arbitrarily covered up for some reason. Would love to rate it higher if not for these problems I have.

At first, I thought this was going to be a game whose main selling point would be the "plot heavy" characters. Chapter 1 of the campaign changed that outlook I had. Not only are the voice actors and art phenomenal, but the story is compelling and engaging. The side story events are also voice acted very well with again the art being top notch as well. I would recommend this game to friends who are on the fence about it, as this game has really blown my expectations out of the water.

If you're going to play some free-to-play mobile trash, it might as well be this game. In all seriousness, it has one of the better level up / growth systems compared to other FTP games. High quality visuals and animation paired with one of the best sound tracks that has zero right being in a mobile game. Main story can actually hold your attention if you take the time follow along.

Very steep learning curve. They just kinda throw a bunch of stuff at you and hope you can learn all of it. Lots of stuff in the game isn't free to play friendly and even then very pricey. A mechanic to get a character in 60 days if I don't spend money. That is ridiculous. I knew this was published by Tencent but geez. Even skip functions that their last game had, Destiny Child, aren't effectively there. Makes gameplay meticulous and boring. I was hooked in the beginning but there was too much.

For a month now, the game has continuously crashed. I can not play for more than a few minutes. I got a new phone, galaxy s24 ultra, and since then, it's been crashing. Nothing helps. Emptied cashe and lower settings. It's getting frustrating. It crashes in PVP, EX, tower, Story, Limited events, etc. If you have a newer phone, don't bother. I've spent lots of money on a game I can barely play.

This game has been very fun for the amount I have played, but there are some things that do bother me a little. The way to level up Nikkes is a little bothersome. Only does a good abundance of lvl materials come from the story, and even then, the difficulty could stop them from gaining those materials, so honestly, I suggest adding a way to properly gain them. Also, having much more to do besides just power level to finish the story after a few days the feel to log in a play gets a little boring

The game is too hard for f2p or unlucky people. The game uses combat power number to represent how strong you are. But if you're under the stage's combat power requirement, your team stats are reduced and deals less damage. And then there's the new event. For the first event of a new game, the combat power requirement increase is too steep. It's almost impossible if you start late. Also, there are many bugs. But there's no news if they're going to address them.

Great story, art, and concept, however the execution is atrocious. Lvling is very difficult and even to advance is difficult. There is no incentive to keep playing the game is very geared to having you pay to advance in any little way so it becomes very off putting. This isn't a game that you can play at leisure it takes serious research and of course money to advance and level up.

My first impression for this game was to give it 5-stars. However I will give it 2-stars after weeks of play. The story is interesting. The soundtrack is awesome. The NIKKEs have nice designs, but I hate that they're censored (they say they're not). The Prices are high. They have a pitty system, but I didn't realize they had one because it takes too long. This game has great potential because it can be a really fun to play and the NIKKEs are very nice, but this game is not being managed well.

Significant issues. Really wish I could recommend this game. It could easily be among the best gacha waifu games, but incredibly poor draws, inaccurate pull rates, and censorship really don't do it any favors. It's quite buggy as well but I don't have as much issue with that, personally. If you think you can play without spending any money or very little and be comfortable getting little to nothing, then go for it. Otherwise, be prepared to spend hundreds of dollars with the same result.

I was worried the game would only feature..."huge" women, but I'm glad to say there is lots to choose from! You will find characters you like. I love that almost everything has English voices! The downside is things feel expensive. As of lately my game has been very laggy, also I've found out about how much they've censored things recently, for a game focused on fan service, I'm disappointed.

I really want to like this game. Didn't mind spending at first, as I enjoyed the gameplay. However, with the constant censoring, update crashes, and how ridiculous the pricing is in this game; plus how difficult this game can get without having an OP character. Makes this game not fun and is very p2w or have a ridiculous amount of luck on your gacha rate to get that op character. Also there is no way I will spend $20 for one skin.

So this game is great!!! The characters and there voice actresses are amazing. There's so much backstory for everyone it will never get old. Gameplay is fun and simple but can be very difficult at times. I've been playing a year and I still haven't complete campaign in normal lol. I'm not sure what bugs and glitches these other people are talking about my game never glitches or freezes so it must be what there playing it on. Also I haven't spend a penny on this game and have most units!

The story and gameplay are great. I like the character designs, although I recently found out that many characters were better designed before being censored. The game still has several bugs that still needs to be addressed. My biggest issue is that this is the most expensive gacha game that I've ever played. The gems/bundles are a horrible value at all levels. It offers very few rewards for putting time into the game. You wont last long as a dolphin or F2P.

I have not been able to get into the game at all. I will get to the login screen, login, and then I get a error called "Unexpect Failure". I know this isn't a issue with my internet connection since I can run and download other games completely fine. Either the servers are getting too full for them to hand or they don't know how to properly solve the issue. So far they have done five "updates" about and it still has not been fixed. Level Infinite, FIX THIS ISSUE. THIS IS A WASTE OF MY TIME ATP.

The game is unplayable for many people. There's been a lot of bugs like not being able to log in, download assets, make an account, accounts being deleted, not being able to claim any rewards, constant crashing, and many more. The devs need to come out and actually say if they're working on these issues or not. This game was hyped up for so long only for it to be completely unplayable for many, it's honestly disappointing.

The story is insanely good and in-depth for a coomer bait shooter. The combat is kinda cool, but I just wish there was a little more too it than just aim and use skills. I wish you could tell your Nikke's what to shoot at when you're not controlling them or something? Idk, I'm just nitpicking at this point. The game is really good, and the character designs are very creative.

$14.99 for a skin that is not unlockable by playing the game. $20 for the monthly pass . Absolutely atrocious in app purchases. Gameplay is genuinely good and different compared to most games, ruined by expensive IAP. And of course, money wins. It takes almost 3min to load the game, from tapping the game icon to reaching the main character screen. Loading times overall are terrible.

After playing for a few months, can't recommend the game. Not friendly, in any way, shape, or form, to F2P players, and even when you do spend, you get almost nothing out of it. Everything is too expensive, and it takes too long to get anywhere Takes wayyy too long to do your dailies, load into any place in the game, and even log into the game. New "free" units require 2 months of dailies, some of which FORCE you to spend paid currency... Just go play Eversoul and thank me later.

So. I will say the game is fun. The characters are great, and so is the story. But none of the content is replayable and once you get to a certain point, you run out of things to do until you get your girls stronger. On top of that, suuuper predatory game. You make purchases but still get free and paid gems. Those free gems you pay for can't be used for just anything. Very skeevy tactic and I'd recommend against wasting money on this game.

Don't trust the rating, devs are deleting bad reviews. This game is a mixed bag. Echoing what many other reviewers have written; writing, art, and character designs are great. The gameplay is simple but fun. But the game is dragged down by bugs, pacing issues, and a bad economy. I don't mind spending some money on mobile game items, but Nikke is designed for whales with little mind for anyone else.

Ok I've been playing this for 2 years and there's good and bad. Example: GREAT story! In-depth character development you can really get a real sense of attachment to them thru their stories. KILLER soundtrack. The gameplay is solid. The auto aim assist thing is overall good. Dislikes: it's a big one. The monetization. At one point there were 3 passes and they were each $20. Skins are the same. Way too much. Gets emotional sometimes. Had me holding back tears a few times.

This game has its fun/emotional moments, but the grind is back-breaking. That combines with the low rates on the gacha pulls, which you need to pull multiples of one character to max them out really slows down progress. Finally, the constant ads to buy in-game purchases is egregious. Every few weeks there are at least two passes for sale, with costume gachas now in place, and no way of getting this stuff with the in-game currency. It screams of greed. I recommend avoiding this game.

Great artwork, terrible everything else. It's riddled with bugs, resources are scarce, coupon codes are too limited, ssr gacha rate is awful, level caps are tied to dupes, lower rarity units are few and unusable long term, dailies are a chore, and rerolling is a pain. I could've forgiven all these issues if the game was at least fun to play, but it's not. It's boring. I really tried to like this hyped up idle game, but there's just too much working against it to be worth any time investment.

Really good game. Been playing for a month at the time of this post. This is a Gacha afk game. So most times you will get stuck on a fight and have to wait a day (or more in later chapters). Unless you get the "meta" characters then it might be hard to get stuck on a stage. But it will happen. Story of the game is imo really good. Too good for a mobile game imo lol. Characters have personality. So you're gonna like, love, or hate them. Overall I highly recommend this game.

Fun game, good character designs, the micro transactions in game are insane though. $20 bucks for a single skin??? I'm free to play but good god my guy. Gameplay wise my biggest gripe is if you don't have just the right team set up or certain character types you'll hit a brick wall you have to wait for your level up currency to fill up which depending on where you're at will take a while. Some enemies stun or are overly tanky and just seem way too powerful for where your characters are.

Dropped 1 star because the load times are REALLY long, and it's pretty buggy right now right after release. However, the graphics are GORGEOUS, and I don't just mean the Nikkes (who also are ;)). This game stands out in the genre with lots of cool, unique features and an engaging manual/semi-auto play, or even full-auto that still allows manual. Also, the English voices are top notch. The common phrases could be a little more diverse, but just the fact they're in English and expressive is great.

I've played a handful of gacha games at this point and while others have failed to keep me around I can see myself playing this for a very long while. The art is absolutely top notch, there's A LOT of high quality voice acting, the gameplay is actually quite engaging, the characters are adorable, and the game's lore and setting are quite interesting. All in all quite a fun game and worth the time. I don't really like the charged gems thing, but we'll see as time goes on. Thank you dev team!

It's a really good game, highly recommend for anyone who likes gacha rpg combined with girls with guns. Only gripe is some nikke don't do as much damage as I'd like. I mean I got a nikke who has, what looks like an M134 mini gun, and it takes a quarter of a mag to destroy one enemy. But other than that everything else is good. Keep it up devs :)

Game is pretty fun and simple. It has your average micro transaction stuff, obviously it's a cell phone game but you can grind and get some pretty cool characters and gear at a pretty decent pace. I've been playing for about 2 weeks. I haven't spent single penny and I have 8 SSR characters, which is the top type of characters you can get. If you like anime girls in military/sci-fi gear and you don't mind grinding a little, give the game a try.

NIKKE is an Idle game with arcade shooting mechanics. The more the player progresses in the main story, the more resources you auto generate. The characters you can gacha for are exceptionally beautiful, with hyper realistic physics. After reaching player level 20 or so, which takes about 12 hours, is when things slow down. The premium currency to summon on daily grinds can accumulate to maybe 30-40 summons a month thus far.

The art is really well done, and the gameplay/story is somewhat engaging. However, the game is not very generous when it comes to summon crystals/tickets, and on top of that, the character skins to purchase are 20$ a piece. It's just not worth it when you have to pay to get more summons, just to hope to get a character you want, then to have to spend an additional 20$ on them if they have a costume you want. Just seems like another game for whales.

Worse game ever. It was fun in the beginning, but after a while, the game began to get too boring and repetitive. There's not much to do, and if you want good characters, you would need to spend real money in order to get characters you want. Gacha summons are rigged, with no pity systems and farming for materials to level up is pathetic. I suggest finding a better game then wasting money and time in a game like this

Performance and quality of this game does occasionally degrade but the development team has been decent at eventually resolving the issues. The shop "discount" pop-ups are annoying. Otherwise, I enjoy the systems of this gacha game more than most, it's not grindy, and dailies aren't overbearing, so it's easy to play this game in the long term without burnout. Pulling for characters also isn't too bad; it's easy to stay FTP and still get most characters but skins and gems are on the pricier side.

The game just released, first impression is that the gacha can be very generous, I am pulling tons of SSRs and characters that I want. Gameplay is very unique to other gachas, somewhat brings me back to the shooters at the arcade. Story seems pretty solid so far. Characters are obviously the main draw to the game and I think that they look pretty nice, can be awkward with the L2D, but the VA is quite good, as there are a lot of familiar JP VAs from Genshin, Azur Lane, Arknights etc.

Gameplay itself is pretty fun. Character design is good. But the gatcha elements are poor price/performance, in some areas just not well thought out (like the battlepass), and lacks a worthwhile pity system. Tactics are also lack luster as being below the recommended power massively debuffs you and being at power makes it easy so team comp and elements don't really matter that much. It's definitely fixable but currently devs keep stumbling on event balance.

So far I kinda like this game for the gameplay is unique and I like the character designs, but there are a few things I don't like about it. Starting off the game they give you multiple oppertunities to get gems but later on they start to become scarce. Also there will be a point to where most players (including me) would have problems leveling up our nikkes past 160 since it requires the nikke to have 3 copies, also some of the new nikkes are aweful on release wasting gems for new/old players.

Lots of bugs but that's not the worst part. Game bills itself as a strategic FPS shooter but you lose HUGE (>50%) stats when you are overpowered by enemy, essentially making this purely about combat power than strategy or skill. As F2P it makes no sense to play as you will never get past large majority of fights where enemy is stronger than you. 100% P2W game.

Decently fun game with interesting mechanics. Unfortunately the disparity between individual characters' skills are quite large. Some have very powerful kits while others are simply useless. Balance changes are needed so that players arent forced to hard pull for the useful 40% of characters to progress. To be clear, strategizing is necessary in this game, but some characters are simply too useless to even consider being included in any strategy.

Gameplay and characters are fun, unlike most gotcha, but their slot machine is a cruel one. it's basically $30 a spin and you're not even guaranteed anything of actual value. getting free pulls is feasible but once you've spin the wheel ~5 times you'll only get redundant copies most of the time. Pick it up to enjoy the characters and story if you're patient, but the monetization is FAR from worth it.

The game is really fun, and I've been playing daily since very early on in the games life. However, after a certain point, the farther you progress, the longer it takes to power up, and the fewer rewards you get. At that point, spending money becomes a necessity in order to acquire new characters if you aren't lucky enough on the first or second 10 pull (which practically takes a month to save up for). I really love this game, but I wish the developers showed the veterans some more love.

Changing my rate from 5 to 1. The game is good, but if you are a fan of certain characters, like Rapi, forget it; they never release any content for her. It's been one and a half years since the release, and they haven't released any kind of content for her. She got a limited skin, and that was it, but for other NIKKES, they release skins, events and alternate versions consecutively. They clearly play favorites, and she is being neglected very much by the developers.

I don't review mobile games often, but I'll make an exception Goddess Of Victory: NIKKE is a game that just keeps me coming back for more! Despite looking like your average gacha anime game it most definitely is NOT Between the loveable characters, and the engaging story, I was hooked from the start! There is so much this game has to offer with full voice acting, an amazing soundtrack, and extremely smooth gameplay, it's quickly become my favorite game on android! Highly recommended!

I want this game to be good so bad... but it's bad. Incredibly stingy rewards, endless bugs and maintenance, about 1/2 of the units are critically bugged in some way. There's fairly obvious censorship, Let's just call it what it is. For how long it took to get this to market... it's staggering how amateur this feels. It's pretty close to a straight up grift. The bones of this game seem good, this can be turned around if you want it to.

The story was good. The characters were good. But the a few things the gold prisums are garbage I used 600 of them and all of those where sr what a joke then when I was trying to get battle data got disconnected. Then my account was disconnected and when I tried to log back in then it gave me the tutorial on how to play when I was already at chapter 8. My account is gone, so please, tech support has to be better! Edit: everything is fixed but still mad about those 600 gold prisums.

With auto battle there's no incentive to play the game. The aiming controls feel lacking in accuracy so it's better to have the game auto aim. Aside from that the majority of high ranking characters are unbearable. They're all so hostile to the player it feels like they hate you personally. On the topic of the player character, nearly every dialog option could be considered wrong. The commander is so dense it feels like controlling an elementary school dropout. Shame, since the art is nice.

I have really enjoyed my time with Nikke, the gameplay is engaging (at least, when the difficulty is balanced), the art style isn't just good, it's diverse, and there is a genuine strategy to team composition. As a F2P player, my collection is pretty strong. That being said, gacha is not a genre for the half-invested, if you want to play Nikke or any other game of its like, it will demand a time commitment of you, and isn't afraid to openly mock you for not giving it.

Frequently gives "failure to sync" error and restarts or crashes, often after hitting "Recruit" which costs gems/points but without recruiting anyone. Extremely frustrating because otherwise it's a nice game. Edit: just "purchased" Chainsawman pass, and received receipt for it, but the game crashed and it won't give me the items. Pushing on "Purchase" again it says "You already own this item" or errors out to main page. $20 down the drain. 1 star.

Not a bad mobile game at all. Typical Gacha with beautiful art, a great soundtrack, and many waifus. Haven't spent a dime yet and I've made it a third of the way into the campaign so far. Finally one thing I love about the game is the many interactions you get with the Nikkes. You definitely start to care about each character which alot of gachas lack.

I love this game. diverse cast of characters, interesting story, music so good I put it on my Spotify playlist, and a scene so sad that I actually cried for awhile after. My only complaint is there are gems you can collect gems and once you get 50 of them, can recruit a Nikke. There is a set for purple and a set for gold, What annoys me the most is when I get up 50 gold gems which aren't exactly easy to come by and I still summon a purple. That's my only pet peeve.

I don't recommend nikke. From sound bugs too egregious prices. The the gameplay loop is flawed. Developers want you to spend money instead of letting you enjoy combat. All the fighting shooting and story voiceovers are pointless because you can't progress unless you idle for about a week before you can progress in the storyline. They won't let you have any SSR characters after you hit a certain amount in your inventory. Please don't waste your time!

The game has amazing visuals. The event "Over Zone" is one of, if not the best mobile game event I've seen production wise. But unfortunately the level 160-wall hurts a lot of players. Either you get lucky or fall for the extremely greedy monetization in-game. A basic skin costs thrice the price of other games. If you go into this game be aware that the problems on it hurt hard.

The game is a whole Power Point / Money grab system. What's worst is that you'll be stuck by ch2 (if your lucky). They'll let you spend money in the game right at the start but no tools to help farm to grow your character without so its a Pay to Win type deal. Power scaling jumps way too high from battle to battle and I feel time was wasted that I won't get back. Only thing the games has going for it is visuals... and even then that's a bit over the top.

Update: So the crashing still does happen on the summon screen, usually by the video lagging then crashing to my home screen, but it's not as much of an issue as it was at launch. Everything else is all right tho, game is good enough and I haven't needed to bust out the wallet. I'll give it a 5 star when the lagging and crashing on summons is fixed

I really enjoy this game's... Er... Writing. That being said, I'm currently experiencing a few bugs that have been negatively affecting my experience: for whatever reason, the videos that typically play on the recruit menu for both the special and ordinary banners have not been playing at all recently. All I get is a black screen. While it definitely doesn't take much away from the experience, it does make me feel as if I'm missing out on an experience that most other players are getting.

So far, this is simply one of the best gacha game I've ever played. The characters, the story, the plot, the soundtrack, the voiceover, the gacha system, the events, and everything is just perfect! The only problem is: The loading takes too long! The main loading, the game loading, the gacha loading, the event loading, the story loading. It's just rlly annoying for me, too much loading! That's why sometimes I got too lazy to play Nikke. Im guessing this is a big problem for the other players too

I like the asthetic of the game and the characters, heck even the story is intriguing, but damn are gems WAY too hard to get as f2p. I can't see myself staying for the long run if I have to wait like 2 weeks to save up just for a summon that doesn't even guarantee anything. This game needs daily log in rewards or something because this is a bit ridiculous.

On the surface, it looks like a great game. Underneath, it's anything but. Drop rates are horrid (the purpose of a gacha game is to COLLECT), difficulty spikes are in every other stage, and there are more bugs than a hoarder's house. The English dub is nice, but pointless if you can't even get the characters you want to hear their voices. You're better off watching something on Crunchyroll. Don't waste your time with this trash.

Game looks great, but the character/unit "Recruit" gacha mechanic is terrible, there's no information explaining how the banner works or if there's even a pity system at all. I also noticed the game doesn't have the basic feature of letting you choose which Google account to log into. Another issue is, if you bind a guest account, the account will remain a guest account still. So you can't create another guest account. Gameplay wise the aim sensitivity needs a horizontal and vertical slider!

I'm sorry, but I dislike games that try to hold you from powering up fast. I have tier 7+ gear and stuff, but I don't get enough resources to get them past 4+. The game is good, but the powering system forces you to log in each day to do a simple 3 daily tasks. And, honestly, I think it's unfair. Some people aren't always gonna log in every day to do those 3 things.

My first main issue is how especially for a mobile idle game, which tend to be pretty casual side games, I found Nikke to demand too much of my time. Next, progression is very tied to RNG, with poor odds, which can result in one hitting various common stuck points, even if you spend money. They could do things like have only one form of pity currency (mileage), and make it so duplicates of all available units can be purchased with it, but instead they just periodically nerf content.

I was super into this game and put a lot of time into it. After whatever recent update that took multiple attempts due to it continuously crashing, my game data seems to be wiped. When the game finally updated I logged in to play, and it's forcing me to start from scratch. I read the customer service report stating it is possible to create multiple accounts or something, but I don't see any indication that that's happened. Did my data really just get wiped? Please respond.

The story writing for the events are pretty bland, but the main story is good. Gears more pay to win with the set up on leveling. Once you can get your characters to 160 you hit a wall until you can get 5 characters to 200. In order to do that you have to get 3 copies of the SSR characters of choice in order to be able to level them past 160. Some of the purchases are vague to get you to waste paid game currency. Been playing for half a year and only could get 2 characers at 200.

Currently my dedicated Gacha. Beautiful art, character design, personalities, and backstories. The main story has me hooked. I'm in love with the world they built, and how they tell the story. With bits and pieces to a larger puzzle unraveling as I go. I also love the gameplay which isn't a popular opinion, I hear. But you can manually play way before the "auto" would let you clear when under powered. Dailies are also quick so it fits neatly into my life without being a second job. Love.

It is a great and unique game. It has idle game aspects for resources and is the trade off for the lack of stamina system so it's fine for me. A "cultured" game that has big checkmark next all the standard gatcha game requirements: music, design, story, gameplay, and good gatcha. Only complain is that the top-up for gems seem really pricey for what you get. The monthly card seems to be the only thing that seems worth the money, which is great for small spenders/dolphins.

I must admit, I haven't reviewed many games or apps on my phone, but none have so pleasantly surprised me as this one has. I expected this to be misleading like so many others, but no. not only do they give you what they advertise, it's so much more.almost too much to be honest lol. Nikke is quickly turning into both my favorite phone game but also my favorite way to kill time. these guys are doing everything RIGHT! I hope they keep up the amazing work.

It's a gatcha... But it's a gatcha with fantastic writing, a stellar EDM soundtrack, and engaging gameplay. It's akin to an arcade light gun shooter like Time Crisis, but a bit more heavy on the rpg mechanics. So you'll be relying on a good mix of reactions, decision-making, and team composition to make your way through missions. (And if you're just here for the plot, you can ignore all of this via the easy leveling system) That said, the real gold here is in the writing. Drake is the best!

Story is AMAZING! Really invested with the characters and their carfully built backgrounds and you could tell that the devs really care about the characters they make. Some things they could do to make the game better is to make the codes last longer than have a limit to how many commanders could redeem in such a short time...

Good story and setting for a mobile game, the art is fantastic, and voice acting is superb which really brings the plethora of characters out. That said I myself have experienced multiple issues with the game, all are unresolved. Customer service with this company is a joke, so don't expect any assistance if something goes wrong. I am not a fan of these Gatcha systems at all, but I'll have to say that. This one in particular is purposefully woeful, the odds of getting any "SSR" is dismal.

Been looking for a game like this. Super fun and can be challenging at times too. Love the bosses. They give you side quests to help you buy NIKKE packs. The game feels balanced in their currency. You upgrade your NIKKEs with in game currency that you earn every mission. And, some missions give you armor to further upgrade your NIKKEs. Story is fun and interesting too. Definitely would give this game a download if you like rail shooters and military anime style art.

Been playing for about a week or two, and so far I've thoroughly enjoyed the game. There's an obvious draw for young men, but aside from that, the gameplay and story are seriously good! There is an enthralling world with lots of lore involved as well, and if you enjoy games with deep stories and a cast of interesting characters, not to mention lots of anime fan service and subtle references to popular series, this is the game for you! PS: IT IS FREE TO PLAY. I've not hit a paywall yet!

Its visually great, riddled with issues off the start, some sloved some their still working on. But for me being competitive, missing out on 2 days of activities due to not getting the items from missions and missing the other activities that follow with leveling was rough. Also been playing since luanch and can't get 1 friend or even make or join a guild. So missing other avenues for advancement.

Game has great art and the sound design is pretty good. With that said, the gacha rates are pretty poor. The pilgrim group of characters are very rare and no way to upgrade them aside from pulls. Once I saved up crystals and social points and did close to 150 pulls without a single ssr. It's a decent game to kill some time, but I wouldn't put any money into it for the reason mentioned above.

Gameplay is mostly fine. The real star feels like the voice acting and writing. But the font is borderline unreadable a lot of the time. I am on a OnePlus 10 and have almost perfect vision and I have to move the phone close to my face to read anything or recognize symbols. and there is no way to increase this. Gameplay is a bit shallow, not bad, just shallow where it basically tells you to auto it pretty quick. Which is a shame because it actually seems more involved then other games.

I'm interested in the story but the further you get, and the more you play, the less they reward you. It's been a backwards experience. Starting on chapter 13, they drip feed you 10 gems every several missions (1/30th of 1 pull) which may take a week(+) to go through. There's also no repeatable ways to earn resources for pulling more units. There's no incentive for me to play except to experience more of the story at this point. And manufacturer mold rates are so low for several weeks of work.

No saves? So the game has certain aspects that don't save. You do single nikke stories and can move to the next story only when you watch the first one and level up their heart rank. If you leave that menu or close the game then it goes back to story 1 unseen. Most of the time however, it just gives an error and kicks you to the main menu from the outpost. Not fun at all.

Just downloaded and already going through tech issues. I think this is common, but stick at loading screen. Trying not to change servers and stick with global to play with others. Playing on phone. Tried restarting,3 time, and just waiting but still no luck. Can't even contact site because like I have doesn't really have a way because I haven't even created an ID for the game. Anyone have suggestions, or ideas, on how I can fix. Been waiting to play and now got the chance

Nikke is a pretty interesting game overall. It's got an interesting story, fantastic and intriguing characters, and lots of content to go over. It's pretty rare for any game to get me hooked on stories and characters as much as this game has. My biggest complaint I have about this game is the combat. It's VERY repetitive and outside of bigger boss battles, it's very boring, just aim with the reticle and shoot. You need to focus more on having the right type matchups and overall team setup.

Basically a Gacha Waifu on rails shooter. There is a surprising amount of intricacies in the mechanics. Game looks fantastic, controls are super smooth, lots of skills and character types. Only complaint (which may be the main appeal for some) is you might as well call it Waifu Butthole Shooter for the ridiculous sprite shooting animations. You don't need to take the fan service levels to 10,000% when the game is actually this good. Some of the designs are borderline hentai at this point.

It's a rip-off. The latest event features a new costume lottery mechanic that uses a paid only game currency, which has a .05% drop rate. That's 5% of 1%! Let that sink in. Unless you're very lucky, it'll cost $60 plus tax to clear the shop and get the skin. It takes 5 pulls before the skin will even be a possible drop at all. There's nothing in the shop that justifies a $60 dollar price tag, and it's definitely not a $60 dollar costume. It's a total rip-off!

Game play is fun, and unique. However, cash shop is like robbery, 30 dollars for a ten pull without pity? And not like other gotcha games you can just pull for what you like, you have to collect as many SSRs as possible and as many dupes as well because you need dupes to limit break in order to level up. It's like AFK arena with a cash shop of Genshin Impact, and even GI has pity. Not to mention data errors that happened almost every 3 combats, this completely ruins the game play experience.

Looked forward to this game for years since I'm a big Destiny Child fan. Was really disappointing to see a lack of care with gameplay bugs and performance issues that legitimately hinder and/or break the game. Dailies also take what I consider too much time, especially when events are active and you're repeating stages and tasks up to five times a day. Hoping some changes can be made before the game is deemed dead by the community due to the issues. Everyone really wants to love this game.

I love the game for what it is and will continue playing... but the game does have problems. A few of them particularly annoy me. 1 is the pay wall. It's a pretty bad design and most people who are not spending money will find it hard to progress past 160 wall. Not easy to do while f2p or light spending. 2 is the stinginess with summoning materials. I came from Destiny Child to this game. As long time DC player.. my expectations where high. NIKKE is nothing like DC in terms of generosity.....

Edit: taken to 3 stars. New event is TRASH. Wait 30+mins to try to play 1 round and get disconnected. Beyond stupid! It's fun when it works. Been quite a few bugs since launch. Failed character progression rewards, failed loading screens. Edit: updates are being worked on and so far my connection hasn't been interrupted. I have been having alot of fun with the game play but the EX levels are just too hard. I can't even get through half the oppents life bars before my team is wiped out.

Fun game, great writing, fantastic music, and tons of content in a wide variety of flavors. It's clear that they've taken the best lessons from Destiny Child, as well as from other successful games. Great features all around. Dorothy is just straight-up broken right now, but Shift Up has a very good track record for addressing balance, and there's already been a balance patch. Yes, the Live2D physics are nice. That's what I came for, but it's far from the only reason I'm staying.

Cool game but some issues that lower the fun.. Stingy with rewards, don't even look forward to do pulls anymore. A certain pilgrim unit (rate as hell) is multiple times more powerful than other SSR units. And only 2-4 SR characters are good. Speaks of bad balancing. Performance. Feels like 25%of the time is looking at loading screens. On Pc and s21 ultra.

The presentation, story, and characters are pretty solid, and that would have carried me through the very steep spike in difficulty early on if it weren't for this: The game is so poorly optimized and buggy that it's caused this new phone, a model from last year that can run the game just fine, to crash TWICE. The game didn't crash. The game *made my phone, a mid-tier 2021 Nokia x100, crash*. I can't recommend this game until it's properly optimized and fixed.

Could have been great, with great art and designs and gameplay that remindeds me of arcade rail shooters. Unfortunately there's less of a difficulty curve and more of a ninety degree upward wall you hit where you just have to wait days to accrue material to level up your girls less and less. 90% of the characters are top rarity with pitiful drop rates that, tied to a stingy in game currency and $$$ in game shop, makes it impossible to fill a decent roster. Shamefully squandered potential.

Progression is super slow and the game punishes you with a massive decrease in stats if you don't hit the recommended power for a level. Progression limiting mechanics defeat the purpose of even having different types of characters in the first place since it really doesn't matter who's strong or isn't. For now the game gets 3 stars, we shall see if that changes.

Honestly I wasn't sure about this game. Some of the paid outfits are stupidly expensive and they push the FOMO way too hard sometimes, so it's very predatory. If you can resist the urge to spend too much, though, the story, art, and music are all really good, and the gameplay is sometimes fun and challenging. Avoid if you have low willpower, but otherwise worth the download.

This game makes me cringe so hard!...but it's fun! It's the only "idle" type game I like. I do see an issue with leveling up though. There has been a few times where I'm "stuck" until the next day where I do daily missions for level materials. It's annoying and will probably get worse but for now I'm having fun, hope that doesn't change.

I'm enjoying it so far. A little worried about a few bugs here and there, but overall? Great graphics, fun gameplay, a pretty damn good story.....and AWESOME music. Seriously, a lot of tracks are fantastic and that's a huge plus in my book. Edit: Well it's still a lot of fun, but what I was worried about actually came to pass. Laggy and disconnects all over. I'm disappointed, but stuff happens. I'll uninstall for a bit and try again later.

I loved it at first, lovely art and fun gameplay. But now it's plagued with constant crashes, disconnects, system errors and failed syncs. I feel like I spend more time reloading the game than actually playing. The prices are also a bit ridiculously over priced for what they give. You really hit a wall after a while barring even your basic story progression. Giving this a one star until the crashes and bugs are sorted out at the very least.

I must say, the graphics and animations used are stunning, especially for a mobile platform. The audio is on point, and I particularly enjoy the soundtrack. However, my two biggest complaints is the draw system, and pricing. The drop rates seem to be exceptionally low, even for a gacha game. Then the pricing. 20 dollars for a skin? The art is good, but nowhere near that amount. And the battle pass? Most AAA titles have passes at half the price. Prices should match the platform.

I was looking forward to this game since I first heard of it. Since release, I'm highly disappointed. Constant bugs, terrible gacha rates, and stuttering are a few of the problems. The graphics and music are great. Great graphics and music couldn't keep me playing. I wanted to enjoy this one, but the problems mentioned doesn't allow that.

The good: Nice character models, good voice acting, good music. The bad: The gameplay is pretty boring as you auto almost everything. The enemy variety is minimal and bland. Cash shop prices are very expensive. The ugly: So many bugs since launch and nothing has been fixed. There is a recommended team power (a total number value that represents the strength of your squad) for each stage but the thing is if you don't meet the recommendation then you automatically get debuffed by 25% or more.

The game really draws you in with beautiful graphics, lovely characters, and a rich story. However, it really starts to show its full colors after about a month. Unless you spend money to pickup the better units you essentially will never see over 3/4 of the units (the breakdown is something like 9 common units, 15 uncommon, and like 40 rare but the gotcha percentages are 50ish% for common, 45% for uncommon, and 4% for rare divided equally across all 40 units). Not worth it to continue.

One of the best games ever!! The gacha is rewarding, the lore and world building is amazing, and the events make it even better!! not to mention the ability to replay previous events using memory films are a thing too, so you can never miss the events of the past, and you can also still keep up with the lore!! one of the best games.

wow this game is solid. amazing graphics, amazing controls, amazing story, amazing sound tracks. this game is so fun to play and just doesn't stop. I keep unlocking more and more side missions all unique and I don't feel like skipping through it. has an amazing English dub and beautiful cutscenes and some are fully animated. this game will not disappoint. I highly recommend this game.

I love this game. It's so much more than it seems on the surface with a truly deep story and rich gameplay, and it's very free to play friendly. the only real issue I have with the game is sometimes when you clear a level the game just freezes and won't load which means you have to close it and redo the level which can be especially frustrating on really difficult encounters.

I support a gacha game's appeal of time invested equates to progress or power of your squad, but this game takes it to the extreme in that even just the campaign main story stops you from proceeding since your power is too low for the recommended, despite being at end game. Furthermore, if your power is just 1 below the needed, it feels like the stage becomes too hard. Though I love the story and characters in this game, I just have a problem with its non-beginner friendly progression.

I have played this game for more than 2 years and absolutely love it. But seeing how much quality of life and amazing features the Chinese version of the game gets has completely with zero communication from the devs about global getting those changes, has severely hurt my love and respect for the company and any hope for the games future. I cannot support a company that shows blatant favoritism for one version of the game and completely ignore the ones who were there from the start.

Excellent game, the combat is a lot of fun very unique, the soldier selections come in good variety, Story line is actually very good as well as the voice acting. Animation scenes were a unique touch as I love anime, however I would really like to see a lot more emotionally in-depth detail of characters, and the character complexity is lack luster, I feel it's harder to be drawn in by the world when the characters lack personality so badly, Genshin as well as other competitors do this well.

I was hesitant to play at first because of excessive fan service, but I must say, I have not been so hooked on a gacha game for the longest time. I have been loving it so far. Also, there is no weapon or artefact banner. Huge W! My issue is that character banners don't show at all. It is just a black screen all the time. Normal recruit and friendship recruits are working fine. But every other banner just shows a black screen. I do not know what is wrong.

The game has great character designs, art, and the fan service is good. However, the core shooter gameplay is a very frustrating experience on mobile, and it feels like it is primarily designed with PC players in mind. For example, the "Volleyball" Rapture encountered in later stages is incredibly annoying. In general, there are too many enemies in the game capable of one-shotting your characters. The developers seem more interested in making mini games than improving the core gameplay.

I love the game and it works almost perfectly but whenever i enter a stage, the loading is stucked at 10% or 90% and it won't keep going until i close the app and re-open the game! it happens a lot of times and i am tired to re-open the app! pls fix this, even if you wanna say that connection is bad, the loading meter is still will not move after the connection gets better, it's stucked and it forces me to re-open the app!

I've spent tens of thousands on this game and played daily since day one. I've seen a huge decline, they focus way too much on marketing now outside the game and have no actual game focus. updates happen way to infrequently, the story gets an update like once every 6 months, no added content and they have lost their original fan service orientation. prices are too expensive for what the game offers, go play dragon traveler, they have it on lock down!

Originally I gave this game a 4/5. After years of updates it's gone from one of the best gatcha games to one of the best games, period. The music is fantastic and full of soul. The story is gripping and one of the best narratives in gaming. Each character has plenty of love put into them no matter how much or how little they appear. There's a slew of content every update sometimes adding whole games worth in a single event through their mini games like MOG or the Cindy metroidvania. Please Play.

The game is really solid, phenomenal music and soundtrack, great character design, decent gameplay, and a REALLY Great story (mostly why people play this game). The only complaint I have might be the progression throughout the game, sure the gems they give you are alot, but one important thing for upgrading your nikkes are the manufacturer equipments, there's barely any way to get them except if you participate Co-op raids or progress through the story for crates. Overall, game is still fun.

So far, so good, but there’s still room for improvement in Battle Mode. I want all battle UI elements, especially the pause button and burst skill location, to be adjustable. It feels unfair for mobile players since PC players can simply press Esc to pause and drag the crosshair to aim ahead. In short, the battle UI should be more customizable for mobile convenience.

"Came for the "PLOT", stayed for the plot" As far as gachas go, this one is more on the generous side. The gameplay is alright...ish, but really? is the characters and the story that hook you in. For those that don't have much free time, the gameplay loop and the dallies can be done rather quickly.

Nikke looks great, but progress is trapped behind RNG, overpriced packs, and repetitive gameplay. Story progression is blocked by power requirements, forcing players to get multiple copies and limit breaks for 5 characters to escape the level wall. Worse, there is no proper pity to secure those needed characters. Equipment, skills, items, and materials also feel like lotteries. Fan service from characters feels like the only reason many still stay in this game.

all i can say is i've been here since day 1 of release. just grind the game because small rewards counts. been getting all the characters i want without spending a single thing. patience is the key for this game and it is rewarding. it's still improving and most of all the company listens. can't be perfect but listening and improving little by little is a good trait to have

THIS GAME IS AMAZING!!! I've been playing this game every day for two years and it's one of the best games I've ever played. It's not perfect, but when it's good, it's REALLY good. PROS: - Story is amazing - Dialogue is (mostly) incredible - Character writing is phenomenal -> Some characters are deep asf (eg. Dorothy) - Music is FIRE - Writing is amazing at capturing emotions. CONS: - Consistency (sometimes the writing sucks) - Some character art is obnoxious - Bugs/performance - Store prices

love the game. even came back after a year to play again. unfortunately, it keeps corrupting after download. I can play for 5 minutes before "disconnected from server" then cant get back in because the files are corrupted. I have reinstalled several times. not wasting my time.

I did not get a refund because of a dupe purchase really sucks. Though game has been improved after the new years patch. years later. The game is still great. the story will keep making you have a roller coaster of emotions. QoL improvements to speed up dailies. keep the enterrrrrtaainnment going!

Have been playing since damn near the beginning. Should have wrote a review ages ago. The storyline sucked me in and has kept me hooked for years. The events are usually good. The artwork is top-notch. Only missed a handful of logins since I started playing.

Great character design and physics in their movements and combat situations. Story-based shooting game with lots of waifus and meta seekers in this game. I personally enjoy the dialogue and lore behind every character. It may seem like a harem targeting male audiences more.. This game is worth investing. Just need a lil storage and a compatible device to enjoy the graphics.

It's great. As a long-time player, I wish the level 160 wall for newer players was just removed. you need 5 ssr characters with 3 copies each to get your level above 160, which I think it unnecessary and probably pushes newer players away. In my opinion.

Best game ive ever played, besides the huge PLOT the game offers it has an amazing story definitely worth going into as well as a reasonably f2p friendly experience unless you want all the skins. I'm considered a veteran (self-proclaimed atleast) in the game and will continue to play and promote personally. If you're going to play, add my user FAKE on global server. Best Community I've ever been in 😂 👍👍😭😭

Returning once again. I left for the first time around the leplace event and returned at the nier automata event. Left again because my phone was low end and I needed space, but I returned on the PC version around the Cinderella event. The gameplay loop is still largely the same as the very beginning but the story has developed in some really cool ways. Grinding for rewards is much easier than it was before and I'm finding I'm having fun with this game again. I think I'll be staying this time.

after a most recent update around the beginning of July 2026, My user account was completely wiped out without consent, do not play this, and especially to not put any money into playing this, you will get robbed of everything you put in!!!!! I will never play this game again, and I suggest to anyone who likes actually putting any effort in their games to not play this either, you will be betrayed and robbed!!!!! this had a happened after I made a simple suggestion of adding YouTubers to thegame

No ads, no timer for TPK, no base that you need to protect or "research" for. Events are to progress the storyline, not empty your wallet. Shift Up is beyond generous with their rewards and they don't stop after a month of playing. There is enough to do on here that you can progress in different parts and still grow your characters.

I have encountered a problem on the game after change to a new device now using sd8elite with new nikke update it won't let me log in into the game, it show "system error" and I also do re-installing the game... it still show the same problem...I think my wifi is good while playing other games...I think ill have to quit for couple months and re-visiting the game again. 😢

I started this game for very apparent reasons, the character design to say the least. But updates and quality of life upgrades have kept this game very intriguing and fun to play. Very free to play friendly, at least from my experience. I got into this game for the girls, but I'm staying for the stories and expansions.

I like the game a lot, great story and awesome characters. I just really hate the gacha system they have. It is not free to play friendly at all. If you want the limited character, be ready to spend A LOT of money. And to make it worse, there's no pity system that many other games have to help you.

as someone who plays other gacha like Morimens, Wuwa, Umamusume; this has the absolute worst drop rate of all, next to Genshin. pity is 200 rolls, skins can cost upwards of 150 bucks, and the gameplay is subpar at its peak. plus ai-generated content creator YouTube ads meanwhile the game is making enough money to roll out stellar Blade 1 and 2, alright my man. seriously, dont waste your time. Just admire the hot characters from art and dont waste time/money on this

Came for the girls, stayed for everything else. The story is far better than it should be and the characters are actually likable. Been playing for almost 3 years now and I'm still getting surprised by how well this game does storytelling and character development. Truly an amazing experience. More people should give it a try, even if they don't like the "spicy" content.

So, my previous review was removed because, jokingly, it only said "Mirror Container", which apparently is not enough to justify a bad review. I will then proceed to better express myself in hopes that this review is not removed like the previous one. Mirror Container (campaign 32-33) is a sadistic wall put in place by the devs to keep you idle for 3-6 months depending on how good you are at the game and how fast you got to that point. I can't use harsher words, unfortunately.

The gameplay is very different from a lot of other gachas and the story is surprisingly interesting given the games "selling points." In general, it's a fun, solid experience. The Devs have brought a lot of the Quality of Life experiences to the Global server...so it's definitely "better late than never" regarding that. As it is, Nikke is a fine gacha with an interesting story and fairly unique gameplay.

I have been playing since launch and have enjoyed my time with the game. The story has been fantastic, the collabs fun, the minigames and minor content plentiful and entertaining. With all this said however I have had the recent displeasure of extremely poor gacha luck not seeing a single SSR in 110 attempts at a 4% rate, with this in mind I would suggest the developers think of implementing a soft pity into the game to at least see a SSR after 60-80 dud pulls, not necessarily the target SSR.

Great smooth gameplay. Perfect amount of fan service, characters look unique and amazing to look at. Progression is very much possible without spending a dime but you are rewarded often for doing so. Leave it to Shift Up to always deliver in a genre with constant oppression surrounding it from the western puritans.

After years of playing I'm probably going to step away. The game has strayed from its original direction and isn't very interesting anymore... core gameplay also hasnt changed at all in over 4 years and other parts just abandoned. Still a serviceable game but the new direction isn't as good as it used to be.

Cute character designs, and the little bit i got from the story caught my interest, however because the game broke and i cannot play, i cannot rate it higher. Waiting hours for a 16gb game to download, only for it to break before reaching chapter 3 and me being forced to stare at the lobby background with no ui, is certainly a game ruiner for me atleast, and it does not fix by clearing cache, reloading the game, or restarting the device. Hopefully it gets patched soon.

The story and voice acting are amazingly good for a gooner-bait gacha game, but I just cant stop playing this game to learn more about the characters. also, the mini-games are extremely in depth! You have a rhythm game, a stellar blade boss battle game, tower defense, metroidvania, vampire survivor game, the list goes on!

This game is actually so much fun. It's exceeded my expectations. in fact, it demolished them. Not only does it look great, but the gameplay is fun and engaging, more so you get to actually interact with your characters. like talk with them and learn so much more about them, so it actually feel like each character is actually unique from each other. Each Character.

Probaby top10 mobile game. (i played most by now). beautifully written stories and characters, great voice acting (JP Dub) and animations. solid varried gameplay. ----- Amazing OST! ----- it's by no means perfect, and it will be very frustrating, and the gacha mechanic is horrible [rate up banners are straight up a lie]. Came for the plot stayed for the plot.

the game and story is amazing. my only issue (and it's minor) is that I like to screen record and send clips to friends, showing them something interesting. this is the only game that while recording does not record the audio. can this be fixed? if not, it's not that big of a deal. could also be my phone's issue, not the game.

After not playing the game for months I log back in and claim my outpost rewards but a bug happens that caused it to overlevel. The rewards were reset and my outpost level set back to its proper level but all of a sudden i owe them 3000 gems of my own earned currency for an issue that I had nothing to do with.
