I find that the daily missions in the game is getting too repetitive, but the payoff is actually pretty good. I just don't like how long i finish all the daily tasks, it's a big hassle to me. I still love the game, I'm looking forward to its future improvements.

This game is good, good ost, good gameplay and hot waifus. But goddamn does this game crash, it literally crashed 3 times in the span of 10 minutes. My phone (S21) can hold even Dragon Ball Legends, there is no reason for the constant crashes other than the game itself not having an stable server. I'm trying to enjoy it but getting back to the title screen everytime I go to the Recruit to summon for units or EVEN WHEN I AM SUMMONING THEM gets a bit annoying. I hope you can fix the server soon

The game's extremely enjoyable. I love all the different characters, the animated cutscenes and it's got some great OST too. My only gripe is the music usually breaking during loading screens and a few times the game crashed in the middle of a battle. Other than that it's great. The story is also very interesting. You'll hit a wall every now and then though, especially at level 160, which may affect your enjoyment of progressing through the story. Gacha's generous too. Highly recommended game.

I really want to love this game, I really do. The game has strong niche, gameplay is fun, art style is amazing. But the current management for this game is making all the terrible decisions, game is full of bugs, overpriced packages and skins, silencing community platforms on negative feedbacks, and most important of all, lies on the promise of no censorship behind the guise of "redesign". There is so much potential with this game, but the decision makers have ruined it all. Such a shame.

Came back after missing 2 Collabs, recently upgraded my phone so I can play multiplayer battles. The visuals, artworks, and battles in this game are pretty good. Haven't really been paying that much attention to the story, just trying to rush through it so I can get the next stage for interception. Daily objectives are easy to do, same goes for weekly. Really just grinding to get better gear and I don't mind it. Pretty good game.

The game is actually quite generous with it's rewards as compare to other gacha games even though it might take awhile to collect most of the units (unless you are huge spender). Not to mention, it has great soundtracks as well as good story telling. On a side note, fixing bugs is not as easy as it seems (try to develop your own apps and you'll see why). So, a shout out to the developers for listening the opinions of players.

Great graphics, great "graphics" 😉 and an interesting dystopian storyline that's keeping me hooked so far. Gameplay though is another story. The game weakens you if you're even a few points below the stage's strength, forcing you to wait hours to days to get resources to level up (the idle aspect). These roadblocks are far too numerous as well, with huge jumps in enemy strength. And it only gets worse as you progress. The rates, as usual for gachas, are very low. Even "molds" have bad rates.

NIKKE is one of the best games I've ever played, It was worth downloading the game after seeing one of my friends played it. I really like that you can get SSR's a bit often from those crystal and recruiting, and it really has helped me a lot with completing the chapters and fighting bosses. The storyline is great, but there are some minor issues, some of the voice lines don't match the captions below and that has occurred at the in the few five chapters. That's all I have to say in my feedback.

I like the designs and the UI of the game, but there is just this one problem that I cannot claim in "Advise", I cant get the rewards of Neon in Advise - Episodes, It says that there is an error. I clicked it and sended me back to the lobby. Overall the game is good, I hope you could add more healers. I'm forward to see this game progress and develop, Thank you!

Fun but only for those with money to spend. I like the idea of the gameplay and find it fun but there very little strategy. I've played to around 6-24 (mission level) and the game is all about numbers. If your number isn't big enough to beat the enemies number you just won't win. (and from what I've found changing team comps rarely does anything) I hope they'll change this decision but that would more than likely require a large redesign at the core and the dev probably doesn't care that much

While the has a fun combat system, character designs with great potential and a really well done story so far- It is heavily designed to pressure spending. Being free to play isn't viable. Summoning Resources come in drizzles, you'd be hard pressed to spend if you're wanting to collect all the characters or even get skins. Resources demand too much time invested for the little you get in return. There is presently an issue with censorship for characters despite how the game is advertised.

Game looks promising from the outside, which is why I pre-registered, however now that I've played for almost 2 weeks it's just riddled with bugs and has an insane jump in power spikes that makes being F2P very hard. I want to like the game for its different presentation and gameplay, however it'll be hard to motivate myself in playing when I'm stuck trying to gain enough power to progress in the main story. Also, for the first event: No Caller ID, it's a horrible sign for future events..

Everything is all fine and dandy, completely what I expected of the quality I've seen on release. It should have been an easy 5-star... except for the frequent disconnections that completely kills the fun. I get disconnected from the game more often than not: would estimate to be at least 1 DC per 20 minutes of playtime. Adding more to the fact that the screentime loading eats up a little more time than usual going from Outposts, Campaign etc., it's basically a waiting game with a lil' shooting.

Been playing this game for 2 years now. It's February 20th, 2025 today and suddenly after the Evangelion collab update, my game crashes. The lobby is all good but as soon as I click on a character, my screen pauses and the game crashes. Same thing happens when I try to click in "OutPost", and " Campaign ". I finally caught up and was really hyped to play the new campaign story but now can't even play it anymore.

Great character designs and I enjoy the story as well. Unfortunately, I could only give it 3* due to too many bugs in the game. The game also doesn't seem to be too optimized, my phone always overheats when I play the game and it also drains my batteries compared to other gacha games that I play. I'll still play the game for maybe a few more months and hope that the issues I mentioned get fixed soon.

It is fun on a surface level until you really get into the gameplay. First of all, loading screen takes way too long. There's a lot of bugs, crashes, and freezing in the game. Monetization in this game is incredibly greedy, 10 pulls cost like 40$. No pity/spark system. F2P will have hard time with this game due to the lack of free currencies and how stingy the rewards are. Overall the game is fun on the first few days, but you'll probly be bored of it especially with how unrewarding it is.

The gameplay is unique, the art and voice acting is high quality and the story somehow actually interested me. The things that prevent me from giving it a perfect score is that there is a distinction between payed and free summon currency. This is scummy, I'm adding this part later, they are peddling a batlepass for 24 euros PER MONTH, sometimes there's 2 going on simultaneously and most costumes are only available through this payed pass. You're scaring off so many people with these prices why?

Initially had really fun with the game, the waifu collecting, gameplay, voice acting and story was intriguing. But due to the direction they have decided to take with future character designs in terms of censorship and covering them up, which is their main selling point, I can no longer say that the future looks bright. Not to mention the truck load of bugs that make certain characters unplayable, the horrendeus optimization or the overpriced cashshop. The other con is that it is a Gacha game.

I've played this game since launch, and it's amazing. Sure, it's had bugs, but the devs listen to feedback and work on them. The story is amazing (I've genuinely cried), the music is fantastic (looking at you Red Ash), the setting is very interesting, and I truly do care about all the characters. The hardest part about this game is the grind once you hit higher levels, but you just have to relax and let time pass. You don't need to spend money to be strong, I would know. It's f2p friendly too.

Good story, music, character designs, and casual gameplay. Although the initial appeal to most is fanservice, the characters are individually well written. My only complaint would be the length of time taken to fully invest in individual units, but as with any other game that just comes with time. Overall a very fun, engaging and player friendly game.

I was skeptical at first when I saw the ads and promo. I thought it would be yet another grinding game but no, I was proven so much very super wrong. There is no grind at all, Nike is just a time management game. No need to worry about leveling all your character. Just 5 is enough and you can get the exp by waiting. The rest of the character level can be sync thus completely remove the need for grind like other game. Oh yeah, almost forgot to say about the nice collection of the booty inside.

Very disappointing. Misleading 110 free pulls launch event. It only give you around 50, the rest are from story mode. Gacha has no pity, good luck ever getting the character you like. The shop packages are poorly worded, very confusing to understand if what you are buying is going to give you paid or normal currency. I will say that the character designs and story are good, but that's not enough to carry the game.

Overall, pretty good game. Great character design and voice acting (jp) with fun game play. I enjoying rolling and there is many opportunities the game present to fo free roll for characters and it does a good job offer extra ways to get more paid currency. I spend a decent amount for the ability to roll more however after I certain point, rolling has just become extremely dull personally as it seems once a threshold has been reached, you no longer get any good rolls (100 rolls deep and nothing)

First off, the progression is amazing. The characters have a lot of depth and unique personalities — makes me feel attached to all of them. I like the music and the animations too. The game is well optimized and doesn't have the usual energy system like the majority of games on playstore. This is one game that I will dedicate myself to playing.

For me this game is average shooting games not just average it's excellent i will give it 4 star. why 4 star?, because the log in screen it's a bit to long, like 3-6 mins to wait from the log in screen, and the shop it's a bit too expensive for me. I can't spend 1k+ for skin, but i think it's just me that can't afford any skins. So far this game is excellent the character development, Character design, physics motion, skills, specially the events, and etc. thank you for taking your time. :3

Great game overall. Very good Story, lots of ways to earn gems, aesthetically eye-pleasing characters. I gues my single complain is the lack of availability on the character skins, though at this point, if they made this change now, those who paid for the costumes would think it's unfair. Also the equipment, so that's two now. It's gacha too, so you'll end up, inevitably, with too much equipment that you can't maximize on the unit you want.

I like the game's artwork, story and music. However, I feel that the game is too hard late-game even as a spender. I feel that the units I pulled doesn't help me progress even after spending money on it. I have skill issues. It demoralised me from spending more money because I start to feel the game isn't for me. I'm not the only one as I heard other similar comments in the community. I hope the developers tone down the difficulty of the campaign and special interceptions for us casual players.

The Gameplay gets real boring real quick as there's not really much to do other than shooting down on some easy mobs. Hoping that you guys could add in some mechanics that will get people to sit up straight when playing the game. Maybe allowing the girls to move from cover to cover. Effects of the game too, explosion of the mobs aren't satisfying enough, feels like I'm watching an explosion sprite from an old gameboy colour. (Maybe you could make the mobs explode into pieces or something?)

The game mechanics is great fun, until you look at the Japanese market and realise that Souls Of Sevens has done it before, and better. Gacha is just as bad as Fate Grand Order, common pulls are not useful due to the sudden spike in strength opposing AI has. High level SSR characters are a must, resulting in an artificial difficulty. To be honest, this game is up against some really hard hitting players in the market. However, the choices made in gacha and game design leaves much to be desired.

I would've rate it higher, cuz I love the story. But I can't even spend more than a minute on the recruit screen without crashing the game. A lot of times I recruited, and I don't even know what kind of characters I get. Only know that the crystal is spent, so I thought I must've got someone useless. Still this pisses me off, since who knows if I got scammed or not? Please fix this, cuz this is the biggest reason for me to drop the game.

Been playing this game for a while now. Solid drop rate, fair rewards, good character design and fun gameplay. But for love of all that is holy, if I see any more of those cringe weird Euro-trash bait commercials on YouTube I'm done. And this is from someone who likes your game, and has spent money on the app. For the love of god, don't sink to the same level as the fake mobile ads like rise of kingdoms

As with any gacha games first lunch, it's quite empty and it is lacking features that other gacha games would have, like different pulls and costumes. Other than that, it's a really good gacha with an interesting gameplay. It's well optimized, the art is really good, and the story is quite fleshed out for a gacha game. One thing that bothers me is that I can't play this game in public because of the "NSFW" aspect of it and so I have to wait until I am alone just to collect cute anime girls.

So far from my experience : 1. The gameplay is good, and i like the full burst system. Though, for some low-mid device i recommend you to lower the settings on 30fps. 2. Story is mesmerizing, it makes me want to keep digging to see what lies ahead. 3. Music is good 4. Gacha is pretty normal, spend it wisely if you are f2p. There are many ways to get a SSR so don't get salty over it. 5. Even there are many minor issues, the devs really maintain the game. So keep up the good work

So far so good... Found some annoying bugs, but that can be forgiven since the game had just released, and some have been fixed, one main issue that persist is still the Server, it's very unstable just like other online Korean mobile games, and with the new event, this becomes even more painful, and it's not my internet that's the problem as I can play other online games just fine with my internet without problem even games like War Thunder with its Server... Except for Korean mobile games

The game is lots of fun, but the monetisation is really stingy, as someone who wants to put some money in to support them, the fact that the beginner one time gacha costs £25, (but looks like less, thats a trap because the free gems you get with the purchase is unusable with that specific gacha) is disgusting, and that amount isn't even enough for a regular 10 pull. The Misson pass is also extremely expensive. Honestly is prices were cut by half, I would have spent a lot to support them.

Been pretty good so far, characters are nice and the lore is alright. The vocabulary used by the commander can be quite basic and the use of "Roger" as an affirmative does irritate me Other than that, the only major complaints I have is the unstable connection to the server that left me waiting on the connection page more than playing the game. But, this is a new release, and connections issues are to be expected when the downloads do so well and will improve with time. So far so good

Not a smooth experience at all. My playtime since launch has been filled with bugs and disconnections. For the past 2 hours i could hardly log into the game to complete daily tasks, making all my previous time/effort feel like a joke. The gameplay is fresh for the first couple of hours, then I realise most of it just go down to straightout leveling. Also the gatcha seems a fraud imho, with an advertised rate of 4% for SSRs, I've only managed to get 2 out of 200+ pulls so far.

The game's all great, i must say in my opinion. Though there is an issue that I'd like to say here from my perspective..: Apparently, I am stuck at Level 2 in Lost Sector, because one of the Elevators is glitched in transporting mode. And won't let my Nikke squad in, thus, the level is left unfinished. Shift up, if you are reading this. Please fix it.. and also, maybe you can try to atleast have the Special Recruit Vouchers a bit easier to come by? If that's possible n' okay

I have played this game since day 1 and also have paid for most of the mission passes. I dearly love this game, however i will no longer be spending money on this game after today. They added a gachapon and because of the currency exchange, the skin from it is $92 instead of $60, both far too much. If you want to play this game, go ahead, but i dont recommend supporting the developers if they continue this. Great Overzone event, just to slap us in the face right after. Please do better Shift-Up!

Great gameplay, likeable characters, interesting story....loses 1 star for lowish summon rates and pressure to buy gems. Edit: After a few more weeks/months of playing, the game feels completely unfair to non paying players. It takes quite some time to gather gems, and with the low summon rates, you can't progress. Within my play time I have gathered 6 SSR units, with at least 20 multi summons. It's a real pity since another shift up game 'Destiny child' is the exact opposite.

Coming back almost a year after my original review, I'm happy to say that most of the technical issues have been ironed out, and the game now runs as smoothly as it deserves. The censorship has also been kept in check to allow us to admire the amazing art and character designs. Monetization, however, remains an issue with most cash shop packages being quite overpriced imo. Also, the addition of customer unfriendly features such as the skin gacha force me to limit my score to 4 stars for now.

Initially had high hopes for this game but with all the bugs for the units not being fixed. I am very disappointed in the game especially since if this is how they are starting off, I can't imagine what things are going to be like later. EDIT: Tried to get in touch with support and no one responds. Game still full of bugs. Units are also still bugged. I'm asking for a refund but I doubt I'll get any help with it.

This is one of the rare mobile games that I genuinely enjoy playing, the story and overall art style brilliant. However, the only thing that makes me sad is the skins gacha, you're only given a small amount of free pulls, which aren't enough to get you the skin, after that there's no way to get more pulls other than to spend real money. I really hope that there can be some limited time events that allow you to save up pulls for the skin gacha because these skins are perfection.

I pretty much agree with other comments on the difficulty spike. The struggle is real. It is kinda Pay2Play game as you can just buy your way to infinite power. I think at least you should not allow EXP for character being buyable. So players can progress in relatively same pace Gacha is also skeptical. I got 6 SSR in my first 6 pulls and the next 15 sets I got none. I feel like it's trying to hook new players Also quite a few bugs right now but what game doesn't have them.

One suggestion is that when I tried to use the horizontal view of lobby the buttons where so small, that should use the horizontal view of lobby the buttons where small, that should be consider on future updates. But it's a really good game, it has the potential!! But we're not playing it anymore (I mean, why do you force someone to see what he/she is trying to avoid? There's no censure for this kind of games? Isn't the design of characters a little bit luscious? What about children?)

There's a lot to like in this game. The character design, animations, voice acting, illustrations, music and story are all great. But the game is let down by the monetization, the poor performance and bugs and censorship. Since the latest update, there's terrible lag and stuttering and the game launched with tons of bugs. They've censored character designs so they can somehow get the game rated for ages 12+ despite being hypersexualized. Cash shop is also very expensive compared to other games.

Been playing this game since its first release, after that I took a month long break from the game because it gets really boring grinding for the daily missions. Now I'm back again after I heard some good things about it on my friends, the game still have some bugs and glitches but I don't mind it that much. I'll be real here, the odds for obtaining certain characters here are really low that it's so hard to obtain one (especially the Pilgrims). 4 star for now, maybe I'll change soon.. 💀

I cannot, in good faith, recommend this game. While it is fun and enjoyable, the music and artwork is nice, the story of chapter 3 is where I was forced to stop due to the themes involved, and the lack of choices on how to handle the situation. I only feel utter hatred towards Suyan, or whatever she's called, and I am not given any options other than complete obediance.

On my experience there's some minor lag in game sometime due to internet connection which most players have. But the best thing about the game is the lore and the development of each character in the story's if there's anything I want them to add that would be (Global chat) and (Co-op mode/Squad) but overall I can say this game has been a great experience.

Went in with high hopes, uninstalled after 3-ish weeks. Game performance is lackluster, FPS drops (maybe fixed?) when large amount of enemies in screen. One of the game modes (Sim room) is nothing but a tedious, boring button clicker with no visuals. In game shop items cost egregeous amounts of real money for basically nothing. Game walls your progress at chapter 5 and 11, only way to progress is spend or wait weeks. Game is just pretty boring really. Characters good, rest not so much.

Character skins are good, but they are also very expensive, and skin gacha, which has the best skins, is insanely expensive ($60 to be certain you'll get it), so skip it. The main story is great; the event stories range from alright to amazing, depending on the event. Leveling up is a bit annoying at first, then gets easy. Team formation is confusing without a external guide. I recommend the game with these caveats in mind.

Lots of bugs that literally gutted some units. Wrong descriptions on items such as Pilgrim Molds (it is stated that you'll get a unit from Pilgrim, I got an SR Unit from Tetra instead.). Massive decrease in rewards once you get past Chapter 12 along with huge spike in difficulty results into halting your story progression for weeks on end. I would not recommend playing this.

I love the game so far has soo much potential. But there is a problem in regards to the episodes of some nikkes. They always go back to episode one and once I start over again, the game automatically sends me back to the lobby with some kind of error message. Please do fix this. No hate for the game though. Edit: from 4 to 3 stars. I thought it was because of my phone but when i played on anther device, the results were the same. Frequent crashes, disconnection, and nikke episode error.

Pros: Beautiful graphics and story. Characters themselves have unique personalities and story which is really good. CONS: 1. Game progression is locked behind squad power attack level. Meaning if you don't spend $$$ to get characters (and thier dupes) you will never progress the basic story or any other. 2. Their event shop tokens only drop if you have specific characters in your squad. And each of those specific characters only add up to a certain percentage/chance for the tokens to drop.

A "Time Crisis" game and gacha. It is a fun game, but I had to use an emulator to landscape the game since most of the enemies really loves to go off screen. Whenever I use the auto battle, the AI really loves my SG units, and wont stop choosing them to shoot far enemies, instead of using my AR / SR Units. Harmony Cubes selection screen seems very buffy, everytime I press it. Everything freezes, so I had to restart Nikke. Hopefully it'll be fixed until then. Still buggy, hopefully it'll be fix.

personally I would like a way for the commander to give some kind of boost or effect to the raptures which can make each team that little bit more different.I would also like ways to purchase skins for characters that have passed you have missed in the gacha. However, I'm not picking here so please don't take this as negative things I can say about the game. Everything else is throughout the most detailed and intricate game I have planned. Thank you for working so hard on it.

Decent game, but very crash prone. Spending 20-30 seconds in the recruit menu is a guaranteed crash. Have tried with 2 different Sony phones with 2 different android versions, no effect. Gameplay is pretty good, the story is very interesting, but the gacha on other hand is way too expensive. 10 pulls equals about 25 or was it closer to 30 buckarinos.

Editing from 4* to 1*, got baited by prologue thinking it's a high quality game, except prologue was the best part of the game and everything after is a downhill roll, not even gonna mention devs lying, censoring and atrocious gacha system. Edit: maybe i was a bit too harsh, but the monetization and very poor daily currency income really hold this game back. It doesn't help that as a new player you encounter the idle game "wall" way too quick.

An idle game that is not suitable for low-budget players. Gacha doesn't have a guarantee (other games in this genre are still have). The golden stone that has to collect up to 12000 fragments to exchange but it doesn't guarantee SSR, plus the rate is also chasing with the chance to get SR character. In the end, the game will be clogged and unable to continue. because of the character's level ceiling Excluding various bugs and crashing servers. Translating in Thai like use Google translator

Waited years for this, was in all the tests, the game is awesome, but whats happening is extremely worrying for the future of the game, two sets of premium currency and its hard to tell between the two, advertising over 100 rolls when those come from campaign rewards not at start as advertised, prices, my lord the prices, they think we're all Elon musk the battle pass which is meh at best is £18, predatory tactics and more, they need to sort this out asap or the games going to be dead soon. 1

Too many bugs! The screen always freezes when completing a chapter. Nikke episode are bug, notification of unlocking something keeps on appearing when you open the game. Too many sh!ts happening on the screen. Short combat even if there's too many enemies, no time to take in what's happening because its already over. Boss fight are fun, especially the "EX" and the jiggle physics are top tier! Its a pretty good game it just needs some optimization and bug fixing.

I really hope this game gets a better publisher, please blink twice if u are being held hostage right now Shift Up! The only thing that keeps me playing right now is the story! Overpriced stuffs in the shop + very stingy rewards keep players stuck and won't progress. If we want to progress we have to open our wallet, which I'm willing to do if the prices are not ridiculous! You're better than this and the game has so much potential!

After playing the game for a little more than a year, I'd say that it became much much better than what I initially expected. It has one of the best stories among all the gacha games currently available, and the gameplay much more interesting than what you'd initially expect based on the screenshots of the game. The gacha is much more forgiving than other games, and is not grindy but still fun. The game is not perfect though since a lot of improvements can still be made.

Good story but the limit break mechanic is a bit arse and the game is stingy with gems. Functionally works well as an idle game but people shouldn't be walled at 160 because of the lb mechanic. Suggestion would be to add a 'stock' lb item that any character can you to lb only ONCE and then have to lb normally the rest of the way, just to ease player burden and add a sense of progression, maybe as a reward for logging dailies in a row.

Overall, it is one of the best game that released this year. I enjoyed it a lot. The things that I am unsatisfied of is pretty much how gold/manufacturer molds works, especially manufacturer ones. At the very least, give us a guarantee SSR from it after climbing 30 floors. it feels lacking just to get R or SR after that much of progress. Another one is Simulation Room. If possible, make it skippable when we have more than the recommended BP, even hard ones. Other than that, pretty much neutral.

The game is really fun to play with really good graphics and lots of characters to use and collect, with lots of things to do and a pretty good story. There are not many problems with the game, being my second account, I've so far ran into no glitches or bugs whatsoever. You also don't have to grind the game too much to get new characters just play a decent amount which is always a upside to these types of games.

Feedback :- 1. Original Developer Game art is nice 2. The Pricing of micro transaction is way to pricey 3. The game bug fixes so slow and shift to other stuff 4. Early stage and tutorial is not newbie friendly 5. The game publisher was not the original company and it was "10Cent" 6. RNG on the game is very misleading 7. The original game wasn't 100% complete like Destiny Child from a get go. And it's seem like it's rushing to release even it's isn't fully fix

Good Graphics, Good Story for now, Game Gameplay. However the Gacha is too player unfriendly, too many gimmicks, and no SR -> SSR upgrading available which makes character nurturing limited. As a character collecting + nurturing game, the game emphatizes too heavily towards the collecting aspect. I understand as a business, they have to make profit out of the game but mobile games need high player loyalty to survive and I am not really getting the vibe to be deeply loyal to this game YET.

The game is still very enjoyable, and I played it for around 3 weeks nonstop. I made a lot of progress but suddenly it brought me back to the tutorial. When I finished the tutorials to link my account I made a new one entirely even though I linked my old one to my gmail. I tried contacting their support but all I keep getting are automated messages and not actual people who keep telling me to do the same thing over and over again even though it doesn't work. I just wasted my time with this game.

Unironically very well done game! Take everything I say with a grain of salt, haven't gotten that far into the game. Had a really fun experience, in short. UI and menus are great -- which I wanna put emphasis on -- super fun seeing well-put and thought-out game design. Next, gameplay loop is amazing haven't felt repetitive, not shy to give you QoL features or mechanics too. Not rly pushing P2W too. Then, of course, the multitude of characters to collect, whatever reason you may have. Good game!

Core components of the game is still bugged such as the character skills. There's a chance when you clear a stage, the game would give out an error and either freezes or sends you back to the launch. Despite all these problems, I am still enjoying this game a lot but I wish the developers would address and resolve these matters soon which is why I am leaving it at 3 stars for now.

The team building, good. The gameplay, arcadey but still pretty fun. The story, excellent. The music, GODLY. The UI and bugs however? Unbearable. Just logging into the game itself feels like a chore, and once logged in the game is riddled with bugs. Make the game more stable and I'm certain more players will flock over to the game. Just my opinion.

The game's concept is good. The graphics look amazing. The character design looks fantastic. BUT The game itself has some underlying issues. We have: Nikkes with bugs that either massively help them (Unli Magazine bug) or massively nerf the unit itself (Vesti), mechanics that do not work as intended (taunt), Forcing players to get out the recommended power for each stage as being under it will result to a massive debuff. And the fact all global servers got ddos'd, resulting login issues. Fix it.

I have been playing since launch, brought some packs, and decided to quit today. The real reason why I quit is because the mini-lags and freezes everytime I click something, load a new page- Edit: I decided to come back after hearing about the pc version, finally, it's so much smoother and less painful to play. Theres still an issue with fomo codes that 99.9% players couldnt obtain; why are you guys even doing this? Progress is still slow and the pulls are still limited, that said, it's decent

Gave it a 5 at first. But after one of the updates it logged me out and my account disappeared (it doesn't recognize my email). The customer service ticketing system never resulted in anything so I gave up - luckily I spent no money but after getting a few of the best characters in the game it sucks to quit because my email got unregistered somehow.

The spin on Gachas is pretty cool, just feels overly repetitive & not in a grindy way. Theres a lot going on, but also not enough at the same time? I can complete most missions without even switching character and just hitting every on screen prompt. I feel like the skills for each character also lack the "wow" factor. Just feels fairly lackluster. Not to say it doesnt have potential however! Just not very compelling overall.

I enjoyed the game, my only issue is having pull varients that you need to spend "Charged" Crystals (Crystals that you buy) to pull on, everything else about the game is extremely fun and interesting, it's just when you put something behind a specific wall, mainly a paywall, it kinda kills the vibe of the game, nonetheless amazing Game, I just need to deduct a point for that, seeing a lot of games that do that... Kinda annoys me (although I understand the position)

The game has a unique game style that lets you shoot enemies with different guns to defeat them. It lets you choose different weapons for specific type of enemies and to counter attack patterns of different bosses in which makes you think how to strategize to defeat them. PLEASE change the weekly mission because I think that: recruiting 20 nikkes and to break a Nikke's limit is not applicable, specially recruiting because it defeats the point of saving crystals and limit break is limited.

I've play for over a month. It's good game, good character design and story, interesting main story. Doing daily wont take too much time and effort, so i personally can complete in short time while having busy day But there're few downside... 1. The Hard difficulty. 2. no game modes with limitless play and reward. 3. No replay story for events and some small side quest 4. Small, rare, and hard reward 5. It quite hard for F2P players I believe this game will be improve better for any players.

The game, mechanics, animations and art is the best. Love the voice actor they add. I love the music too. The gacha is okaay? I haven't even get SSR in like couple of draws after getting 2 SSR in a row especially the limited time edition SSR. The only thing I dont like about this game is, the loading screen is takes so long to load. The game is faster than waiting in the loading screen which is annoying asf. The campaign has no quick battle too.

This game brings new gaming experience in mobile RPG. If you like shooting games, anime, apochalypthic cyberpunk themes, this game is for you. The story plot is interesting. Deeper, the story gets dark and more mysteries will be revealed. You don't need to grinding hard to get some resources, because resources obtained passively (AFK) and in some quests and events that make your time not wasted at all.

Having a lot of fun so far in this game. The story and world are really well done and pretty detailed especially for a mobile game. The affinity you can build up with the Nikke is fun and easy enough and often give some more details about the world. I do wish they would make the characters a bit more detailed lots of pixelation on the characters I'd be willing to sacrife some storage for it. Game just released so do expect some small buggs nothing mayor. Deffinitly recommend you try!

One of the best gachas that I've played, great story. The rewards you get are not bad, and from what I've played so far this game is f2p friendly, now the issue lies when you actually want to spend money, the prices are very expensive for what you get, I would only recommend spending on this game to support devs not for the stuff you actually get.

Excellent Game, i've been waiting for 4 years for this game to come global, 4 YEARS BRO!?, and it finally has arrived and i'm loving it alot so far, there are still a few errors that needs to be fixed but that won't change my 5 star review cause they'll be fixed at the end of the day sooner or later. The mechanics were easy to adapt to and such unique characters aswell, they're so adorable too. I swear, it was worth the wait for this game. Ly Nikke<3

I like the gameplay, graphic and the characters design, but so far I can only give 2 stars review. I play on 6gb/128gb device, but there are bugs that keep making the game crash. Sometimes the game just frozen and then windows popped up "system error", and crashing when I open the character story to get gem and the harmonical cube. I've tried to reinstall the game, but it's still the same. I guess I won't keep playing this game if it keep crashing by itself.

It has the best music I've heard from a gacha, proper shooter arcade gameplay, and incredible designs! and has English VAs!!! If you have the space for NIKKE, I would recommend it, but... This game is incredible top heavy, as they shove most of the characters into a golden rarity. And after you've gotten out of the honey moon phase, good luck getting any of them as this game becomes the biggest scrouge imaginable. Which is a real shame has the gameplay loop is soiled.

I wasn't having any problems with the game since the launch, neither with bugs or crash very noticeable, it is indeed beautiful and unique, but on one day, by a system error warning that kept coming up it restarted the game when entering it made me login and restart my account from the beginning, tried logging again, cleared cache and later even data to see if it would log back, but it only keeps the data as just started the game for the first time

Currently in a near unplayable state. Game constantly freezes, or 'fails to sync information' which resets the game at times. Sometimes, theres an obnoxious in game pop-up trying to get a dollar and half from you. With how inconsistent and stingy it is right now in terms of performance, insentive and reward quality I wouldn't even spend less than $1. Bad start to a promising game. Also, why are child characters in a blatant sexually suggestive game? Theres even a kid with a BDSM theme! 🤦‍♂️

Currently on Chapter 17. Very engaging storyline. Not to mention, limited time events are very satisfying. I am currently saving up to buy a stronger laptop/budget pcs, so that I could play this game on those platforms much more smoother. It performs quite alright, on my phone (Infinix Hot 30, on 720p resolution setting). Lastly, I would love it if it is possible to optimise the particle effects, as even with combat effect off, I'll suffer from frame drops(harder to aim).

The art and lore is very good. You have to be patient and know which teams work well to progress in the story. However the main gripe to enjoy other stuff in the game is gated by a paywall and also the prices are way too high. Even the battle pass, albeit the skins provided look enticing is not so worth to get.And yes the skins are overpriced as heck.

The love child of a Time Crisis game and that one scene from Highschool of the Dead, yeah you know the one. Kinda busted right now, probably expensive long term if you want to get anywhere(max levels are tied to dupes, never a good sign), only somewhat saved by it's VA performances and artstyle. Also has some afk game elements inspite of having actual gameplay so we'll see how that all plays out. If it doesn't waste players time this moght be a decent or even slightly better game.

I always play game until I could no longer play due I have to pay for the upgrades or taking me too much time to wait until I get to certain level normal way, let's hope this game doesn't do that, at least not much. so far I've enjoy the unique gameplay, story, character design (especially SSR) and events. I think it's very creative and so out of the box. so for now I'll give 5 star for the game itself. later I will updates on how the game going

The gameplay is all good, the graphic n animation is nice but there's one thing that's really bugging me is that when the update comes, it always showing "system error, restarting the game". Only when I connect the wifi or somebody else's hotspot can finish the update. Just because of the last few megabytes of data I cannot finish download. Seriously? I don't wanna waste my money to get new and fast data plan just for this game, to finish the update.

The game and graphic is nice, the only problem is the rate of the recruitment is extremely low, you can spent 30k gem and still get nothing, and will let all your time spent feel dissapointed. And the in-game purchase is also too expensive to really consider, unless you really love the game and willing to spend your fortune. I just hope the rating of getting SSR can improve.

First off; the game is great and I'm all for the lewdness 🫡 The gameplay is more satisfying than I thought it would be at first, the characters are all likeable, the gatcha so far hasn't been too bad (but the store for gems/outfits is very expensive). The devs actually seem to care about players opinions/experience too. English translations still need work in places or are wrong though. I hope for more lewdness and expansion in the future (age-gate content if you have to via account age).

Don't be fooled. Shootings fun but can get a little tedious. Lets be honest, 90% of you are downloading this for the cute/sexy girls. First of all they use all kinds of things like hair, backpacks and those damn jackets to block the view. They've explicitly changed multiple designs for being much too indecent(lol), despite this being the #1 selling point of the game. Lots of predatory practices, without multiple 5* copies don't expect to do well in stages. Can't believe the DC creaters made this

Updated Review: Game is now playable at least. It is fun though for some reason I am lagging at the recruiting part even though everything is smooth everywhere else. (old: Game is extremely buggy - ranging from downloads going backwards and looping (even not downloading at all) to not seeing anything on the screen and even up to not getting any rewards at all. Extremely disappointing waiting for months for a game that doesn't seem to have any quality control whatsoever.)

For a game somewhat based on "fan service", I think it's still good. The character designs are appealing, the main and all the side stories are quite interesting. Though some of the things can become a chore to do like the simulation room but that's not the main issue I have with the game. The main issue I have the several bugs within what's in there, mainly the constant system or sync error screens that can sometimes make the game unplayable

I really like this game, story is very interesting, Nikke are cute, fun and each has a distinct personality, combat is engaging and fast. Unfortunately, I'm uninstalling the game because of insanely long wait on loading screens, both while starting the game and while switching between different game menus. It bugs me more than grinding for resources and gatcha mechanics. If they ever make an anime out of this story, I'll watch it!

I really like the game i already used a lot of time and money in this game but i cant log in anymore its always says unable to retrieve information and your verification is expired its 5 days straight now can't log in or enter the game . I already tried everything to fix clear cache , storage, improve connection I even delete the game and download again. I really want to play!!! I already late for the first event. This is a really an unexpectedly great game, it has the same PGR vibes except that it is straight shooting. I love the story, characters, especially Rapi and Anis. All I have to suggest for the game to be a lot better is to allow the landscape mode in the game. I admit that I had a rough time doing my strategy to guard my nikkes when there are missiles coming in because I can't see on who will they land on.

Game seemed pretty good at first with high quality art, story and music but currently it's no longer good. Game throws 2 hours of dailies at the player. Simulation room, interception, advising, current event with both battles and minigame, seasonal co-op (laughably easy compared to previous coop missions), multiple PVP battles. It's a supposedly idle game yet it wastes so much of the players time. There's no skip button (outside of interception). It's outrageous. And it's bugged in many aspects.

The game is amazing! The story line and gameplay is well thought. Although aside from some bugs and some crashes, the game has improved every update. Edit2: I'm seeing so much improvement and catching those pesky bugs! 4 stars. Gameplay is smoother. Edit4: Wildcat co-op server is potato. It's been an hour trying to have a decent battle until it the game decides that it doesn't want to co-op anymore. Connection in other games are well unlike here's co-op.

I've been enjoying this game for a couole of months now. And I can say it very beautiful game. Great gameplay, great character, great story. Being the onky downfall is the repetitive grinding. But hey, gacha games. Tough i wish they would fix Rapi's bond 10 english lobby voice, because she's mute on the lobby. And it would be even nicer if they would optimize the game further sobthat mid to low end phone can enjoy this game too. Thanks as always.

It takes more than the art to be an actual good game. As of now, the combat is basic with no strategy needed to win. Gameplay gets repetitive. It's worth a try still but you will be bored of it a few days later. New characters are good and all but... Is that really the focus right now when the game is plagued with slow loading and bugs? I don't know man you do you but I'm done with this game for now.

Is there any chance fixing the character bonding stories error? The error kept occured and I can't read them at all. I just love the post apocalyptic storyline and all characters are lovely. I wish I could know them more in the view of the Commander. Plese fix the bug as soon as you can. Love your game. Gonna keep playing them.

Game downloaded it's base memory size and later applied random patch file size which constantly kept getting bigger eventually reaching Gigabytes of file sizes. Plus often game is going into maintenance mode meaning it's not accessible and what's worst....IT DOESN'T EVEN OPEN! Patches which randomly keeps getting bigger with every game's reset doesn't download. They just get stuck along with the screen. Basically crashes the game. I never even got into the game. Unplayable! Shame, devs!

Game is actually unique and feels original. It actually puts itself out of the typical Gacha RPG that we usually encounter. Gameplay is a simple fast-action shooting game with some mechanics similar to elemental weakness and chained skills Gacha system is quite f2p with 4% rate for SSR's. However, there's no pity system. Character designs, Lore, and animation is actually really good. Despite its mature content, the lore is something to look for. Currently looking forward for future contents.

This game offers a unique and interesting story to players. While there are some minor grammatical errors, it's still very enjoyable nonetheless. The developer, Shift Up Corporation (based in South Korea), is quite generous to players with all the in-game rewards and they actually listened to the community on things that needed improvements. What's surprising is that the in-game purchases are actually not that bad, and this comes from a conservative light spender.

This game has some cute girls and cool mechanical designs. Unfortunately it's also buggy as hell, has extreme timegating for player strengthening (circumvented by whaling), is badly translated (dialogue is often stilted or doesn't connect to previous lines properly and character episodes straight up read like machine translations), and did I mention it's buggy as hell? I do not understand how this game was released in this state when it spent so long in beta testing. Also, censorship.

Gameplay is fun, art and sound are fantastic. Gatcha rates feel a little meh. Really like the characters and the story. Some of the English translation feels janky but that is mostly forgivable. Have to give it middling marks tho due to the app somehow losing my account and probably losing all my progress since it was a guest account. Trying to track down how to contact support is a pain when not in the app. Maybe I'll start again from scratch sometime down the line 🤔 For now I'm done.

The gameplay is fairly unique and interesting, however I would not support the english localization as the translation team made the deliberate choice to be creepy about pronouns when characters in cutscenes refer to the commander. Though it may be difficult to do so, you would be better off supporting the original developers directly if you must play this game.

After maintenance the server quite unstable many system error pop up appear, longer loading, i also crash several times, sometime i cant even claim reward, and the most problem were customer service ingame isn't even accessible i try to press but nothing happens like it just photo not actual button. At this point the game become quite unplayable. I kinda like the game hope you guys fix it. Edited: some of them fixed already now.

Great game for those that want straight forward ideas and some strategy with progression + emotional story. The game uses easy and clear terms. Central Government, Ark, Outer Rim, Surface. Some games try to invent the wheel and use absurd names. Unless you spend a lot of time, you're probably forgetting it. Combat -easy since auto, but it works better manual, esp if you can go to PC. Feels cluttered on mobile. Story likes to weave between happy and depression, very rewarding and touching.

I'm on global server and I can't literally play the game anymore. During the naming phase the game crashed and I wasn't able to name my character. But that's not even the worst part. I can't progress through the story because everytime I click my profile and the outpost it shows "failed to sync user information" and then reconnects the game. I'm literally stuck at chapter 2 since I can't open the outpost. I emailed my concern already with photos as reference, as of today there's still no reply.

I give up playing this game. I have been extremely disappointed with the experience. The recruitment rate for SSR char is extremely low, making it difficult to obtain the characters (even it says "increased rate"). Additionally, the game is plagued with bugs and technical issues, which disrupt my gameplay and make the experience frustrating.

The game was fun at first. The story is well thought out and it was really interesting. But, after the 1st Chapter and Tutorial ends, the lobby screen is quite crowded making the game quite slow ang buggy. Having fps drops. The characters are 1000/1000 but I got tired playing cause the boss level in chapter 2 or 3 are quite difficult for a beginner like me.

Good gameplay, horrible stability. There isn't a single launch of Nikke app that i either; 1. Failed to sync combat details 2. Connection error during coop event 3. Failed to sync with server 4. Crashing 5. Freezing for a while then desync from servers 6. Sounds overlapping with itself The gatcha mechanics are forgiving, you'd get what you want in the end. Overall this game is good but until they stabilized and fix the bugs. The rating stays for now (19.11.22)

Think of the good ol' arcade shooter games where they give you a plastic gun instead of a controller, now combine that with waifus, gacha, and shove em in a mobile game, that's Nikke, and I love it. But, with some slight issues. While I appreciate being able to stare at woman booty while shooting robots, they can get in the way of aiming. The auto fire wastes ammo which in the beginning is fine, but I can forsee this to be a hindrance in the future end game. And some other stuff but 500 max cap

Visually good game, many diverse characters but the game makes you spend money to progress the story because being FreeToPlay is excruciatingly slow in terms of getting more powerful characters and leveling them up. You can get them all, but it will take YEARS of constant dailies, plus leveling and getting their additional parts which is not worth the time anymore. I initially played for the story, but leveling made me stop because I couldn't upgrade my characters to match my pace.

Nice change of pace from other games. Gameplay is fairly enjoyable, but I'm mostly here for the plot (for real) and the characters. It was a bit of a mess at launch, and there has been questionable decisions at times, but most of the major bugs that initially worried me have been mended. Hopefully the game will continue to make progress with solving problems, qol, and balance issues, and find its own stride.

The game it is interesting, the mechanics are a novelty and the way of playing a shooting game from a cover up brought me a smile more than once. Sadly, thats about it, I didnt feel the need to puechase anything in-game, the character decisions seemed like they didnt matter and some missions seemed like they ramped uo the diffkculty without reason. Give it a try, but I am sure I am not the only one that will play it for a bit and then uninstall it to never play again.

I love this game the story, the music, the character not just their appearance design but their personalities especially for the 3 main characters excluding us the mc, I enjoy seeing their dynamic and I only reach last chapter 6. I see a great game that clearly doesn't finnish with a lot of bug, and it seems the game also a cash grab that force player to spend money to upgrade characters. I will spend money, but if I feel I forced to do it I will not do it.

Update probably my last update, I change the star from 3 to 4 I'll update this review if there is some changes in game. Some bugs are fixed but still many bugs. Many of the in game transaction are too expensive compared to other game, event AAA games aren't this expensive. Progress a bit easier, the requirements are nerfed. Hopefully no cencorship in the future.

Overall the game to me is OK, but there are still a few bugs they must be fix in this game. The bug is "View Episode" on Nikke, which is after you rank up their bond, they keep showing episode 1. Pls fix this bug and everything is good. And one more, the app purchase are so.. expensive. Consider a little bit cheaper and that'll be fine

The game doesn't really have any big issues so it's only a suggestion. Can you add a pity system? The chances of Event character is so low that it's so ridiculous, really? 4% of appearing? The old characters appear more frequently even though it said they're all 0.5% chances. I even save up 100tickets and still didn't got it, like what the heck? At least increase the chances of getting the promoted character. It's really annoying and makes you lose interest playing the game.

I've been playing more or less off launch and I really enjoy the story. Really well fleshed out world and characters, in my opinion. The combat reminds me of the copy and paste side scrollers, though its different and hands the player more control than the mentioned copy-paste side scrolling games. Overall, I would recommend that everyone try this game at least once.

I do love this game but I have one really specific issue with it. When you're downloading the content the first and second separate times you download after closing the app it's fine... Until the third time and it just somehow freezes at 5/7 which it isn't even technically a freeze, it'll take really long for the pop up to download to show up, the only solution is deleting the app or clearing the data but it's still annoying, other than that it's a solid game but it's just annoying to download

Okay... I've been playing this game ever since it's released. The bugs and crashes were annoying but I still kept playing. Months ago, the game was finally stable. For fk sake, my progress in the game has come to a halt and my friends who expect to trade their friendship points with me would remove me. Thanks a lot for that (Sarcasm)!!!

The Game is great, good graphics, gameplay and even story. However, whenever I download the game files, it will always reduce as if the downloaded files were just nothing. Please fix this. Edit: The problem have now is that some data downloaded still needs to download again even after I download them over and over again. What is wrong with this game?!
