The story and gameplay are both fun, and the events often have engaging minigames. The game is relatively generous with free currency and gacha rates so it is not too hard to get the characters you want. Progression is a bit stalled at the start due to the "160 wall" but once you get a bit lucky with dupes and understand the synchro device the game opens up.

Get's grindy at higher levels but the story and events totally make up for it and the music team are 🔥 hands down one of the best soundtracks on Gacha games ever. Only big drawback is the gacha system here being a bit unforgiving, and with power directly tied to characters you get from the gacha system it's the main thing holding this game back. The game benefit of not having a "resin/stamina" system like most gachas, therefore story progression is only as fast as you want it.

The character design is..Ahem..i never started to simp for a robot until now. I really like the combat system but i do have some suggestions. I dislike how everything you have to do is just drag and hold your finger to the enemies with no skill used. Maybe give some difficulty except enemies dealing more damage? And one small issue. I can't sex the robots :( . I love the fan service! Please more! i really love the characters and their bonding cutscenes. Please continue this game!

Just feel disappointed for this game, I've tried my best to enjoy the game without spending any money. But I feel the game system is created to spend more money rather than let players explore the game, you don't need to calculate average damage etc. In my opinion, you just have to spend your money and you will get all the things you need in the game, p2w players will have no limit and that will make this not really recommend for f2p players because of it. Thanks for the game n i'm out.

Update: Current event is super fun, the mini games are like their own games right now. Loving it. Its not bad, fairly friendly for F2P nice graphics, cute anime girls and fun shooter mechanic (for a while) but there are some drawbacks. - $34.99 AUD for skins is asking a lot. - Gameplay is very repetitive and breaks immersion during events. (I'm supposed to be doing some kind of cooking competition but also have to shoot killer robots?)

Innovative and new style of game that could have become a gold standard. The combat starts to feel stacked against you rather quickly and the cover system needs work. Store looks reasonable, story and art are what's on the box. No husbandos here so if you're not into an Uber waifu simulator you'll be disappointed. Overall could be one worth watching but doesn't have the breadth of story I'm interested in.

This game has many good aspects. The character's models are great, the gameplay is good and the music is also good. The boss battles are also interesting and some of them are challenging. However, this game worst aspect is that is difficult to obtain Gatcha currency, in the three days that I have been playing it, I only have pull the Gatcha five times. The Gatcha's rate stipulates 4% for SSR characters but I only have pulled 1 on 5 pulls of 10.

1. Opening and loading screen takes about 5-10 minutes to fully load the game. 2. if you have a high end device, then the game runs fine, but for medium to low end devices, good luck spending the next 5 minutes on the loading screen trying to clear up a level of a chapter. 3. Gacha mechanics that the game has isn't the most consistent thing this game has to offer, and the resources required for it is nearly impossible to get on a daily basis. overall an OK game.

So far the game is fun to play. Good graphic that mix 2d and 3d and addictive shooting. Like a shooting gallery but you don't really feel like it is. And all the voice acting is good and the animation and attacks looks Hella good. Just that reading most notification you send and the current maintenance you are doing makes the game feel like it was not fully patched. Glitches and bugs i see player constantly report kinda kills the vibe that the game although fun feels very unfinished.

It's just my opinions, before I go. Simply say, Just like a collectable games like other games. I agree with the idea that devs put a tons of efforts into the graphics and sth visual. But, the thing is, game itself is not really fruitful, so blend. No strategy is needed to proceed. Grinding up you Nikkes(This is what they say) is the key to beat all contents. Doing the same thing repeatedly on the all contents is not a very interesting factor, I'd say. Well, that's all about. Great job, anyhow.

It take too much time in between load of scense or lvl of missions and campaign. It makes whole experience pretty anoying. Everything else is just fine. Looks good, fights are entertaining, big diversity of heroes...all in all not bad. But as not being optimized will put game aside until, if ever, that part improve. If u spend 30% time spent in game watching load screen that is not good.

I take back the rating, the game is good but too many bugs, the event is not well organized, logging into game take forever. What bothers me is that the ssr characters takes forever to get other copy which limited the progress. The packages which included the crystals in the shop isnt consider as paid crystals? The crystals is literally overpriced. Might consider leaving this game if the problem isnt solve at all.

This game has great music and gameplay. But, the amount of system error, failed authentication and synchronization failure led this game to be very annoying. It's not rare to get about 10 game crashes in that same day due to this game server being an absolute pain. But, if you have enough patience to hold back from stress, then I should say this game is pretty much a good game to play on free times.

Great Gameplay, But there is just too many bugs. 1. System errors at the loading screen restarting the game again and again. 2. Out of sync combat information errors having to reload and replay again. 3. Connecting to servers are a pain as they keep getting stuck at the login at 3/7 world registry. 4. Then the random disconnects that keep happening when in the main menu or in combat. With all these bugs happening at a high rate. These make playing the game a chore to even run...

Nikke sure has come a long way. I was worried about this game shutting down early because of the many bugs and problems that frustrated players during launch and in its first month. However, it's not the case now anymore. The game improved greatly, and I am glad it did because I really like the game. Characters, visuals, gameplay, and music are nice. Pricing of items is a bit on the expensive side and getting the Nikkes you want can take time; otherwise, the game is good and fun to play.

It's been a while now. Since the new update, i am constantly facing the same problem. I had no issues playing the event till 6, but ahead of it, whenever i play 6, the screen only loads the picture and doesn’t move forward or shows any story. If i try to skip it, same with the battlefield—it doesn't load at all. So i always have to exit the game in such situation.

Add a damn mute button for the download screen please... (I WANT TO LISTEN TO SPOTIFY, NOT THE THEME OF THE ANIMATION while I have the app opened to download the game.) So I played it on PC and mobile (for me, it's better controled with mouse [pc]) The graphics are decent with it's own stories and type of gameplay I really like the animation they implement in the game, they do collabs which is really honorable.

After half-year anniversary, the game have improved much in term of performance, event and how it helps player to break though the wall of level 160. Even the game still play to win and everything is very expensive, I can see the effort to help those free to play and player who can't effort to pay much to be able to play the game without lacking behind whale too much. Their event is high quality. Especially, 1 year anniversary event. I love it.

Good game but im sick of "disconnected from server" "System error" Everything that kicked me out back to title screen over and over again. The new coop mode also keep disconnecting, duhhh. Cash shop items are too expensive,i advise new player to try the game without spending money. Difficulty spike also kinda crazy, not everybody is pro gamer or big spender, people like me just wanna enjoy the gameplay, progression, collecting character and have fun.

Nice art, game, stage design. The concept is so nice when you mixed the shooter game with (jiggly) anime girls. Each stage give different experience, more higher stage become more strategic to you for the team composition. The BGM also so good, banger and boppin' from each stage and boss battle. The minus is, the notification bug and story bug is so annoying. Great game after all, may change to 5 stars if the bug is gone.

This game developer got rich quick with a whopping 47 mil after 1 month of debut. The graphics is nice, the girls are cute and that's it. The game play system is not well thought out. After sinking in 1 month, you will be hitting pay walls where you literally have to wait 9 days for resources or pay to progress. The game design sucks; for instance, the towers never resets so once you get that resource you are done. Hence you are very limited and constantly resource starved. Also no updates...

Basically this is one of the most anticipated mobile game for this year. The Art style is Awesome, indeed this is ShiftUp art style. At First Launch, considering it's still somewhat buggy and soon enough will be normal. The Concept and The Story of this game is Good. It's also bring chat system so this feel so lively interactive and engaging. However, the Mechanics, Gacha and The Leveling or Enemy System is still need to be considered. For me This is Still Recommended.

The game play is fun and the character designs are phenomenal. I love the story as well but the drop rates are abysmal to such an extent there seems to be no point in trying to recruit new characters. The cost is also insanely excessive, minimum $30 for anything worth buying compared to any other gacha game on the market. I know this is a game designed to attract whales but it'd be nice if there wasnt such blatant disregard for F2P players

good story, nice mechanics to talk with Nikkes and overall interesting world. it's a good game to pass time, as it is really good at that. Worst part of the game is how confusing the redeem menus are; having to enter the pass, cash shop, mileage shop, the exclamation mark before the story arrow, and 3 different event rewards are way too much. it all consumes about 20~30 min to get, as they're not automatically claimed when you enter the game, so "fear of missing out" is kinda prevalent here.

I started playing Nikke during 1 week of it's launch and I've really liked playing it. Story, combat, and huge assets. There's a lot to like, but I can't keep up anymore since level capping others until you limit break all five of your students or the great amount of resources needed is just too much. Basically, this is all skill-issue. I just want to read the story but it seems like being casual and just being able to log-in do a 30min daily task isn't enough. The game seems like a chore now..

Well the previous issue is solved, and the game updated with big event, but now even my network is stable, the failed to do auto login appears, if one successfully login, clicking on wipe out will yielding "system error", clicking on message to claim arena daily reward will also yielding "system error", it happen to often that im start to think that im always in bad network area which is impossible. please thoroughly fix it.

Out of curiosity from it's popularity, I tried to play the game for a week. PROS: Fun arcade shooter style gameplay which I think is rare these days, intriguing story but sometimes cringy, lots of characters to collect & great 2.5D graphic integration. CONS: guest login issue, (this will cause some hate on me, but) I know that this is a waifu collector but the proportion & jiggle physics of the plot is way too exaggerated. Overall, I guess it's a fine game but definitely just for the sex appeal.

I really want to like this game, gave it a fair chance but at this point you have to ask yourself what character functions as intended, so many bugs, game runs really bad since last patch. Even tho I don't mind it much, the censoring is something negative as well and can understand that it's unacceptable for others. It's very VERY stingy and the monetization is god awful. The Music and Art is very cool tho,I like the combat as well. I dropped it and won't look back.

The game itself is pretty addicting. You come to learn many things and I am one of those types who do not look up a tier list or guide beforehand. Took me a while to understand fully and get a better grasp on teams. Character design is great. Physics too ofc. Outfits are nice. Gameplay is pretty engaging and challenging as stages go by. Gear becomes more mandatory and unlocking tiers as well. I wish molds in this game have higher chance of giving ssr characters.

Amazing! This game reminds me of my favorite anime, 86. I preregistered without knowing anything about the gameplay and such. Despite the bugs, I really enjoyed this game. I love the story and the character designs. This is the only gacha game that got me hooked within 15 mins of gameplay. Also, the soundtracks are amazing. :)

Was enjoying the game in most aspects, there has been a crazy amount of bugs and other minor gripes. Story is fine, gameplay has a lot of ...plot the first event came along with a dismall chance of getting extra event currency and unable to do the second part due to insane power requirements for a game that just released. *Edit from here* after playing the game since release the gatcha pull rate is the ultimate reason I quit. Real shame as I liked the story and characters.

Marvellous simply and absolutely marvellous, I don't think I've played a better gatcha game with such a masterpiece of a story yet so fulfilling in all aspects. I have to admit that I had played solo levelling arise before this, and I was very disappointed with that game, and yet thanks to the ads on both YouTube and ffbe:wotv I remember this game and gave it a chance... best decision ever this game out guns (pardon the pun) solo levelling by a longshot and a half in everything. overall 10/10.

This game is phenomenal! I'm loving the game so far. I love the story, the visuals, the gameplay, and most especially, the plot. I've been playing for days now and somehow I still don't get tired of it. Update: It's been more than a year and I still love this game! The compelling story always hooks me and the character personalities and designs are just too good to pass. The gameplay is phenomenal and the progression is pretty balanced for a gacha game.

Very good game, and attention catching characters! There's only one problem though, this game makes my phone super laggy, my fps dropped to 0 sometimes and it's so unplayable. I still keep this game with me because the characters are just straight out pretty, and good story line too! But the lag stopped my characters farming.

I've been playing since launch and quit today. The dailies take way too long, especially simulation room, it ends up taking around an hour for them. Ontop of that, you need to do the dailies for events, which takes another hour. 2 hours for dailies is ridiculous, I thought that they would change simulation room to be faster, but no, they add arena which is another daily I need to do which isn't even engaging (it's an auto battler)

The game is unique compare to other mediocore game, but bug everywhere. even the bug for that bond episode never get fixed after they say will fix it after maintenance, so i have face the same loop whenever i want to take the bond reward. and now after the update its getting worse, the server is lag as hell and I'm getting error pop up every 5 min then force to close the game. The game become unplayable.

During your first hours you will be excited about some of the production values such as the character designs, music and dialogue, the first couple of chapters will be interesting enough and everything will be good...but after you reach a certain point you'll realize that this game is targeted to P2W whales: you'll have a very rough time upgrading nikkes, at some point it will be impossible to do any progress unless you pay. Bottom line: character designs got nerfed.

Play has gotten more stable after the last few patches, you will still getting kicked out of game but nothing too serious or irritating to deal with. Good story and characters and gameplay. Packages, paid gems and costumes are on the pricey side (i paid for about 30 summons which is equivalent to 20 meals) - you get free gems daily but its low and goes away fast due to stingy midgame rewards and being forced to spend for daily progressions.

Gameplay : good, Difficulty : hard, Characters : gorgeous, Graphics : good, Complaints : the only thing that's making me reluctant on giving it a 5* is because of the bugs. Bugs that messes with my ocd (stories unread even though u did read it and claimed the reward, in-game notivications (red dot) that still notivies you even though there's nothing to claim (the events, Lost Section, charactet story)), and from what I noticed, bugs affects the gameplay aswell.

I like the game but certain issues can't be overlooked. Summoning currency is to high and to hard to earn. Ontop of that no pity mechanics. Game still buggy. Then there's the gameplay. Dailies take to long -simulation isn't fun - and constant difficulty walls. The difficulty needs to be drastically rebalanced as there's no direct way to really gain combat power. Just hope you get lucky with gear, or get a dupe of a unit to limit break them. Unfortunately seems like game just wants you to spend.

At the beginning game was interesting and fun, but after about 1-2 weeks of playing it became boring, repetative. The only thing that made this game still worth something was the story, but still even to enjoy that story you need to upgrade your characters because that's basically the main point of the game, pull on character banner, get characters to upgrade to higher level...

Everything about the game is great besides the fact that each screen load is slow. BUT...After the latest update, I cannot longer continue my campaign. The game keeps persisting on "failed to sync user data", contacted already customer support and says restart device, clear cache and reinstall game. Did all of that but same error is still persisting. Decided to create another account, but still the same problem. Update: Bug has been fixed, developers are quick on releasing update to fix bugs

Edited my review. After 3+ months of playing the game, I can say that there are numerous bugs and crashes, too many for a "finished" game, the gacha rate is horrible and the cash shop is abysmal. Apart from the soundtrack and character's design, this game is definitely not ready to be played and the Devs should really rethink their monetisation system if they want to match the hype this game was getting. If things don't change, I don't see this lasting 3 years. Don't download it until June 2023.

So hard to rate this game. On one hand it's been the most engaging and longest played Gacha I have ever installed. On the other hand there were a lot of bugs at launch (seem mostly fixed now) and the Gacha system is hella stingy. People playing to win must be loaded as prices are also high. Been playing since launch but might be nearing the end.

This game should not be out of beta testing phase. In the JP server where my account data is stored, I have not been able to log in due to unspecified reasons for over 22 hours now. There has been no further compensation for the most recent 4 hour maintenance that was performed on top of the 15+ hour server down time prior. Known bugs were also not fixed even after a 22 hour downtime, very disappointing. Otherwise, gameplay and progression is mostly idle.

It is the BEST game. Story wise you got the anime comedy feeling, good missions, great characters/NIKKE DO NOT LOG IN WITH X. My account got abnormality with the log in so I can't log in to my account at all. Yet the dev can't help me with this issue, and it's X fault I can't play it anymore. It's sad, but they said it's X fault so.. yea. 3 stars because I have yet to find any good replacement of the game, and I don't any compensation since they say it's X fault Quick response, thank you

Nikke is one of those games that just have so much potential, but the people behind it dont give it the love and care it needs. The story is good. Gameplay is really good too, but needs more to it. The rest is good, too. The biggest issue that it has is the horrible gacha rates. I put about 100$ and just got sr not a single ssr the system is evil. Yes, the bugs are bad, but that'll be fixed soon since they are aware. But that gacha system is too much. Please give it love and dont neglect it.

On my phone at least, it simply doesn't work. The additional files to download get to about a third and then freeze. If I reset the app it loads to 5 of 7 for an absolute age and then finally goes to the download screen where it immediately freezes again. Reset my phone several times, redownloaded several times, on various wifi connections including my own super fast super stable one. It simply doesn't work on my phone. Sad. (Using an S21 ultra)

At first I didn't want to try the game because the character design was too revealing. I thought to myself that this is just a game that mostly captures players by sexualizing the female characters. Then I tried it out of curiosity. Sure there are certain aspects of the game that are... Eye catching... But honestly during actual gameplay, I don't even think for a second to look at the characters butt or physics. The soundtrack and story are really good and serious, and the gameplay is enjoyable.

So many bug fixed .. but found out... If you want to be the strongest, there are no way you can reach that level with F2P... and this game is money hunger, every skin need money to acquire, there are no free skin at the moment, only rapi or makima at the moment... No point to play a game that is being bottleneck by paid to win player... To be exact, same 160 level but different core(star) is actually have many stats difference... I can play by my own no problem, but I hate buggy wild cat event.

Great Game Overall. The story, gameplay, graphics, the f2p friendliness, It's all top tier. Came for waifus, stayed for the story. If you're an fps player, this one's good. It has elements of Fps, rpg, gacha, and the likes. Although I wouldn't recommend topping up immediately as a beginner, as the game gives a you a bunch of free stuff to begin with.

This game is fun and the visuals and audios are amazing. I want to enjoy it but this games makes it difficult. it heavily requires you to spend money and a lot of time is spent hitting a wall in progress. I understand it's an afk game of course, but most of the characters are ssr and not enough sr or r characters and that limits your progress so much. Even the molds you farm, it takes forever to get for a chance to get an already ridiculous pool for the ssr you want only to get an sr.

Dropping my review from 4 star to 2 star to a 1 star. This game doesn't have the basic optimisation of other mobile games and that is just sad. Foundation is important. When you tab out the game while it's loading to quickly check something. Error, or stuck loading forever. Sometimes you do a battle and it fails to sync data for no reason. The gacha is also stingy and the shop is expensive I cannot see myself buying anything for support this awful monetisation. They added censorship!!!

I bought a limited time Pass in the game, my account was charged,I received none of my purchase, and the event is now over. Customer support said to wait 2 hours before going back to customer support again because it might be a delay in processing, I waited 24 hours and nothing arrived, then I went to customer support again and still nothing.

Played it before on it's launch day, tbh it's pretty hard at their first year. Play it again this year and it's so much better, it's very generous. There are many improvements in terms of upgrading characters and all. I'm hooked. The story is pretty good, the characters feels alive and very colourful with personalities. Sure others might be sceptical since the amount of "plots" in this game but it's exceptionally a good game. The musics is phenomenal! Recommend to adult gacha players 👍.

The story is good so is the gameplay the arts, The design and animation is top tier. But the problem in this game is that it is very buggy, I've experienced having black screen Game Freeze and the Story of the Characters you've collected, You need to restart the story but you can't get the rewards because it always says unclaimable or whatever it is called (I forgot), you also need to restart the game so you can go back to the game becuase after finishing the story it'll go stop or Black Screen.

The game is extremely fun and well balanced so far, issue is the stability, in 3 days of playing I've crashed 20 times, if I get disconnected from the internet I need to restart the game, the game some times freezes and I am unable to do anything but restart the game (this happens for example in the lost sector with the box cores menu), seeing the episodes for the characters also can crash the game or simply freeze or go into a black screen, sometimes it's unplayable, wish this gets fixed soon.

Game is good. Character designs are nice. Gameplay mechanics are ok. I'm also interested about the characters' stories. Would have given it 4 stars. If not for: the game is plagued with frequent disconnects (always getting sync errors). The game really drains your battety very fast. And the loading times are so slow. I'd suggest wait a few more weeks before getting this game.

The game itself is 5/5... amazing story, great character design, a player- friendly pity system and even an interactive battle system. That being said, I have one issue: the loading times. Every time I wish to enter the game, I have to wait for about 5 minutes as the game is generally loading rather slow. I have tried opening the game in different wifis and it didn't change nontheless which is very sad, considering I don't always have the time to wait at least 5 minutes for the game to open.

the gameplay is good and the story is interesting. However once you've got stuck in the campaign, you can't progress anymore especially after you cleared the daily tasks, there is nothing you can really do. My suggestion is to add free quest in each chapter (like FGO) and because there is no action point, limited it to 3 times per day so you can spend more time playing in the game even after you've cleared the daily.

Pretty fun, but bad rates with a bad pity system. The loading screens are also too much, with games like Genshin and Wuthering Waves, loading screens today feel archaic, especially when they are this frequent and long.

I like the game so far, the art is nice, the music is awesome, the story is suprisingly very cool, I'm only giving 3 stars because there are a ton of bug, for example I buy from the shop and exit the game crashes, looking at character storys then exit the game its resets the progress etc. If they patch up this annoying bugs Im sure the game can deserves a 5 star.

The amount of menus and systems can be a bit overwhelming at first, but after a few hours it is easier to familiarise. A massive amount of high-quality and free content, purchases mostly only for faster currency obtaining and not mandatory at all. Very good story and art, sound design is top-notch, but the soundtrack for this game has no right being as outstanding as it is. Very catchy, high octane and extreme quality and polish. The booba is a bonus on top.

I want to enjoy this game, I really really do. The visuals and sound design are great, the music is good, VA performance is stellar, the gameplay is fun. The only issue is how outrageous the difficulty curve is. I'm convinced the boss of Chapter 2 is nigh unkillable. It's been a week or so since launch and I am still walled on the same battle. Keep in mind this is the first chapter you play outside of the the tutorial. No game should get this hard this fast.

The promise of this game is exceptional. I have fun playing it. However, the game is heavily hampered by its publishers poor decisions that just make the game outright frustrating to play. Most characters are so bugged that they can't do what they were designed to do, in game rewards from progression are slim, molds are infuriating with their rates, no pity, constant game crashing, and more "modest" character design changes. I hope the game can improve on these as I would like to keep playing.

Gameplay is honestly pretty good and fun to play. Character designs are incredibly well-designed. Story is also well written. The only problem i had with the game so far is, the constant inactivity due to hardstuck on a certain stages. The difficulty spike is ridiculous, and it's pretty hard and confusing to develop a better team, and have them upgraded since there isn't any proper information on how to get a certain materials, or even a way to collect the materials in the first place.

This game is really fun, I like it alot. For example the voice acting, story, arts. It's all really good BUT the major flaw of this game is the connection issue, I still have failed to sync/unable to recieve player data and some other system error. Please fix this issue, it's really makes me unable to enjoy the game properly. Whenever I play this it's like a gamble on will I get system error or not, it's really frustrating. Overall this game is 9/10 for me if there's no error

I have to give credits to the graphics. BUT, it's so darn long to load and play. I played it on a Google Pixel 7 Pro. Just waiting for the loading screens and constantly taping for the numerous conversation. This game looks more like an anime novel with some shooting than an actual game. It took me a day to play and I was still in tutorials. It's also very linear so. Not my type of game. This is made for people wanting to spend hours on their cell phone or tablet as their main game device.

Fun game, but there are several bugs and errors that often pops up like server errors or systems errors which forces you to restart the game and lose programs, they are also other minor bugs and issues which I hope will be resolved soon. However, the game is fun to play, Voice, song and graphics are really nice. Hope to see more improvements being done to the game!

It's a decent game, but I'm just not a fan of the type of fanservice it places at the forefront of the game. Good music, nice sound design and the graphics are passable. It's just not for me. Edit: Gave it a second try, still can't get into it. The controls are wonky and gameplay doesn't feel satisfying. Character models are still great, gameplay has potential, but overall misses it's mark.

Overall a pretty fun game, but there's a slight problem. Whenever I would try to complete a certain Nikke's episode, the game would bug and restart the whole progress of said episode. But that's not all, the game would also crash at random times (not completely sure if it's a problem on my end though). But anyway, the game is still pretty enjoyable and the gameplay is very engaging.

Gameplay sections need to be reworked. The only good thing that's keeping me here really is the combination of the design of the Nikkes and the writing. The story is really, really good. Way better than the Gameplay sections told me to expect. That and the art feels like it's manipulated to look faded so that they can be animated. maybe they don't have the budget for 3d, which would really help, or they probably can't do it as well as other titles.

It's not one of the generic auto-battler RPG gachas and has cool character designs, BUT it's on the stingy side and doing the dailies becomes a chore very quickly (you have to do a lot of things, some time consuming and/or very repetitive). I don't really see this changing on the future so I can't recommend it for now, until they show improvements (if they do at all, which is not happening).

I love the game, but my God it is unstable. Lots of bugs that randomly pop up after battles, changing UI, logging in. The interaction is sluggish with random delay. The power spike between normal and hard Event stages that are designed WITHOUT casual players in mind... Really, I love the game, the story is engaging, and I don't want it to fail. But come on, do your job!

Alright, so I actually left a more positive review previously, but after more time and changes in the game I've kind of changed view points. One of the biggest problems is that there is a pretty stark power difference between different weapon classes, which feels brutal when your trying to push forward. Likewise the story is good, but the long gaps of waiting you need to do makes it hard to enjoy. Also some bugs can hamper it. I advise waiting a while and seeing if these things get ironed out

Love the story and voice acting, character design are great too. But for a newly launched game to be this unstable is making playing it frustrating. I get system error, disconnection among others when just trying to login, or claiming rewards,even completing a battle sometimes gives out errors. Not to mention even reloading too. Safe to say at the current state of the game, you'll probably spend 20-30% of the time logging in and re-logging into the game due to the game being unstable.

Good character designs, voice acting and music. Extremely predatory gacha system and unbalanced gameplay. The entire game is just you trying to match a number on screen representing your power level so as to not get a huge debuff. The 'hard stages' have obscenely high power levels for the enemy instead of difficulty, so much that even people who have spent lots of money to get the best characters cannot hope to beat. In short, unbalanced, buggy, predatory. But hey, there's good art and music.

Great potential, way too many bugs. The core of the game is pretty fun; being able to aim and have your units shoot the enemies while trying to manage your units' abilities is fairly engaging. However, the game is riddled with bugs. All of my main units right now are bugged in some kind of way: I have a tank that can't taunt, a healer that can't heal for anything, and buffers that can't buff. I can't progress any further cause of these bugs, so until they're fixed this game is not worth playing.

Aside from the hellish leveling (both nikkes and equipments), everything is quite good. This is a cover shooting game, so i know at some point it'll be quite boring and repetitive. I think there are some change needed to fight enemies aside from they're harder to kill or maybe we can change the cover or move to a different cover. Or we fight different enemies, not just ruptures. That way it can change the dynamic of the gameplay.

I was enjoying the game. But when the game has update, I always get stuck at some part of the update. I don't know if its a bug or not, got no problem with connections. Everytime it happens I always had to uninstall/install the game to play it again. Now its currently uninstalled because of that bug is very annoying. Will change to 5* if fixed.

I play a lot of gacha games but this one is a little more fun than average, however this is also the most broken game on a technical level I have yet to play. The amount of times I have to restart the game to continue playing only for progress not to save is increadibly frustrating. The just randomly ceases to function or I keep getting the dame notifications again and again even though there is nothing to see or I already did. All other gacha games I've played were technically flawless.

Don't get misguided by the ads, it's not easy to get SSR. And the first event is not even friendly to players, most of the players couldn't pass the event hard mode. Besides, there are still a lot of bug, and it is definitely not friendly to those F2P players. Too disappointed about the first event and chances to get better characters to play.

The game looks great, though as with mobile games, it's mostly mindless and really wants you to spend money. It also seems poorly optimized for a phone, frequently taking longer than its peers to load between menus with minimal quick-travel options, leaving you with little option but to wait through multiple load screens. Balance-wise there's a huge gap between the best and worst units so you'll likely find it hard to justify using your favourite over the meta. Try it out if you like butts.

Update: 4. with the most recent update, alot of QoL stuff has been added that greatly improves the experience of the game, double reward days, daily, weekly and monthly free shop items, new way to get top teir gear all welcome additions. some people are still stuck on the lvl160 wall due to not having 5 units unlocked to 3* and this is still probably the biggest bottleneck of the game. still going in the right direction.

Just gonna say, the game itself is very very boring. The daily grind is easy to do, but there's nothing to do except it, and of course that's how an idle game works, but this game is ahem kinda not meant for kids. Anyways, this game have many bugs, the developer patner, tencent is money loving, making the game an obvious wreck I wouldn't recommend you playing the game, just so you know I whaled in the game, before u call me a f2p. Spending like 1k in the game doesn't take u far.

The straight-faced answer is that this is a team building / collecting game where you build up teams of waifus to fight for the future of.... Humanity? The story is interesting and the gaming mechanics are pretty deep - deep enough for you to feel that spending money is not just an exercise in futility but one of support towards the developer, for them to continue delivering the goods. If you choose to play without spending, and it wouldn't be any less fun. Spending will just make it more fun.

I will admit that the character writing, and especially the lore, is better than most other gacha games (keyword being "MOST" others). That being said, I decided to drop this app mainly because of: 1) quite frankly too much to do with the dailies alone, which burned me out, honestly; 2) the Main Campaign is too grindy in the later stages, forcing you to grind your squads (which feeds into point 1), just to beat one more level. Then there's the bosses... yea, 3/5 until gameplay issues are fixed.

Would give it a better star system but unlocking characters with real money doesn't help you now it takes 100 to unlock characters greedy much don't download if you want to go broke with character unlocking marvel future fight 10 dollars to unlock and upgrade but 100 probably 200 dollars or more with this game

So I've been playing this for about a while now. To sum things up, the progression in this game is absolute abysmal. The paywall is there and it's big. In order for you to advance casually, you'll need to continually increase the power level of your team and it's hella expensive. Your main materials source is gated by time and the only way to consistently match the enemy power is to pay. Otherwise, you will be perpetually stuck at certain levels for weeks. Avoid trash.

Joined around the 2nd anniversary, and so far, it's been a blast. Great story, great characters, ordinary recruit has a wishlist, which means released characters aren't limited (at least most of them) and gives you a better chance to get what you desire. Special Recruit is a blessing, thanks game devs. Soundtrack is amazing too. Props to this company for not being so stingy with its rewards like some other gachas out there... Hope to stick around for a long time. I love this game so much!!

The game's lag has been fixed. However, the monetization of the game is terrible, with the most expensive 10 pulls and most expensive battlepass across all other gacha games I have ever played. Censorship of characters make the game unbearable for its targeted playerbase and the premium income for free to plays is too little. however,the discord seems to be coming up with ways to improve player experience so fingers crossed. Give it a try but keep expectations low.

Overall, its a good game. Though, there's still quite a lot of bugs, system errors, lags and anything related that needs to be improved. But, considering that its still quite a new released game, its a good start. Just hope that there's going to be a greater improvement on the next update.

Alright, after two weeks of playing, let me give you a honest review. This game is way too expensive for each multi for f2p, even more expensive than Genshin. And PILGRIMs rates are too low, very low. You need at least 4 or 5 of them to be able to win the Pilgrim tower as well (p2w). And lastly, there are a lot of game breaking bug in this game. And it seems like the dev didn't really care about it at all.

I don't particularly like gacha games, nor am I a mobile game fan, but honestly, this game is really enjoyable. I treat it as a rail shooter. I just wish I could replay levels to get more resources, because getting them takes so long, even after finishing the story (so far). The story is fantastic, and the devs have so much love for the world they have meticulously crafted. I am now over level 400, and in the top 5 of the leaderboards for everything. Syuen is my waifu.

Game has a lot of potential but right now it is a buggy mess. It's poorly optimised and burns through my phone's battery faster than any other game. The 1st event is impossible if you're f2p and the rewards are poorly explained. One item that cost half my event points resulted in a single Normal Rarity character! I'm enjoying the gameplay and story but if the issues aren't addressed I don't see myself playing this long term

The graphics is excellent , the animations also very neat and the game itself is easy to play . The fact that I love this game is because the player can interact with the characters , and good voice overs . But if I want to complain there is one thing , the gacha is not very generous as I thought so the players have to grind a little bit . However , this game is not a pay to win game as you can proceed in the game smoothly

It is a very unique, fun, and error riddled!! There are times when you cant even login due to multiple changing errors each everytime you try. I already spent a few $ but I don't think I'll whale on a game that I can't even constantly login or even stay logged in. Edit 1: De-sync error is getting worst. Edit 2: Already missed a day on the login event cuz of errors... uninstall.

I have been playing for a day so I might update my review in the future. So far i gotta say this game is gorgeus, the style, the characters, even the ambience and story are decent, no complaints there. Gameplay is entertaining for the first couple hours and gets stale really fast, it's just aiming at robots so you can progress and aim at more robots. Furthermore, being honest i downloaded this game hoping to see some sexy anime girls 'assets' but most of then are censored. Not cool. 7/10 so far.

Did not expect the complexity this game has at all! Seems that I underestimated Nikke. Nikke has so much to offer, and I love everything about it, from the characters to the story to the gameplay. There's actually a method for clearing the simulation room quickly, but it isn't stated in the game. Overall, the game is slowly getting better. Just be sure to run the game on 60 FPS with no screen shake if you can, though I highly recommend it for optimal gameplay.

1. The loading time is slow it always took me a minute just to enter the outpost and go back to the lobby. 2.The simulation is time consuming which is not good for me since I am always busy. 3. The limited time events are always the same and its boring. 4. The newly added pvp is obviously not good for free to play players. Whales and dolpin players will dominate since they can limit break their SSR to maximum.

All of the hype and marketing it did for the game did more harm than good because it grossly underdelivers. The core gameplay loop is tedious at best. As a cover shooter, it ranks among the worst, given that the characters take up half the screen. Its attempts to be a multiplayer experience are laughable, given that its actual coop segments are time-gated and stamina-capped. PVP offers no incentive to make you want to join in, with rewards that are useless, and a player-base that pays to win.

Nice Mechanics and UI. BUT: Please optimize the backgrounds and UI overall for horizontal gameplay. The icons are often way to small. It's also very dissappoiting that there are only so few animated cutscenes. The Marian one was actually great and you could maybe add one to the "overzone" recollection event etc. Tbh you could add one to each major campaign chapter (Modernia encounter etc.). In general there alot of long dialogues in the game which could be made more interesting with cutscenes.

some parts of the story I'm interested in, but the limited option in which you can reply sometimes is a bit infuriating...but don't worry, cause the eye candy this game has is really really not bad. waiting for some minor bugs to get fixed and then I'll maybe give it the 5 star ratting. also as of now at the launch point in time...the is a good rng and you can have the high ssr units just by rolling now and the with what the game rewards you.

97% of the content in this game is locked behind stupid combat power, and only old players or whalers can enjoy all the content. My god, I just want to enjoy campaign story mode, but the combat power spikes are insine, i always stuck on certain stages and need to wait a few days to clear it. As a new player... I can't clear the hard stage mode of the event because of stupid combat power.

This game is getting better now. Events and minigames like MOG and tower defense are really nice. Major events gives lots of pulls and gems now. Still a bit hard to break 160 wall if you are not a day 1 player. Also, overloading gears is a bit of an issue since drops from special interception don't guarantee the gears you need. Upgrade materials for gears are also hard to come by. I am fine with grinding gears, it's just frustrating because you are limited to 3 tries per day to farm them from SI

Nice visuals and cut scenes but it makes me angry that at the beginning game makes you click through all the learning process, not letting you do anything else, like either you are dumb, or you have to go through everything like creators wants and there's no other way. It takes so much time before you can do however you want and enjoy the game, that it just better to uninstall the app.

For a 3rd person shooter idle game it's very well stylized. Art & BGM stunning, decent amount of content for now. Characters aren't chibi in battle which usually turns down most players. Obviously as any game it's having a few issues but it's being handled very well, communication with the players and constant notices and updates through any means necessary via social media platforms and in game too. Honeymoon phase so also generous with in game materials and currency. Recommended to try out.

To be honest, it is a fun game and I was hoping it would change like its other game destiny child. At the moment, the game is full of bug that effects the gameplay, worst gacha rate (at the moment), censorship, and not f2p friendly makes the game unenjoyable to play. With the lack of source for free gem makes it even harder for f2p player to progress the game. Also its resource is very scarce that eventually in a day, you could only upgrade 1 lvl for 1 nikke. So at the moment not reccomended.

Bait and switch fanservice modifications during its pre launch advertising and full release, intentional deceptive wording on "launch rewards" advertising "100+ free rolls for launch"; yet counting every single roll you can get in the current version through clearing the game as "launch event rewards". Censorship to cater to china. Very little value for your money in all purchases, and complete lack of urgency in fixing bugs, some characters are bugged since launch and they dont work...

As a casual gamer this is a nice game and great for me. The characters are adorable and the gameplay is simple yet intuitive for a phone game. It's not too complex but a simple hide and cover shooter. I think they can make the cover system a bit better by adjusting the turn around and shoot timing on the first shot but that's just me being nitpicky. Like azure lane you don't have to spend any money to get the most out of the game. They mostly sell the skins as premium and that's how to go!

This game has been fine for me the arts and soundtrack is beautiful. Character design is decent atleast, But i hope it'll be enjoyable & ease for people like me who's don't spend on this game, It's hard to get materials for characters the stimulation room needed to repeatedly(i am aware that is normal for games for thing to repeats). Banner rates are kind of meh. I don't care about those fan-service you developers shows and i don't like that kind of stuff but overall this is fun. can't recommend

Overhyped waifu baiting game. While the gameplay, music and story are not bad, it's very stingy even on release with new players. No re-roll system built-in; awful rates to get the character you desire; false advertising regarding release rewards; no pity system (they have a wishing well which is just fake) and constant push for monetization from the get go. Feel free to give it a shot but if you're expecting awesomeness like Azur Lane or Counter:side, you will be extremely disappointed.

Game is fun for the first hour but then you realize how increadibly tedious it is. There's a lot of different activities you have to.finish daily in order to progress which takes a lot of time and gets repetitive and boring really fast. Half your time is spend just going through the menus because of the increadibly slow loading time. It's just a massive chore. On top of all they advertised the game on fanservice but they already censored multiple characters. Can't recommend.

This game has one of the worst gacha rates I've ever seen and I've played a ton of them. Now that may be tolerable to a certain extent but this game is also super stingy when it comes to normal resources like in game money and exp. Like they're literally hard capped and you can't attempt more on the game modes even if you want to spend diamonds like stamina-based games. Progression is therefore extremely slow. The quick battle feature is also very limited. Just unpleasant experience all around.

This game has one of the best storytelling I've seen in a mobile game, it quickly immerses you into it's universe and gets you invested in it. The main story and events are incredible, the characters are very well designed, and both the artstyle and soundtrack are superb. The minigames that you may find during events can be considered games in of themselves, with fun gameplay loops that denote a good attention to detail (thank you devs ❤️) 10/10 would recommend

I realy realy want to love this game, but the gacha system is bad... the top up is expensive, Theres 2 Diffrent BP with same price but have diffrent rewards(costume/skin). As for the prestige skin i understand its expensive but theres no special to it. As for the story is pretty solid i realy like it. The visuals, combat, music, and UI is pretty good. It just its not realy suitable for f2p players as for gacha.. for progress is still doable

I wanted to give this game high remarks for obvious reasons as well as it's appealingly visual and strategic gameplay but I seriously hate that when the game shows an error, it would restart from the loading screen. This take a total of about 5 minutes and what's worse is that it happens after a 2-3 minute battle and doesn't even save the progress before it restarts. Demoting my 5 star rating to 3

Good gameplay, Amazing OST, Amazing characters design. I'm changing my reviews because even tho the game have alot of problems( like a lot of problems) I still enjoy playing it. The difficulty spike is a huge problems. Have to wait 1 week to enjoy the story because of those difficulty. The game getting fix with every update so it a good thing. But still this is the most expansive gacha game in the history. The game should change it age rating to 16 or 18.

The game keeps crashing when I go to the recruitment tab, and this only started happening after the latest update. Another issue I have noticed is that the login sequence takes too long which dissuades me from wanting to play when crashes happen. If I switch between apps for more than a few seconds the game sends me back to the login screen too. I shouldn't have to go through the long login every time, it's really annoying. If I hadn't been having fun I would have uninstalled already.

Been waiting this to come out on early 2022 and it's exceed my expectation. It's just like a blend of arcade shooter mixed with rpg elements. I expect nothingless for the artwork since iirc this game comes from the same studios that made Destiny Child, it's just astonishingly beautiful. Also love the idea to make scenery of battling scene to low-poly so decent phone can handles the battle smoothly even though the Raptures spawned a lot at the same time.

The game looks nice but suffers from some major issues that you have to consider before commiting both money and time. 1. Game is extremely stingy with resources, not just currency for you to rolls, when a character needs multiple different things to be fully "level up". 2. Many incoherent system/requirment in game which suggest last minutes changes before rolling out that make game unenjoyable. There are other problems to this game but character limit. Not Recommended at its current state.

the effort they put into each character is spot on. the story line is amazing, however I do wish there is maybe more events with coop mode or a storyline where you have to use multiple teams. the missing 1 star is how much battery it takes playing this game. I play other games for 1 hour and only lose 2% battery. I play this game. 5min lose 3% battery. other then that. keep up the good work!

Been playing for a while now but overall, this game is nothing short of a masterpiece. With its amazing visuals, strategized gameplay, and some of emotional depth, it sets a new standard for what a video game can achieve. If you're a fan of anime and guns, this is an experience you won't want to miss. Five stars, without hesitation.

This game has good story and characters, but with many problem they have, i need to rate low to hoping waking up the devs. Bugs are everywhere in the game which is quite suprising how they greenlight this. The first event just cheery on top, you only need 17k to clear the normal stage and suddenly you need 46k to clear hard mode, the fact that you need certain characters to getting the currency is another telling how this game is going to be another failure. Dead on the first event i guess.

The game is good and all, and i get the fact that it just released. But my problem is updating the game. It would get stuck at 57% of the loading once i downloaded the update. You have to completely uninstall and reinstall the game back again just because of an update. Then you have to wait hours for the download to finish. Then you have to repeat that over and over for every update.

Riddled with bugs that have gone unaddressed for weeks and really hard paywall which grinds story progression to a halt as you're drip-fed enough ressources to level 1 Nikke 5-10 levels a day. You're severely penalized if your team doesn't meet the Recommended Combat Power of an encounter, something like a 25% stat loss if you're even 1 point below recommended, reportedly scaling to 90% if you're at half. Stages are either impossible to beat or impossibly easy. This is not good game design.

Surprisingly not bad. The ecchi art direction is definitely the obvious thing you notice but this is a well made gacha game. It has simple yet satisfying combat, decent dystopian sci-fi story, there is no wonder they did a collab with Nier: Automata. The graphics are also good. I wasn't expecting to praise a mobile gacha game on audio but both the OST and Japanese dub are top notch. I find it super satisfying unlocking new music tracks. One suggestion I have is allow quick battle in campaign.

After 6 months of playing i can assure that this game doesn't deserve neither your time nor your money, there are a myriad of problems, terrible monetization with overpriced skins and packs, game progression slow and characters skill can almost only be leveled up by spending money, an absurd amount of bug that have been there since launch and characters kit that never worked as intended and many more problems but at the end of the day all these problems can be summed up with just 1 word: Tencent

The system errors and other errors popping up, even without doing anything caused you to return to login screen which in turn may cause more system errors which will cause you to be in a loop of encountering error and back to login screen unless you restart the game completely. Why would an error message popping up be able to send you back to login screen? The game only load after server selection is kind of stupid for how long it takes to load. Why not have the game load completely then choose?

Great art and character design. Doesn't hide its sauciness at all. BGM and VO slaps consistently. Battle mechanics are pretty fun, and squad creation takes some thought. Some technical difficulties remain and levelling up seems kinda grindy, so four stars. Nonetheless , so far (post ch. 2) quite enjoyable.

Game wise not too bad story is okay got up to almost endgame ish but tbh price is a bit harsh but still playable but the most fed up problem about this game is it's customer service. I have purchased a 40dollar-ish battlepass and somehow got an error not able to obtain the premium awards and filed a ticket to the customer service center. I sent them evidence but keep getting replies 'that they are on it' but been on this problem for almost over 3 weeks, what a service.

I had this at 1☆ for the CN benefits but they have pretty much added the important stuff for now so I'll give it a fair review. I do very much enjoy this game(I've logged on everyday since I started it a bit over 2 years ago). The characters are the biggest reason I play it and love it, same with the story although I have seen the story be a bit wonky moreso lately, especially since the 2.5th anniversary. There is more I would talk about but play store only has a 500 letter limit so that's that.

Gameplay is fantastic. Story is quite good too. Other mode is good too. Overall the game is good but the system sucks. Wonder who maintaining the game balance. why should i get 25% cut if i don't have the recommend power. And why can't i level up the char i love and worked hard to pull?? Totally ruined the experience. Plz fix it. Remove the limit cap

The gameplay can get challenging if you want it to, but otherwise a very simple and interesting gacha game. Probably not for everybody but credit where credit is due, they put a lot of effort into the events, character and visuals of this game. However I feel the core gameplay alone is not super enticing.

Gameplay: Addicting action shooting and if you suck at shooting (like me) there's aim bot Graphics: Stunning and filled with plot (IYKYK) Only one complaint, from time to time the game freezes at the end of a mission. Fortunately it does not happen often but I hope it gets fixed soon.

If you think this game is all about Waifus, you're wrong. This game is one of the innovative TPS that I've played. Fun, Exciting and Beautiful art! Yes, this game does have some bugs, but I understand because it's us that requested the dev to release it ASAP. Overall, its a very fun game to play. I'm hooked. However, we do expect more improvisation from dev over time. thanks for the game

LVL 160 wall is ridiculously insane and for that reason I'm dropping the game. However the gameplay is pretty good, fun and entertaining. The art is nice and feels polished. The app runs pretty well with some hiccups. But the gacha is too little. I've been stuck on 3 3-rank SSR units for several weeks now. I give up.

This is by far the best gacha game I ever played, and I played quite the few gacha games I just love the mechanics, the sound tracks, boss fights, story, everything and it is fairly difficult not like games where u can ace in few weeks of play no u need time and effort and the process you take to make this time and effort to Improve yourself and your team is quite enjoyable (at the start it can get quite repatitve when you reach highest difficulty in dailies) so the game deserves 5stars

I really love this game. The quality of the game, the graphics, and the way you can advise your own Nikkes are really good. Then, the main story of the campaign, the cut scenes, and their voices are really interesting, and being the Commander(us) of our Nikkes as we are trying to reclaim the surface from the Raptures and they're Queen is very interesting ,and the mini stories in the Outpost(IDK if they're mini stories or mini scenes) are really good. I want to wake up as a Commander of my Nikkes

If the game had told me, that it would artificially downgrade the power of your team, because your team does not meet the required powerlevel, just to create a feeling for the need of spending money, i would not have started the game at all. I have no problem, to spend money on games, but this prevents any strategic combination and makes the game a number comparism programm. Furthermore, the game is so buggy, constantly disconnecting, skill description does not fit the actual effects etc.

Been playing since start until now, unfortunately there is so much bugs in this Half-Anniversary update. Please fix it as soon as possible. I cant even access SP Arena, the loading takes forever i had to restart the game just to find the same problem. Also loading at starting game is unbearably longer than usual. Will return the 5 star after the fix, thanks in advance.

It's not that bad on what the other reviews are trying to portray, the game is the same trope of commander ( you the player) where you command a group/harem of girls into battle kind of niche. The only difference is the game characters are very catered towards the male audience where the gacha characters wear very sexy and hot outfits for you to collect and admire, best part is the game is on vertical screen, meaning you only need one hand to play this game 😉

Really cool character designs, unique game play (for a gacha), high production values for story mode and all of this ruined by monetization model. Prices are ridiculous,for a single character skin you could get a full aaa game on steam. Even normal gameplay progression rewards are locked behind expensive passes. I won't say stay away, try it but beware of greed.

This is my first time downloading and playing, and so far the story is really good. And at the first our of gameplay had me in the feels, hope that there will be more content on this game, the reviews from the past kept the game to improve there short comings and that I hope that others will not criticize this just because of negative comments from the past. This journey with Nikke will certainly be a wonderful experience.

Game is good, BUT Performance is really bad. Dev really needs to figure out how to make performance better. I play the game without any apps running every tim and on Samsung S21+ with lots of free memory space its still heat out quick and loading time between screens are not efficient... this certainly a performance issue as no problem when playing in PC

While the games story is interesting, the extremely poor rates (which seem to be below listed) and punishing reward system generally leave you feeling disappointed. There are multi-month grind activities, which instead of feeling rewarding to complete, are usually an empty time sink almost guaranteed to provide nothing of value for your efforts. Combined with poor rates, the outlandish costs of in game purchases is comparable to burning your money in the hopes of a return on investment.

(Edit) Love the rare gameplay and the story (and the girls), really! But there is some CONS: NO daily free draw, NO pity feature, LOW SSR rate feels although 2%-4%, HARD to get the girl you want, Some SSR girl feels like SR quality, POWER CREEP for some bosses/missions, CRASH happen likely on some occasions/scenarios (really annoying). I was hoping they coud be more generous like similar (grinding feat) other games, but no. This game has potential, but again, it ruined by marketing side. Shame.

The game hasn't changed since launch, it's getting stale, old and boring. It lacks of interactions with nikkes, new modes and generally the game needs an update UI wise. Shiftup thinks they got the perfect formula for the game, but releasing useless characters every 2 weeks not gonna cut it, people will eventually quit. Even the main story is becoming boring and cliché, with many subplots unresolved.

I love the game, but the auto aim doesn't prioritize on the main objective targets like bosses so its kinda hard to progress to the storyline even if your cp is higher than the enemy, due to lack of target priorities and the enemies durability the timer quickly catch up to you and at the same time the nikkes still got a full health so yeah my main problem here is the timer and the auto aim priorities..

I like concept and the gameplay. However, the bugs of characters skills, difficulties of main story missions, the censored version artworks and bad gacha rate. I cannot recommend this game to any F2P player. You will need to put so much money or wait a weeks or months to progress just a little further in late game.

It's start with looking good game that should be fun to play and enjoy then go down very hard with spike power scaling. The problem is that too much for normal difficult content. Player should complete content at least main story content without too much effort. This game every progress lock if you don't lucky enough to get good character to brute force it. I know game should be challenge, but not fair is not the same as challenge. Please make the game more playable and enjoyable for everyone.

The game is excellent! My only problem is that, it lags in some certain areas and can you just add landscape mode feature. That's really my main problem right now, cuz I really can't see fully in battle where ex stage boss missile going to hit my nikke during my fight in ex stage. and and really lags so much during in battle cuz (probably) I have low end phone, even in the lowest settings still lags. Please fix this issue soon.

Great casual game, a lot of casual events, will take time to progress not suitable for impatient people, attractive characters, 'great' angles, mild jokes in story, great music. Now, one thing I find it annoying is that in lobby, the chat bubble is blocking your characters when they talked, maybe let me move it away, or allow me to turn it off without hiding the whole inferface. Will appreciate this.

Surprisingly? Not as bad of a game as common media portrays it. This game is pretty lively. It has an apocalyptic-ish setting, but personally I don't think they really nailed that one well aside from main missions. The elephant in the room with this game is the JIGGLE PHYSICS. It's actually not as distracting as anyone says it is, since you're focused on aiming instead of the "posteriors". Only complaint is how it's MOSTLY in portrait. Horrid stretching when used in landscape. 8/10, gacha is ok

The gameplay is very easy to understand. The story and music are a high point imo. The visuals... Could look better sometimes. It's not bad, but I KNOW they can be better. Especially for older characters. But this game really gave me confidence that the developers care and will deliver. Oh yeah, and it runs VERY smoothly.

Good game and haven't found any game-breaking bugs so far, although there are quite a lot of UI bugs here and there. Please fix the UI because it makes exploring the lobby quite stressful because I have to click all the red dots everytime I log in the game. These notifs should only pop up at least once a day or every daily reset.

Characters are pretty nice and gorgeous. Gameplay is OK and developer team has made great improvements in stabilizing game. One of the big cons is how time wasteful some events are. For passed challenges, you still need to play them on follow up attempts, there's no quick play like for event or interdiction missions. Finally, recruiting rates are abyssmal and the way manufacturer molds (loot from towers) work is honestly absurd.

feels like the game was rushed to released. Tons of bugs that need to be fixed and what's more disappointing is in some scenario doesn't have VA. Kinda sad about the music because you got pretty chill music in lobby and outpost, but when you go to battle it just makes you want to have dedicated button to turn off music lol. Expectations we're high cause i used to play a lot of Destiny Child. Overall it's still a good idle game.

The only thing that's frustrating me is that after we killed the STAGE BOSS it will pop up " Failed to sync battle information " ( I dunno the full text ) then we can't proceed to the next stage since we didn't completed it so, we go back to fight again and it's irritating. I hope you will fix this error since it's disrupting my play and BTW OVERALL THIS IS GOOD GAME because of some error or bug I give it 4 star

Have been playing since day one, i like the designs, characters, architectural sceneries, and art style. The story and plot are very well made, it can make you sad, laugh and even cry. Overall superb. The only thing is some parts are difficult and incapable for phone. That is why i switch on PC Version.

Good design, but the most horrendous gameplay to exist. The concept is there but it is so executed poorly that I outright ragequit the game. There is no reason to manually control your characters when Auto is 3 million times better than you could ever be. The only thing that you need to control at that point is the skills and even then it's only pressing 3 buttons and aiming if it's a skillshot. Not to mention the fact there are many instances where I literally couldn't see the enemies.

I love this game! I've played this game for months and so far here's what I thought: The game let's you play automatic and manual, letting you breeze through basic necessities like dailies and stuff while giving enough challenge while dealing with harder maps. The growth system is great. You could grow almost at anything you do! The gacha rate is generous and the mods are even more whenever there's events! The most generous out of the top rating gacha games out there!

The game is great from soundtracks, graphics, story depth and personality of each Nikke. The flaw lies on the game itself, often times the sound breaks for some reason and is observed over multiple device I use. And the loading of each and every screen, fights and scenes needs to be optimized and shouldn't take 8-15 seconds to load. Given that I experience this both on PC and Mobile.

The rates of recruitment is absurdly low. The cash shop is over priced and is not that rewarding. Game loads so slowly even on my pc with RTX 3080. Events are boring, the progress of the game is very slow. I'm only enjoying the story but now I'm stuck at chapter 17 because the Limit breaks takes a long time and is based purely on RNG. Might drop the game after a week or so.

Optimise this game. Even my 12gb RAM samsung couldn't take it smoothly. Internet is not an issue anymore. I'm sure my Internet connection is good. Sometimes the game just froze when i finished my mission and when i reopened the game, i have to do it again because it didn't count. Doing this again and again because it always freeze is tiring and kinda piss me off.

Good work devs. Absolutely love the game the art style,the gacha system,the story,characters,and most of all the story line. but the thing that outshine everything the most is some the characters moe gap. not a rant but a suggestion i would love if you add a landscape option cause im not used to playing on portrait mode.

This is game is nice the characters are nice too but on some of the phones you have to reduce the graphics details or the skip the cutscenes or even to do both in some cases which is a bit disappointing but overall it's a good game , so keep up the good work hopefully more good stuff will come in the nearest future.

The game is good, but holy hell its badly optimized. For an example i have a better frame playing a game with "impact" in its last name compared to this game. Not to mention how it heats up your phone too, and something that i suspect as a memory leak because my 6gb ram/128gb storage apparently cant stop the game from crashing.

Honestly I really enjoy playing this game. I hope that they also have a better way to get the items needed for favourite items. Overall the game is fun though it can get a bit grindy when you hit a certain point in the game (would say around mid chapter 20's).

The game itself is fun in aspect of story and graphics, however my only issue is that i keep getting character Data error or system error, which becomes a pain when the game starts to auto-reload itself as well loading time when going to an area that you were just booted from. On another note, i keep getting notifications for events and mail when there's nothing, so that to is a hassle in itself going to another menu and finding nothing.

I love the game, but my issue is contact support. The response time is awful, and that's if they respond. There is no indication that a response was sent or a time frame. I've had two technical issues since Aug 4 and no resolution. I reached out on fb, ig, and the online site, only to be ignored.

System error can't get inside the game. I played Tutorial, claimed email rewards and did gacha. And i want to try looking at the in full HD, so i changed the Graphic to full right. BUT, this game forced me to restart the game to apply the graphic change unlike most other game i played. And now i can't get inside the game anymore. I keep getting "System Error" at 10/10 loading bar. Please add "Setting" button on login page too ! I can play again now.

It is a good game. The only thing that this game is lacking is that it is buggy, bad looking user interface(ui) and their loading screen takes too long. But, all in all. I like it and I will rate it as a 5 if they fix the bugs in the game. Recommended game if you like shooting games and gachas.

The game is currently being left behind by the devs as they are currently focusing on the cn release of the game. Most aspects such as optimization and stability which have plagued the global release have been resolved only for cn release. and certain characters received much needed improvement in combat only for cn release. also higher guaranteed rates for cn only Given the current status, i dont recommend joining in as this game is starting to lose its focus and goal.

Joined for the event, grinding for pulls, turns out its either bugged or impossible to pull characters features despite them having 10 times the drop rate of other ssr characters, you just get dozens of the much lower drop rate characters. Very frequent crashes, blurry graphics, im not sure why this game is popular? It looks and feels like a run of the mill cash grab clone of other games that are usually in "open beta"

Decent game with not too many remaining bugs. The massive downside is that either their netcode, anti cheat, server or something else related to it is absolute garbage and will drop you constantly forcing it to return you to the main screen and you have reload the page you wanted to do things in, if this happens at the end of a battle you have to replay the battle. This can happen dozens of times in a row for the simplest things and PC is just as bad Updating to 1* because CS is also useless

Been playing since launch and all i can say is that it still didn't disappoint me. Even though there were several bugs during launch, it seems all of it have been resolved. Every update have been exciting . The character design of every character is unique and also very good. The gameplay is actually fun and different from other gacha games. The most surprising part of the game is the story. Although at first it seems to be a guilty pleasure games but its actually have a very well written story.

Great gameplay and character design. But the amount of bugs in this game is ridiculous which are still not fixed even till this date. And the amount of gems given for this game shows how stingy this game is. Examples like completing stage 13 gives u only 10 gems which is not even enough for a single roll & u need 3000 gems to do a 10 roll. A pity for this game as it got ruined not by the gameplay but the greedy publishers.

Everything's great but the landscape mode is bugging me sm, the icons and letters are so tiny I can barely see especially because I have poor eyesight, wish the devs make it a bit more readable. I'm enjoying it so far but it's quite a learning curve at least for me. I also like how the player is referred as "they" bc it's not just men that plays the game, that dumbass in the reviews here doesn't seem to get that lol. Though I wish the anime cutscene made our character just a white shadow.

Animations are smooth, gameplay is fun and the plot is interesting, overall this is what made me first rate 4 when I installed. Now I see the cracks. There are unfair jumps in Battle Level required: 1 minute you're enjoying the story, the 2nd minute you're stuck for days. There is no in-between. In the meantime you costantly get reminded that paying can carry you. Dont wanna wait? Pay. Need good units? Pay. After chap 13 you get NO GEMS for wins and you slowly get deprived of all rewards. a fantastic game with good story, stayed for the development of the history and the events. Gonna keep playing for a long time. Keep it up! Keep getting " System Error" and "Unable to sync up information"...game run smooth at high setting with 60fps, surely not because of my phone. \\EDITED// After maintenance it's seems like all the problems were fixed. Heads up to the Devs for paying attention to the Commanders complaints.

Great animations. Story is a just fantastic. Gameplay can be engaging at times. NO ADS!!! (no way!!!) In app purchases can me pricey tho. The characters are all very well written and designed. Only issue: I'm not playing this in public... ps: contains gacha gamba.
