Will have to see how f2p friendly it is on the long run but for now there's no lack of rewards for playing. Overall worth a try at least.

As someone who only plays 2 other idle gacha games, I really enjoy this one. I'm taking it slow, currently at chapter 3, and I'm really liking the story, mechanics, and all the characters. The music and voice acting is fantastic, especially the Korean voice actresses, they do a great job. I recently upped the stars on my review because they recently fixed a lot of issues, and I hope they continue to monitor these issues to continue making the game better.

I'm a bit surprised by other user ratings, for me this is one of the best rpg games. I do not deny that sometimes this game has errors like the fps drops, crashes, lags, and sometimes my phone screen is even black and the game will exit by itself. But it's not a big problem because I'm pretty sure that this game will grow and become better from time to time.So keep the spirit of NIKKE STUDIO. I wish you the best and thank you very much❤️. btw I've been playing this game since it was released👍😀

It's a cool game the game is pretty enjoyable. Good graphics, the way to earn gems has gotten alot easier than at first, alot of voice lines which is cool and new costumes for them. But the costumes are 20 bucks But the SSR nikkes drop rate feels its extremely low. I don't reccomend wasting your time on tribe towers for those special gems, you'll have to earn 50 gems to recruit a certain nikke class but you'll end up getting a regular nikke, which keep in mind take weeks or even a month to earn

Seen an ad for this game, and figured it another joke ad because many games on mobile make false ads. Not a problem with this one. The ad was actually the gameplay and I love it! There's some time gates for some of the smaller fun interactions with you Nikkes but I really do like this game!

Almost at the 1 year anniversary and my take is: The BAD: EXPENSIVE. Devs runs limited banners every other month it seems and they run limited costume banners ($60 if you dont get it until the last roll) every 3 or so months. They also do monthly and occasional event passes that run $20 each. Game is NOT free to play friendly and unfortunately you need to get quite a few duplicates to progress into the game. The Good: Story is good and interesting with voice work. Not sure if it's worth it.

Have to edit my original review. They switched to a new login system which didn't work too well with FB. Almost lost a high level account that I'd spent over 50 bucks on. Luckily I was finally able to log in after missing 4 days. I submitted a ticket but no one ever got to it...had to figure it out on my own. Fantastic game, but bad support team as my ticket never got addressed after 5 days.

So I've been playing for like 2 and 1/2 months, story is good and gameplay is good, only issue is the massive pay wall you hit, you gotta either keep playing for I can only guess a year or so to pass it or start paying heaps. I already paid but it won't cover it. So ok game if you're willing to spend hundreds on it (I've spent 50-100 AUD) edit for below: it's not pay 2 play if you're ok with doing daily nothing for a whole year before you can progress with the story

Despite its look, Nikke is actually a lot of fun! It's well put together, though there are a few bugs. The story and charters are well thought out and it's just a fun game. But my biggest issues are the wait time, it's not an enrghy system like other games. It's leveling your charters against the emmines. It's takes too long just to get one or two levels for one Nikke, if that could be sped up a bit that will fix it easy. Also 40 dollers for a ten pull is just crazy. Good game needs some work.

Probably one of the most unique gameplay you'll experience with these types of Gacha games. It's pretty much a modern version of Space Invaders but they executed it so well that as soon as the intro mission loaded up, I was hooked. Each character feels a lot more fleshed out than other games of this genre, later on you can have individual stories/dates with them that it becomes a mini life/love sim. It's free, just try it out, and yes there's auto battle after the tutorial, if you're wondering.

so far, the story and voice acting are pretty good. i haven't felt like I'm forced to buy anything with real money. there is a grind, but so far, it's not too bad. still getting new nikke shards is pretty slow. Edit: I'm far in the game now, and I'm beginning to hit a paywall to get body tokens for ssr nikkes. The Pvp section is definitely p2w. The story is still pretty good as well the individual nikke stories.

I had hope for this game. If it was actually able to run and not charging stupid amounts of $ to play, then it would be one of the best. But so far, it should still be in Alpha stages with the amount of game breaking bugs, lack of optimisation, and crashes.

It's surprisingly good. I know what it looks like from the outside with all the... jiggle physics, but there's quite a lot of depth to both the story and the game. More than I was ready for at least. The actual gameplay is just interactive enough that it's still fun to engage and take the reins rather than just putting on the autopilot. A solid gacha to sink some free time into.

Hi, can you please change the age rating from 12+ to 16+ or better yet 18+? Because theres a lot of thing on this game that I don't think a 12 year old should see, Thank you. I know what I'm talking about because I was there when this game had it's 1st anniversary

not sure what's going on, but as of today, I try to get in the game, but at main menu before logging in it says game needs an update and to go google playstore to update, so I do, and upon arriving here it says to play the game, and that there's no update needed. and this process repeats, try to get in, get update, no update exists, go into game, it's acting as if the update doesn't exist even though it says to go to store to update it. storyline and characteristic quite good, but there are too many bug and lag in this game, freeze at simulation room, force quit at event interface, not response to any click at outpost...etc, and the SSR rate are way too low, other banner keep pull out the thing i don't mark in my 15 whistlist, i don't think that's coincidence.

The game is tame, do not play if you are looking for an real gooner game. Shift Up has censored many outfits and they favor the CN version of the game with exclusive characters and an interaction mode. They put cloth on characters to keep the low age rating. Their communication with the fan base is horrible & haven't added a new game mode for years. The game is now mainstream & they go for safe collabs & appeal to "global audience". Their greed is insane with gacha skins & paid minigame content.

A fully fledged game with plenty to do. There are multiple avenues to joyfully sink time into. The visuals are striking and the soundtrack amazing. Fantastic story with an immediate hook. Honestly feels more like a console game rather than a mobile one.

I'm enjoying the game so far, however, with the new update, it constantly gives system errors and forces a restart. It happens on missions, collecting rewards and events and even when leveling up characters. Please, patch the issues.

Uninstalling because every time one of the ads for it comes up, trying to close it launches the game. Beyond that, it was your standard gacha fare, breasts, guns, a wildly unintuitive UI it's nearly a menu simulator. The combat mechanics were at least fresh and unique, but overly involved for a mobile game like this. Almost better suited for an arcade cabinet.

At first I thought this game was just going to be a fanservice advertisement with Mediocre game play or just click bait, BUT I stand corrected from the graphics to the lore even the gameplay, it is all fantastic. I've loved every minute of the game, plus it's free to play friendly. Unlike other gotchas the system seems to be balanced, and I've already managed to get a lot of ssr characters. Top marks in my book, highly recommend!!

Its a fun game but you need to manage your resources well or else you're stuck. good thing the game lets you subvert that using a mechanic in-game. One of the downsides is that some stages are a bit too hard for casual players and sadly they won't be able to complete them. Another is its pity system, I don't really understand the wishlist system.

Lost my account, I haven't played this game for a year now because I lost my account. What happened was I was participating in an event (Little mermaid's story) and I was pulling for her, right after I got her my acc vanished the next day, I tried searching for it by logging into all of my google accounts and Facebook account but to no avail, it's really unfortunate because i spent a good time Playing that game I had great characters like Cinderella and Biscuit, I want my account back.

Devs don't want to fix the issue on Snapdragon 8 gen 3 devices. Game crashes constantly. Before it used to be only twice per day. Now, I can't even do my dailies before the game crashes over 5-6 times. It's ridiculous. Other games already fixed the issue so I don't know what's taking them so long.

Good Game, but lack of event and so many error. i hope many events come when this game release but is not. i want to tell you, that first login is so annoying it's so long and that regional choose box always appear. When i want to recruit character an error appear and my game restart.

Final thoughts, game is good, the progression needs some work, its hard to progress in some situations, upgrading characters has many factors both with benefits but also down sides, for one you need the upgrade the character with a copy to increase the stats of the character, getting one is hard enough imagine getting a copy. This game is also expensive and still has issues too.

I appreciate the fast-paced gameplay, the story, and the wonderful music. However, I do think that charging $19.99 upfront for a single costume is preposterous. A lower price, or at least having the option to pay for costumes with gems instead would've been better.

My first mobile game experience and I'm pleasantly surprised, it's obvious there's been alot of effort put into character design, voice acting and especially the OST. Natural progression hasn't been an issue for me at all and there's been plenty of updates and new events happening.

it's an amazing game. 10/10. I only rate it 4 stars because it keeps closing the game at random points. Also, I spend so much time and effort getting molds, and 80% of the time I get Rares. the blue rank. I do wish the odds were better.

Actually want to give 5 star reviews, but because of bugs that I found in the game, I decided not to. Especially about Mirror Container as level 32 boss which is supermassive bugs, because I can't even break the body part (Glass Slippers) that is protected by a ridiculously impenetrable shield. Therefore, unless you give us an explanation and fix it, this will be 4 star for me.

Landscape mode was added! Could you please fix the UI being super small in landscape mode, or add the ability for us to adjust the UI scaling ourselves? Thank you for listening to the community and working so hard! My last gripes with the game is that gacha rates are still quite low compared to other games. Cash store prices are also too high to be worth buying for anyone other than a whale.

downloaded it as soon as i could and was not disappointed. well worth the wait! the dialogue is great, the characters personalities are funny and the gameplay!! so fun! i like that you can switch between different gun types to suit your situation or just stick to one type and go wild! glad to see a game this unique get a lot of attention!

Graphically demanding shooter on a phone. Bought a gaming phone a year ago and this is the first game that truly taxes/makes use of all this power. There is tons of story in this character collector/gacha game. Doesn't seem to punish F2P players. Obviously micro transactions make it easier to get good characters, but it's certainly playable and enjoyable enough even as a F2P.

The multiplayer event has bugs it disconnects players. The infrastructure core has bugs it has notifications but nothing's happening there when you go in it. I don't know if itson purpose but the pilgrims have low rate chance or just ssr even. Please don't make this game like FGO 2019 that we barely have any chance of getting a good character even with all the gems spent.

Love the game. I've been on the lookout for games like this while waiting for the game to release. I'm not disappointed in the slightest. The only reason I'm writing this comment is to recommend an idea. It would be wonderful if we could replay boss battles (with no rewards or costs) in the 'recollection' tab in the Command Center. It's really sad to see the wonderful BGM and boss battles go to waste as a one time experience.

Obviously the game still need some improvements and optimisations but its going in the right way toward the standard of a mobile gacha game. Cannot give 5 stars though, the pricing is the big problem here: I feel like the battlepass and other things are way overpriced for what it's worth. And in all of that is a bit of my own disapointment, having played CBT2, the game had less bug and lag than what we got at launch, it's crazy how many bugs we got in a such a short time

The ads make this game look like total trash sometimes lmao but it's genuinely so good. Haven't been this hooked by a mobile game story in a LONG time. So many characters are so well written and so fun to see develop throughout the stories. Fascinating how much depth the writing has. I don't even like shooters. I love it.

I've been playing this since it was still in beta, and it's been awesome to see it grow since then. I love how you can decide how much you want to get involved in the gameplay, and it doesn't affect how much the storyline sucks you in. The Nikkes are on point as well, being almost collectable and endlessly upgradeable, and the limited collaborations make them just that much more sought after. Plus, they're frickin HOT! 🥵 Can't wait to see where this goes, HIGHLY RECOMMENDED!

I just downloaded the game and I was able to play it. But the constant freezes, the constant game crashes, it's just getting ridiculous. Then, as soon as I change the lobby character, the game crashes and everytime I login, it constantly crashes to the point I can't even play the game anymore. I'd give it more stars, but until this issue is fixed for Android Galaxy, I'm leaving this at 1 star and I'm uninstalling this game.

Very large file size for the game. 1gig+ updates take 5 plus minutes Very expensive and slow to recruit new characters. Small pool of basic characters. Game could be fun, but you run in a difficulty wall very quickly. Not many options to grind for leveling materials.

Horrendous aiming system and terrible gameplay. Gets old and boring after the first few missions. The opening dialog is so cringe. Crashes after completing a mission, did developers not QA this before release? I guess the visuals are decent at best if I can say one positive thing. What the hell happened to game studios that actually take pride in their work? Avoid this game if you take gaming even remotely seriously.

I love the game, but there seems to be a problem with the daily missions. Sometimes it won't register as completed. For example one of the daily missions are you need to upgrade an equipment, but after you upgraded an equipment it won't register as completed in the daily missions menu. Can you guys please fix this as soon as possible?

I've waited for the game's Release and no doubt one of my favorite game. The arcade Portrait style gampley really Hits the spots because i've play arcade Shooters, the story is good, tutorial is easy to understand and The "Fanservice" is the cherry on top overall, the game was good. Although There are some bugs there that i haven't seen for now but am hoping if there is any it can be fixed right on time.

Honestly you have a very good game. Good story great mechanics and...tasteful characters. The only things I would hope to see in the future is to be able to get gems faster and usbs. That's really it also there is a glitch when you are going to the next stage the button to go to the next stage doesn't work so your just stuck there besides that great amazing game even. But I feel like the luck in the draws are definitely against you not in your favor. I had went 15 draws and still no character.

Actually I am planning to rate this 5stars, this game overall good but the updates became more frequent which is kinda down side because my phone is low end and just a budget phone. Around 2021-2022 it isn't like this before, the updates are usually 2-3months gap before the update. This makes the game more demanding in terms of stroage and battery life. Another thing is i recommend you need to add more graphics options for gamers like me.

Auto mode helps me so I can play even when my carpel tunnel acts up!! PC version is just as amazing and allows me to play truly whenever- graphics, accessibility, and fairness with character pulls and prices are perfect for me and I couldn't ask for more!! I look forward to future updates!!

Very astonishing artwork, the graphics are mindblowing and the story is very interesting. I highly reccomend playing this game for those that are interested to Action and sci-fi. 9.5/10 since there are still some issues but I consider it because it's just a newly released game and by the way, the game is for 18+ only

A fun game with fun mechanics great graphics and characters. The strategy factor isn't really important at the beginning, but the bosses and EX stages really need you to think about the best team combination based on skills and abilities and that's really fun. But, the leveling process can come to a really sudden wall making it look like you need to pay (to recruit characters) in order to surpass the level cap. That or be really patient and hope for the best gacha luck during your free rolls.

I love the game but the combat gets a little stale and I wish there was more animated scenes in the story, aside from that definitely one of if not the best mobile games I've played, also, the soundtrack is really good and they have a lot of really really good voice actors, they literally have 2 of my favorite vas of all time here

Game has improved a whole lot from launch. Weekly events monthly events! Game is funner all around. However in terms of combat modulars/credits from your Outpost. Still is not enough if you have five-gold characters all three stars. Trying to level them above level 180+ the max level is 200. I have to either waste money on diamonds which I'm a free to play player. Not a pay to win. So for someone like me I have to go three days saving up to upgrade one character! by 2 or 3 lvl.

I taking back every good thing I said before this game is just unplayable right now after this new update brought so many bugs even cyberpunk didn't had this many bugs I pulled for character and the game just wished to cause a " error during purchase" and restated it self and lost my pulls. And about the sudden crashes during gameplay 😩 I gave it a 4 star before but after this new update i give it a 1 star . I am really disappointed in this game it had a lot of potential but alas

It doesn't overload your brain with "prices" and I would like if they gave you another chance at the monthly pass. when you fail the monthly pass. I bought it at the beginning and wasn't able to finish it due to time and you have to play everyday to level up. Beside that it a well design game to play and keep coming back to each week.

I'm not sure why I can't get into the Outpost. I can't progress the story without going there first, but I waited five minutes on the loading screen with no results. Every other aspect of the game works just fine up to that point. If an update can fix the loading issue, I'll be happy to up my review. Edit: It wasn't an update that fixed it. Either it was brute forced or my game glitched slightly allowing me to enter the Outpost. I did the update after that and everything works fine now.

This is a great game and I'm a good portion of the way through so far. Here's a quick pros and cons: Pros: Good gameplay. Fantastic character designs, very great opening experiences (Common in gachas, and this slides off over time). Exploration is very satisfying. Cons: The single worst monetization I've seen in a gacha game. No pity and very bad rates. Parts of progression are locked off from obtaining specific characters for enhancing outpost. Very buggy, will improve over time.

Fun game so far, enjoying all of its ASSets. Main story is engaging, and gameplay has good mechanics, and various modes. It's not too difficult to progress, even if you face a wall, usually just need to level up a bit, and can go through most of the game with only tutorial SSR. There are some bugs here and there, but devs working on the fixes. If you are thinking about giving this game a go, it is definitely worth a try.

It's a really good game with a really good story, Very likeable characters and the art Is great, I guess the only problem I have with this game is how long it takes to level up characters especially as a F2P and It doesn't help the level cap just keeps increasing and you only have to level ssr characters beyond level 160 (and 6 at that mind you) which takes so much resources than SRs... At least this game shoulda letted us have the SR copies max at 200 rather than 160.

Thank you for the opportunity to give you over 150 € for 2 costumes during the 1.5 anniversary, truly something you were looking forward to! I hope next time, at 2nd anni, we get to give you 300 € for 4 costumes! This display of generousity can only be overshadowed by your greed and arrogance after all. I really want to like this game. Graphics are good, characters are beautiful, but the gameplay gets booooooring after 3 weeks. The battles are the same over and over, and there is very little strategy. Maybe it gets better as you level up, but I really don't see how. It's an afk game, so progress is taking forever. Also, the loading times are super, super slow, and frequent. Any time you press on something (which is all the time) it has to load. I just can't do it any more.. too boring and slow.

Really enjoying the game so far! Only issue is it keeps closing itself, quite often. Usually after it's been running for over an hour. But sometimes it won't even take that long. After it does it for the first time of the day the frequency increases.

Graphics are gorgeous and exactly what I've come to expect from Shift-up, but the game is still too early to tell how the experience truly ends up being. At the moment, not super f2p friendly and somewhat underwhelming, but we'll have to wait and see. Destiny Child set a high bar for me, definitely.

Sorry, but I unfortunately cannot recommend this game to others. Even though I am a returning player and also absolutely enjoying the story and the characters, the microtransactions feel awful and unbalanced, especially the recruitment system. It really frustrates and ruins your motivation to continue playing when saving up for 100s of pulls doesn't guarantee you the current event Pick Up Nikke, and this 1st Anniversary event is no different. Will edit rating when I no longer feel disappointed.

I adore this game, I've been playing every day for almost 5 months now and I'm thoroughly addicted. This has hands down the cutest and sexiest characters out of any game I've ever played, not only that but each character has lore that is enjoyable to learn! The story is brilliant in my opinion and the events are always super fun, especially with the unique mini games they release alongside some of the events. I will continue to be a commander and the 1st anniversary was special! Thank You Nikke!

The game starts off really fun it's showering you with resources and character pulls then it just drops off a cliff. I have been hard stuck at a level for 5 days... 5 goddang days cause the game gives me 1/10 the resources I need to level up each day. You can of course level up practically infinitely if you pay money with zero wait or delay. I've been playing games for 20 years and this is the most predatory one I've seen.

Pros: Lots to do, great graphics, unique and fun gameplay (even if you choose Auto during combat), great story so far, really enjoying the Nier Automata crossover event, really fun if you don't pressure yourself too much on collecting every character and metagaming, easily lose hours just doing daily tasks Cons: It's a gacha game - if you want to collect everyone asap then you have to spend money, one of the more expensive cash shops, character design may not be for everyone ;)

Everything is great. The combat mechanism is quite fun, characters live 2D are great. I wish there's some more frames between taking cover and attacking though, because it still looks like they blinked into attacking and taking cover without much movement. The story itself is pretty good, music also good. Pity system is kinda harsh, you need to have 200 mileages to buy them off the shop. Regardless I hope you guys can improve the game!

I have been playing this game for 6 months now. The 1st impression is all about character "appeal", the game play is auto most of the early, when come to late game and hard bosses manual is required to push through. The story of this game is extremely good, event story also really good highly recommend watching it "Miracle Snow is my recommendation for those who want to try". The game still need improvement in some activities. Overall one of the best game in mobile game genre.

Just can't with mobile anymore, any time the game updates even on wifi the game constantly crashes and I can't get any updates done, I'm stuck to playing PC if this is so memory heavy it's not good for a percentage of mobile players who can't download the game now. I've played since the game came out and I still thoroughly enjoy playing it to this day it reminds me of playing arcade games such as House Of The Dead way back, the story I wasn't expecting much initially but I have been pleseantly surpised how invested I was in it, and the art is great. It can be rough with the fomo on some of the banners however when events come around they still give more than alot of other gacha games I've seen and/or played. Overall love playing I say it's probably worth.

70% of the game's launch units (44/62) are SSR and they have a cumulative 4% (no pity) gacha rate. I've done the tutorial roll and 1 roll after and have every SR in the game except 1. If that's not a red flag nothing is. The gameplay is okay at best and the story is bad at best but it's fully voice acted so I give them a star for that. The graphics are a miss, I was expecting higher quality l2d the sprites look so bad on my galaxy s22 ultra, especially compared to counter:side.

I would love to play this game but when comes to download it always triggered error and to redownload from the start again. Also when it reached 50% download it pullback to 30% which is frustrating. I've been thoroughly enjoying my time playing this game. Unfortunately, I want Volumes because of her frontman mentality, but I'm just not pulling her. The pull rates, when we're talking about real money, are disappointing. I'm still enjoying it though.. which is a testament to the overall game. Plus.. anime babes with guns. What's not to love?

The game has some great voice actress both I'm Japanese and English The story at the beginning was what really got me addicted. The Nikkes are amazingly well drawn and so fund finding the right combos in PvP and PVE. You want a different game that it's not dependent on P2W this is the game. Thought being P2W helps but does not mean you know this game or be number 1 at it. It's done well where you need to know which burst 1 2 3 combos work best in different situation. The pulls are decent too.

Don't bother. The initial success is being ruined by a blatant approach to censor all the ASSets that people got drawn into. The game hates f2p players. Once you reach lvl 160 you'll need 5 SSR characters and 3 duplicates of each of them to progress further. Depending on your luck that's a paywall of at least a few hundred Euros. This paywall will block you for potentially years from ever progressing in the story or getting new characters you want. Shift up hasn't addressed this as of yet.

Love the game, but keeps saying that there's a update that needs to be done in the play store, and when I click 'Confirm' and it takes me to the store, there's no update. The game is good. It is pretty pervy, but honestly not bad. I play less than an hour a day. It has a lot of events, simple dailies, and features entertaining short battles that are easily completed using auto battle. If that's your thing, you'll like this.

After 2 months playing, I decide to change to a better review. This game in no doubt a gem with wonderful story and great musics. The story is mature enough and the characters' setting are "alive" and no cringe feelings with some characterisations. "Don't judge a book by its cover", the best quote for this game, the more I discover, the more treasure I found from Nikke. I'm looking forward for more interesting events and rewards (new album songs, new animations) from Nikke in the future.

Love the game and have been playing since day 1, but for the love of my Nikkes, PLEASE fix the crash issues for newer Galaxy phones! I currently run an s24 and I always have these random crashes mid battle that really hinder the enjoyment. Would be glad to give 5/5 if this wasn't an issue.

Can't login, when I turned the Graphics to Basic I restarted the Game and updated another 600 MB worth of files the next time I know is I couldn't even get into the game anymore, it's only stuck at 10/10 InitSuccess which took me a 1 hour of wait but still the I couldn't get into the game. Simple and fun gameplay loop. there are some tired gacha ways to pull money from the wallet but otherwise the game is pretty F2P friendly. characters are nice, designs vary and while it's somewhat lewd, it makes it back in the surprisingly well done storyline. give it a try, you might like it if you're a shooting gallery lover or perhaps just want to wittle time away talking to cute girls or your husband Andersen.

I want to give this game 5 stars but it takes so long to get to the fights. There's a lot of talking and boring mini-games in between fights. The art, fighter upgrades, item management, and team building are awesome. Everything else should be optional.

A 14 hour extended maintenance just for the Christmas update with overpriced outfits? Yeah no. The outfits are just lazy since the basic pose is the same, just with different clothes. Other games like Azur Lane have entirely new art, and added voice lines for new skins that cost less than what's being charged here. Tencent is going to kill this game.

So I love the gameplay and story of the game, however the lack of bug fixes, prioritizing new character releases over fixing the bugs and the censorship (please understand the censor isn't too much of a big hit for me but there are some that are just downright nonsensical). I honestly want to say this has to do with Tencent as we all know that Tencent is bottom of the barrel in terms of other mobile games they've published. The bugs, censorship and timing of backlash on data mining...no, just no

Tencent has started censoring characters after promising there wouldn't be censorship. They have also forced ShiftUp to make the game harder with more artificial roadblocks to encourage player spending. Not to mention the numerous bugs, which while they are being worked on, are literally game breaking and have taken too long to resolve.

Okay I think I'll just say mid for this one. It just came out so i expext there will be lots of updating and things later but i probably wont be back because i wasnt entertained by this type of game. I wont hold that against the rating though. It was fun for a bit all around but it gets to be quite repetitive the more you do anything in this game. It is not a pay to play, but it is a pay to interact for all the people that crave the extra bounce and jiggle the game offers
