Been playing this game from day 1. love it constantly updates and love from the dev's and good storyline and character. But I only have 1 issues is the flying shielded healer there shield I cant seem to get threw them normally one is ok 2 is a pain but doable and I'm fighting three now and I'm 40k some power over them and cant do it.

The game is pretty good quality for a gacha game. The story is amazing and gut wrenching, decently generous with rewards, the characters are good, an overall solid game. But one thing that bothers me a ton is the long startup time. It takes 2-3 minutes each time just for the game to load. It's been like this for a while and I don't remember this being an issue when I first started playing. And of course, being a F2P gacha, the monetization is kinda overpriced. For example, $20 limited outfits.

I have played this game every day since the start of September, so about 7 months now. I enjoy Nikke a lot and I won't be stopping any time soon! The stories and writing are really good, despite a few small English typos. The VAs are done well and there are many various personalities amongst the Nikkes as well. As far as I can see, it's not P2W unless you're doing PvP Arena. I've also never had any crashes or other technical issues - it plays flawlessly. Thank you for your hard work, Shift Up!

Great story, gameplay, and character designs. Progress does get tedious at around 160 and 180 but it's an idle game what do you expect. The free molds need to be reworked entirely. I have gotten more 5*s out of the 4* mold than the actual 5* molds. It's mind boggling.

Enjoyed the story. Gameplay was alright at best very boring after a while and only worth playing if your into the characters and gacha aspect. Did not save my progress even if I signed in with email and Facebook. For a gacha game you need to have a better way to save data because people are spending real money. just after 2 months of inactivey you will lose your account

Pros: Interesting story for a rpg, good quality animations, "engaging" characters, good voice acting for a mobile game, no grinding for resources Cons: Squad power must exceed the recommended level to beat the level or it will fail, game codes expire quickly due to mass redeeming (would be better if it was set to expire in a week instead of a redemption cap.)

there's a lot wrong with this game, but almost all are technical problems that can be fixed. "design changes" can't be fixed. push an update that fixes some bugs and introduces lag and stutter. radio silence for one week and shadow patch it later with no compensation. can't update the game without having it crash. I must install the entire application to update properly.

In my years as a gacha player, I have never played a game with this many crashes EVER. Trying to claim mail? Crash. Trying to recruit? Crash. Opening shop? Crash. Trying to load home screen? Crash again. Reloading into game after crashing? Another crash for you. And the worst part is the loading screen takes ages. And this is supposedly the more stable version since release. This is too stupid to be a stable release of the game. DO NOT PLAY until they fix the glaring issues.

Entertaining, lots to do early on without using in game purchases. Slows down a bit but advancement is straight forward with achievable goals. Gaining new characters is a bit hard due to some rng. But we all know you're here for the 'content'.

First impression is really good. There are several games with this gameplay, but this one is better in some aspects. The graphics are beautiful and the characters (nikke) are interesting imo. I don't know about the overall story yet, but in the beginning is good. Maybe I won't play this game for a long time because I'm more into mmorpg games, but this game is really worth a try 👍

It's just a waiting simulator. Every day you log in, find that you haven't waited long enough to clear the next 3-5 stages, then you log out. You have to wait for your daily chances to clear the event. Hell, you have to wait a week for the events' hard mode to unlock. Absolutely nothing is gratifying about this game because there is little to no strategy, you just wait until your power is higher than the recommended power and you win. Definitely the most boring game I've ever played.

This is the epitome of gacha garbage. Dozens of systems in place that all require real money to continue using, FOMO on event characters that will never appear again, season passes are $20 and they have multiple of them going at once, terrible rates for getting new characters. This game was built for whales, so unless you plan on dropping hundreds of dollars on this game to collect characters, expect to receive the same ones over and over again. This game preys on people with gambling problems.

Its a decent game , fun and visualy good. Saddly hitting the progression wall makes it unable to play for a long period of time. I dont see the fun in just playing to do daily to stack resources for a few minute and set the game aside for the next day. The fact that i want to play the game but theres nothing to grind to get pass the progression wall. Theres a few other things to do but once your unable to clear the content your basicaly just cant do anything...

Great art styles, playable both as a free game or for people who want to spent money. Special gotchas are on the verge of too often but most hit the general acquisition pool after their banner runs. There is an exception of "limited skin/alternate load out" gotchas these are (so far) limited to a single banner run and gone. Game Loop is solid and occasionally needs tactical thinking, story is pretty good, a little heavy on some tropes (looking at MC/Player responses especially) but entertaining.

Honestly I was skeptical at first when I saw this game in Japan but let me say it's one or the most fun phone games there is it's all I play anymore the daily stuff is the best and the events are always great this most recent first anniversary one was incredible having them voice the characters in the event story was awesome and some of the cut scenes I've seen are down right incredible if you like anime download this game you won't regret it

Though there is obvious eye candy appeal the game itself is fun to play and the interactions with the characters are enjoyable. The story is also excellent! Lots of different characters to choose from and it's not too difficult to recruit. Paying money is not an absolute necessity. The game is actually quite generous.

A great game with an amazing story. When I started playing it constantly crashed but I'm happy that the devs took care of the issue. The reason why I don't give it a 5 star is because of the system for farming resources. It's not really good especially when your progression in the story is overly dependent on the strength of your units.

The story and interactions have so much to offer! One of the most generous gacha games and one of the most continually entertaining and engaging mobile/live service games ever crafted. I have 95% of the Nikke I want and often get the new event Nikkes; be sure to complete the challenges, event content, and campaign and other modes. The Mileage ticket redemptions are awesome! I play on PC. Edit: Still love it! Don't play as much but it's always improving. 4 days/week. (March 2023 original review)

This game is honestly great and it's pretty fun but as for one problem, for some reason the Icon of the game aka app of it doesn't appear on my phone like other mobile games. I have to search the game up in the play store to play it I'm not sure if other people are having the same issue as me or if I'm the only one. Over all the game is honestly great 👍

It's a decent shooting style game, but aside from combat and clicking on the screen to move the story or tutotial forward don't expect to do anything else during the tutorials as they are quite literally a series of click here and we'll automate the ENTIRE process so you get to sit back and be bored out of you ever loving skull for 3 hours.

This game is amazing. It has great detail to chachter and the background of maps. They clearly have took note form the anime and manga of this. It also has great weapon play and bosses. Plus the voice actors are especially amazing in this game. If this would I would rate it a 100/100 amazing game. Also the story line is unique and on its own level plus the background chachter toom the art and music goes hard and I would like to shake the hand of the devs. I would like to see a few male people.

Make the story more choice-based if you're going to utilize the choice boxes. I don't really feel immersed, so if this game were to be linear, at least remove the dialogue or choice boxes. Otherwise, you can add choices to get a "say". But all in all, the game is good.

I really enjoy the game. The character, storyline and the VA is really good. But, I can rate 4 stars because I encountered some problem regarding the character's episode. The episode always stay on episode 1 eventhough I already viewed it. It keep showed 'system error' everytime I skipped the episode and brought me to home screen. I hope you guys can fix this problem.

this game is phenomenal! I really enjoy it. but still it have some annoying bugs occurring from time to time, like the game freezes after defeating a campaign stage. and the game keeps saying connection error when trying to finish a character story in command center then it will redirect me to the lobby. I hope this will be fix soon.

$20 outfits aren't acceptable no matter what. The canned response saying "but the game is free!" doesn't change anything and just displays that they are much more profit oriented than competitors like Blue Archive. I'm all for making enough to ensure the game can continue being made, but they are displaying that they don't want you to enjoy the game no matter what just enough to become a money dispenser for them. Very scummy outlook that shouldn't be rewarded. Spend your money elsewhere.

I have spent 800+ hours playing the game, and has bought at least one costume and several packs over the time I've played. I started during the 1st anniversary and never looked back. I truly love this game and the characters and stories in it. The QOL discrepancy between CN and all other servers is disheartening and disrespectful. I do not see this game in my future much longer without similar adjustments made for your existing, dedicated player base. Please do the right thing.

Definitely the best gacha shooter I've ever played, the anime cut scenes hits hard, the story was very entertaining and the expressions are shown well, but one of the best thing in this game are the music and OST of the game, you'd definitely want to download all the music in this game. 10/10 for storyline, cut scenes, music, lore, characters, everything

This is going to be one of my favorite gacha games. Very interesting gameplay, great storyline, high quality music, and of course, bouncy NIKKES. But there are some drawbacks, I understand this is a new game. Same as other problems, there is no information where we can get the materials. Bugs, Idk why after I entered advise menu, the VO changed from JP to EN. When I'm trying to enter Diesel's 2nd story, it says "A character data error occurred". But overall, good, I like the bo-.. the game.

Look, there is ingame transactions, but it's optional. Yes you can play F2P and be within top 10 in leader boards (people quit within 2- 4 weeks anyway). The game is entirely based on luck with the pull system. I've people put money into the game and still pull garbage. This game is really heavy on time consumption if this is not your thing, you can get by most of it with idling.

Going to echo pretty much every other review I've seen. The game basically crashes after a few seconds of logging into the game on mobile devices. I'm on Samsung Galaxy Note9 and it was just fine before the NIKKE x Nier collaboration event. Been having issues since. The game has a good soundtrack and gameplay otherwise. I'm hoping that this issue gets sorted as soon as possible so I can raise the rating.

The game is good, the characters as well, your gatcha system is normal, nothing different from others in my opinion, i like the game and i'm willing to keep playing it, just one thing and this a very personal opinion, i really hate Syuen, what frustrating character. Then again, i like the game and i'll keep playing for sure.

This game is consuming too much power. My phone always heats up aburptly whenever I play this game. I appreciate the effect, however, transitioning between outpost, lobby, surface, event, shop, even character is too long. I know that it has nice effect, but it drains too much power and storage. Perhaps dev can tone down some aspect like texture, or post processing effect, or some preload char database to smooth the experience.

Nice visuals and music, but when one gets past the loading screen...well...some low quality story writing, toy stores with teddy bears, girls with personalities that do not make any sense whatsoever (except Rappi and Anis maybe). My hopes of a decent postapocalyptic game went out of the window. The world map and the short cutscenes are a nice touch tho.

At the moment, the game is pretty interesting and fun, it projects a image to be F2P friendly aside of the fact of the micro transactions, so while that perception still there, the game will keep me trapped, graphics, story, characters and gameplay are simply super cool for a few minutes or a couple of hours sessions!

One of the best gacha game out there thanks to it character design and fan service!! The story are great aswell so far. But the price of costume are too expensive for what it give.. i really want to support the dev, and would like to buy costume to show my support. But fk, its soo expensive for just little change... But other than that, its perfect! Very f2p friendly too.

I've decided to edit my review of the game due to the recent patches and fixes. And I'm happy to say that they've finally fixed the crashes. Although there are still pently of sync issues such as after finishing a stage but those happen rarely and now I can actually play the game. Hopefully the developers will continue on patching the game.

Well. It is a good game, took me some time to understand how to play an de mechanic of the burst is pretty good, don't know any other game with that style of ulti, what I mean is that I'm glad of the way they put you in a situation that you have to use any type of nikke to use the max power of the squad Graphics: On point, I don't need more 4 stars because the game has some issues, errors in the outpost, sometimes the game doesn't start and sometimes screen goes black, and that sucks

i can say that the game was pretty good, characters was well designed, so do the events. the problem is the changing scene where from lobby to the outpost for an example, somtimes the music bugs out like glitching. i gave a solid 4 out of 5 star is because i introduce the game to my friend ad he likes it, which is good news.

Very deceptive practices. They have two sets of gem premium currencies. Both look identical, but the fine print on one says "free" and the other says "charge." Essentially they differentiate between gems earned through gameplay and gems bought with money. However, most of the packs, passes, etc that are paid for with real money only give you the "free" gems, and they don't make this obvious upfront. Many things are "charge" gems only. They have clearly done this deceptively.

Let's see the game in it self is good yes, and well that add look great. My only down side is that after patch/update is I can't even play or get past the login screen, and I wes hoping to play it more. Guess I'll have to wait until Infinite fix this problem. Over all the art work is good 👍 Infinite games please fix

The idea of the game isn't bad, but the main appeal for most of the players would be the fanservice offered. But with poor attempts of censorships it shows that they care more about money and not making changes worth it. At least put effort in making everything look the same instead of changing what you see on just one thing and leave the other untouched. Then the bugs and how bad the lag has been makes the game very hard to play. Was a decent game until 10cent showed their true colors.

I play this game on pc, and so far I really like it. I only started recently, but the story is compelling, the art is stunning, the animation is beautiful, and the gacha isn't too cruel. The way costumes work is my main complaint. We shouldn't have to pay $20 for a single costume for one character. Make a pack that gives other resources or something along with the skin for that price, or let us buy them with the in game currency. Overall a fun and interesting game!

This game isn't bad, its just not good either. At first I really enjoyed the story, as other comments mention if you get into it, some moments are real tear jerkers. The problem is the agressive montization for me. Sure I understand its a business for games, but almost every aspect in the game is slightly tweeked to create a problem for you as a player. I cannot recommend people come to the game as new players since with these current artifical road blocks, you will hit a wall and the fun fades

Fun game, great visuals, story, and voice over. But I've only been playing the game one day and I can't get past chapter 2. Either I'm really dumb, have to spend a lot of money to level and get better characters, or the game is just that difficult. Either way, I'm stuck and I'm not willing to spend money to level. Maybe I'll try more squad combinations but I've already tried a few and can't get past.

Very good game. I love the fact that I waited 20+ minutes to download additional assets to enter the game just to see "Disconnected from server. Please try again later" no matter what I do. Can't even play the sucking tutorial stage. Rather save the storage space for something not as poorly optimised like "Azur Lane".

Pretty fun game, I really enjoy the story and of course the beautiful women, HOWEVER this game is getting a 1 star from me until they fix the constant crashing that's happening on S24U phones. $1500 flagship device that is the pinnacle of mobile phones but Nikke can't run on it? Absolutely unacceptable, for 3 months now I've been having this problem and I'm sick of it. Shift UP, fix your game immediately.

it's no Destiny Child, but the closest gotcha game with amazing art and waifus. super high quality production. gets a bit repetitive and the grind is real as F2P, but I've had some lucky pulls, enough to keep me playing. hope to move away from the guns and get more creative characters. honestly could leave all the guns. girls are what Im here for. #waifu4lifu

Although gameplay is fun and the story is great, the gacha aspect of the game ruins it for me; after saving 3,000 gems (which mind you, they are really really really slow to get) and then doing a 10x and getting 7 blues and 3 repeated purples feels like a joke. But don't worry, there are always real money bundles if you wish to try your luck again. I'm not going to waste anymore of my time with this soft-porn coomer-trap excuse of a game.

Wanted to like this game, but it ended up a bug riddled mess with horrific monetization. Then I saw news they are changing upcoming character models and did some research I should have done earlier. Finding that Tencent owns Level Infinite made it all click. Don't expect to progress in a timely manner without dropping a lot of cash. Worse, with Tencent being involved I have no hope for things to get better any time soon as they will hamstring Shift Up's best efforts to fix the problems.

Drop rate is bad, there is a 1 to 3 ratio of purples to SSRs and I've never had that in a gotcha. The art is very good the story is actually interesting to the point I want to upgrade my squad to go further in it and best of all there isn't a stamina type cut off like other games it more tied to the power of you waifus so I consider that a somewhat good thing. All in all a fun game you can play on handed while you watch a show/moive.

The game story and characters are great. The PC version has far better performance than Android. Being a gacha game there are gambling elements to this, and with statements from the developers they are implementing changes that are only going to improve the Chinese version of the game while remaining more predatory for the global version.

Great game and amazing art work! I have one complaint being the gold Mold Crystal's should automatically give you an ssr Nikki.. I spent days on trying to get the full pilgrim mold and didn't even get one. and the only way to get them is through the tower... which you can't reset progress on... so I only feel like I've been cheated out of a pilgrim now 😕

Love the unique gameplay, character artstyle, music and event. But just received a update for day 1 stellar blade supporter like myself, that we won't get the free collab skin in nikke even tho we spend the same amount of money buying base game and then buying dlc, which is equal/same as complete edition. Such BS decision. Stellar blade can't even focus on the main issue of what the day 1 supporters wants. Not free content, just the option to upgrade to complete edition for the free skin.

Fun, extremely so. I enjoy that I can play this at work as long as I make sure they only see the pretty colors of explosions and never the talking scenes with all dem physics. A masterpiece of modern times as long as I don't let the character art be seen by puzblic eyes. So much fun. So engaging. High recommend if you like interesting dark stories, decently entertaining action, fun characters to interact with, and character designs that raise an eyebrow.

Edit: They reran the Nier collab event which was great. After playing the game for awhile now, I still enjoy it. I like the stories and the world building. Events are typically 2 or 3 weeks, which is faster than I've seen in other games. My only criticism of the game would be their skin prices. They bundle skins as part of passes for $20 or have special skin Gacha for up to $60. I never liked the idea of bundling resources with skins just to inflate prices. Skins in other games are better value

This game is awesome and wonderful but there still some bug inside this game especially when i tried play story mode rapi character. It always go back to the chapter 2 even though i had already finish and also the reward it self gone in chapter 3 even though i play for the first time at chapter 3. I hope you guys can fix it this bug.

Forget Genshin or any other gacha game. This is the best one I've played so far, awesome UI design, captivating story, great characters. The progress is slow, though, it's not necessary to put multiple hours a day to see improvement. Is say it's a pretty original game idea overall.

Terrible update system. The reason why is because the game keeps updating in the highest resolution settings. Playing from highest resolution to lowest doesn't make a huge difference except heat up the device and consume more battery. Even worse the characters still turn "black" every time they shoot. Having to log in every time I updated is also annoying.

The game is fun, i usually don't like these team building gatcha games but this one keeps me hooked, the story has some comedic points that I find really charming. There are some performance issues with loading times and sometimes the menus load incorrectly forcing me to close the game but besides that it is a solid experience.

Really great game! I love the characters. they're all so gorgeous and great tbh, it's so detailed, and the bosses are terrifying as well. Though there's some problems that I wish to get removed, the physics makes me uncomfortable, although I don't really mind since it's pretty reasonable why they move like that since their holding a gun most of the time. I actually don't like the fact that you can't pick what gender you are. It sucks that it has to be a man but overall good game!😭

It's much better than most mobile games. the models are top notch, the mechanics need polish but work. But the writing is excellent. Mature, thoughtful, and capable of stirring emotions. Please keep doing this type of stories. If you can improve the odds for drawing SSR characters that would make this close to perfection

Very good game. The story and music is perfect and the simple gameplay somehow works pretty well too but this cashshop prices man......I dont know if its the same ammount on every currency or not but i cant spend 30% of my monthly salary on one pack that actually help me to progress a few story mission before i get stuck again due to the insane ammount of resource you need when you reach midgame and the later parts. I would gladly spend money on this game time to time but this is too much.

Edited my review from 4 stars to 5. I've been a day 2 player and log on daily. So much has improved from launch. As a avid DC player before it's EOS, Shift up has almost always taken customer consideration when making their decisions. I just wish that one day we will be able to sell unwanted gear though and the cooperative operation won't bug out frequently. Everything else is amazing!

Pretty graphics, quite high SSR rate, no stamina system. However, the game is Censored for the sake of keeping it for age 12 and up. Also, after you play it for 3 months, you'll need 5 SSRs to have 3 duplicate copies. So it's 20 SSRs of the same characters, or else you won't be able to make some progress.

Bugged, game. Crashes since newest update. Uninstalled reinstalled, cleared app data, issues ongoing. No update from developer about this problem. Suppose it's easier to pretend it's not happening. Worked perfectly for months before most recent update but now it's unplayable. Requesting refund for content that I can lo longer access.

As a long time destiny child player I've waited on this game for a long time and i am not disappointed. I am enjoying every aspect of the game right now and having a blast as i did in the CBTs. Rerolling wasnt easy but i kept faith and got a good team. GJ ShiftUp you made an amazing game. I cannot wait to see what the future holds for this one!

Gameplay is actually amazing, however no real pity system, bad (arguably rigged) pull rates on molds, and the 1% increase fiasco means I cannot in good conscience recommend this game. All that needs to happen is change the molds back to 100% like they used to be and add some way to guarantee a specific character after a certain number of pulls.

I rarely review games but the bug occurred almost every damn time so i have to say it. After i finished a campaign mission a notification pop up that said 'failed to update information' and force me into the login screen. I have to restart the whole mission again after that. Idk why this happened. Pls fix the problem. Other than that its a good game. Sexy waifu, good storyline, and why did u let marian die😔😔 (pocof3)

Decided to give it another chance since devs offered a SSR selector. After a month of playing I didn't like what I see. Hype seems to be artificially created. A voiced story, but that's it. Animation looks cheap. No customization. Gameplay is awful. No sexy outfits. Battles are barely playable on mobile due to it being an shooter. Dailies take too much time and give nonexistent rewards, so I skip most of them. Worst is gacha: rates are too low while income is small. Edit: still as bad.....

If your device is powerful enough to run 60fps game is fun. Free to play is viable enough. Graphics are very nice, not just the character sprites but also the environments are very well designed and rendered nicely. Prices for passes and extras are kind of out there though, who pays €24 for an alternate costume?

This game is really fun and addictive. I enjoy the game play and the amount of content. I have a few issues though. The micro transactions in the game is too expensive and very predatory. It practically makes you want to spend money for the opportunity to get your favorite characters. There is also a massive issue with people rerolling. I believe that either we should be given a free character of our choice, or make it easier to recruit without having to spend money. Thank you for your time.

I stepped away for a few months, and after a massive update, all of my progress was erased! What the heck? That was a lot of time and effort completely lost to be set all the way back to level 1! After contacting Customer support, I was able to figure out this issue. If you use Facebook to login, it may mark the app's credentials as "expire." If this happens, you'll need to renew them in Facebook before logging back in.

Awesome music (I need the soundtrack to be published separately), great graphics and voice work, good gameplay and generous drop rates. The story is rather cliché but servisable. However, there are some technical bugs that really impact the experience of the game. Starting with slower loading screens the more one plays the game and ending with inability to download the updates for the patches and having to completely reinstall the game. Overall, after some bug fixes it will be a great game.

Everytime when it tries to update the game keeps telling me there was an error. I have enough space on my phone because I just bought this phone. I've tried picking different server's to use but that wasn't the problem because it keeps telling me there was an error. I need 125MB to download but when it gets to 35 it stops and tells me there was an error. I'm gonna rate this a 1 star because I haven't gotten a chance to play. I understand this game just came out and I'm looking forward to play.

Downloaded this game out of boredum a almost a year and a half back. All i have to say is wow, this game is amazing, between the story and events, this is one of the only anime style games i keep coming back to play. Only downside is most costumes are at least $20 bucks, or $60 if its a gacha skin, but other then that, this game is amazing

fun so far, around 14-15 hours in. free to play so far, but I wish all of these phone games with amazing stories and immersive worlds with rich diverse characters could have a standard price. I would gladly pay $70 for this and have the full game, no pay wall, no virtually necessary micro transactions. I always love to have micro transactions help me let the developers know I approve of the way the events are and are being handled, and for all of that day to day hardwork they put in instead.

Updates always almost kill any desire to play. There is an interesting intro movie that plays every update. It stops being interesting the 20+ time it's looped, every 2 gigabyte patch, without an ability to skip or stop it. It can be muted, but the only plus side to the looping is that it tells you it hasn't crashed or stopped patching yet... It's not that I can't download the updates, but that listening to the same 2 minute song for an hour is so irritating. Crashes make it mandatory to hear

Turns out there is so much more to Nikke then the recruitable character ads that you see being memed. Others I'm sure summed it up better then I will. It's a RPG Shooter that really dives into the RPG side more. I think it goes the extra in the little things that make it feel a bit more alive. It's worth a check and not a write off, especially with the surprisingly banger OST. Be warned, the story/event writing will kick hard you in the gut, repeatedly. It can get pretty depressing.

Update 01/24/23: While I still enjoy the game, I can no longer recommend it to new players. There are bugs that boggle down the experience by quite a lot. I had to switch to iOS for better performance, which is not acceptable. I got the infinite loading screen in SP Arena and lost 2 attempts today. More info for bugs on prydwen.gg/nikke

3 years after my original review, Shift Up has basically fixed all of original gripes. NIKKE in my opinion is what every gacha should aspire to be. You can be lured in by the sexy girls but the game is so much more than that. Incredible story. The best soundtrack of any mobile game. Extremely accessible gameplay that never feels pay to win. Well written characters. And an amazing community. You almost forget it's a game. 10/10. No changes needed.

Time to update this. The story is decent at the start but gets better as the story progresses. The gameplay, yeah, simple. Can play with one hand. 😏 Generous game tho, sometimes luck wasn't on your side so yeah, 200 mileage tix. Overall, 4 stars. But I'll make it 5 stars since they're really generous with the freebies and rewards.

This game has become pay to win. Lack of currency for summons. A shame to have been waiting 3 years for this. Destiny child does it much better and are from the same developer. Also on the exclusive summon trials are supposed to drop the exclusive new one but it does not happen. I have thrown more than 10 times already were the gold ones drop and it is not the exclusive ones

I'm just downloading the game data and it keeps going down, once it was 130 and then suddenly dropped to 50. This is a waste of time and data. Please fix this. The download data always drops and system error keeps coming. I can't even play the game. I wasted hours just for the game to download it's data and failed.

So this is actually an AFK game. The only difference is that this is more action oriented when you are playing. It's not all just tapping away and doing things, you are actively playing when you have to play. It does a nice job balancing the AFK aspect and the hands on playing. Also waifu's are full of character and you will like some of the girls. The jiggle physics is a nice touch and added bonus.

The first resources download is not doing anything, there isn't even a downloading speed indicator. Been waiting for almost half an hour and it's stuck at 15 mb, and don't think I can download it in the background. And why do I need to watch the video while downloading?? The music is loud and I can't mute it except I'm muting my phone and the audio is still playing while downloading it in window mode while I'm doing something else

Gameplay is fun and the dialogue, character, and story is pretty engaging and interesting. What's holding it back is lack of event diversity and seems the devs might be getting lazy, only time will tell. Edit: 5 stars now, the game is great and events are very interesting and fun nowadays. Highly recommended for the story it's very captivating and you can get lost in lore theorizing.

Random characters make it less interesting to make squads. The combat is more about doing enough damage before you are defeated, rather than any strategy or skill. Bits of story to encounter all over, but nothing special. No major pay wall and no major problems with ads. It is an okay game for people to try, but don't expect it to surprise you. Several of the "nikke" look too young.

simple gameplay with a decent mechanics. Gorgeous visuals and pretty interesting story too. The only downside is game can freeze and crash sometimes. After winter update i cant get into the game. There's a required 0.06 mb file to download but when i click it, the game is freeze and when i relaunch the game the required files increase again and again and again. The rewards for progressing after chapter 13 is a joke. 10 free gems for completing a quest or stage. Feels like the dev spit in ur face

Game is pretty good, however after the latest update it won't even load completely. Progress bar stops and either says system error, or prompts me to download the additional data which also freezes. Tried emptying cache and even reinstalled the game. No change. Cell is perfectly fine. Can't play or contact support in game.

I was so excited back when this game first released. After playing for around 2 months(?) I realized it's just for lack of better word, A fanservice cashgrab. Buggy, too many dupes needed to pass the lv. 160 gate, very expensive real cash shop prices in general, and many flaws that I think as far as I can see won't ever go away.. I LOVE the characters and I appreciate the story but yhe points I've pointed above just let me down too much that I can't force myself to play anymore sadly.

Enjoying it but lots of bugs! Like on the tribe tower (can't access the elysion tower, it just reloads for like 3 times after starting then I get dragged to the main menu) , some battles won't get recorded and it errors so you have to fight it again. Tickets sometimes won't appear to be gifted even though you've acquired it.

One of the best gachas Ive played, top tier story, very well designed characters with good personalities, fun gameplay and amazing music. The summoning rates are not bad and the pity system very nice. The game can be a bit grindy and sometimes hard to progress in but, the rewards are generous and with patience you will do well even as a f2p. The devs listen and are constantly improving their game. Im a day 1 player who plays consistently, seeing the progress made from back then to now is great.

Lets get the negatives out the way first: WHY ISNT EVERYTHING FR.EE? lol I know why but damn I just want to watch what I get from endless recruits. Now the positives: The graphics are amazing, the game plays like arcade where u scan areas and defeat enemies but with much more "pleasant" characters. the game contains a huge story line and is just super fun overall. I love Rapi, send me a waifu pillow of her plz

A fairly fun 3rd Person shooter. The art is great, and the controls are pretty solid despite just launching.There are some controll settings that help better suit your needs, which is pretty great since I'm bad. Two major downsides are the fairly high demand for specific characters for different fights (scrounging for my best team is strenuous) and the constant crashes (I can barely play for more than 10 min before it crashes). I'm hoping the future updates will at least address the crashes.

I have playing this since first release,but it was getting worse over time than i was expected. the cheaters and bugs are getting worse,also the server are very unstable. although this game have exciting soundtrack and gameplay,but one thing i hate about this game is the battlepass system and never fixed bugs. so yeah I don't play this anymore.

It don't have data stability with low internet connection. The moment your update interrupted either the update won't go up or go up but going down again, or even you lost most of data more than 1 gig bruh. WTH!!! It's almost 1 year and still not fixing it. I'm tired of anxiety in every update, wether is it working or gonna be interrupted and lost precious data. I can even get to 'Touch to Start' screen thing to report man!!

no bug fixes. just extra content which made game even more awful. game freezes when trying to access the event and had to restart again. annoying keeps lagging esp the mini game during burst. i think i'm done with this game and i'm uninstalling this and might never consider playing again. the tower molds and SSR molds are so bad almost a scam. it's been frustrating one issue after another and the devs don't even pay attention to listen and address problems players are facing. game is a failure.

fun gameplay, good graphics..... good uh "assets", good story, nice list of voice actresses that are very well known, but some stages I feel are bit repetitive and boring and some harder stages feel straight up impossible if you mess up just once but this is a good thing and the gacha rates I feel like is pretty generous but my one biggest gripe is the way you level up characters I just don't like that part but overall a great eay to get through breaks at work and just to pass time

Love the art style and game play, but rating the game 4 stars as there are some annoying bugs that still persist. The first one is voice choice changing whenever exiting the setting menu, even if I didn't open the audio tab. Second one is the game fully freezing and/or crashing at certain points.

The devs keep making this game unplayable...I had to wait AN ENTIRE YEAR after launch before the game would let me download it. Got to play for a few months just fine. And now once again it refuses to download the new update and gets stuck within the first 25 out of 3138. It does it on my phone, on my PC, on an emulator, everything. I was really looking forward to the Nier collab. Thanks for making me miss out on it...

Such a unique experience, I can't think of any other mobile games that play like this. It's definitely not for everybody but I would recommend everyone to at least try it out. For me, I'm really enjoying the experience. Kind of reminds of playing Time Crisis in the arcade, but with wifus. The quality of the art and Live2d are excellent and I'm also thoroughly enjoying the storyline and characters so far.

I've played off and on since the game officially dropped. The Nikkes are pretty, the gameplay is fun, and the story is well-written. There's usually some event going on with a few collabs that have happened--such as Chainsaw Man, RE: Life in Another World, and Nier: Automata. Occasionally, there'll be co-op raids, guild raids, and solo raids. They've also added a survivor io minigame that has zero micro transactions if you just wanna kill time there. I can't put it down.

I love everything about this game so far, except for one big nit-pick. There are parts of the main story where the creators seemed confused as to what they wanted the voice actors to actually say. Ingrid has called me "Protagonist" several times, as well as flat out not said the word "Counters" in Counters Squad. There's a lot of scattered mistranslations or incorrect subtitles to cutscenes. Sometimes Nikkes refer to the very obvious male commander as they/them

Game is awesome, love the characters and story so far, for some reason tho when I try to do a characters personal/advise quests I get to the end of it and I get a "character error" message so it won't let me continue to the next episode, tried uninstalling and reinstalling, resetting the characters level but nothing works.

UPDATE: It's 2024, and I had 3 app crashes during a boss raid. Good story. But a bunch of crashes.. also every fight is a DPS check. After the update.. loading screens now stutters. Manual aim is next to not doable due to lag spikes, even on the lowest graphical settings. There's not even a pity system. Pulled from event banner got 3 SSRs but not the featured one.

Much improved since launch. Good: Amazing graphics, awesome English dub. Top notch story. Great units. Cons: lots of loading screens and long loading times. Makes dailies tedious. Overall: nikke has been the most successful game since it came out and should be put on the pedestal as what a mobile game should be. However, the loading times lost me awhile back

The game, story, and events are great all in all, but there are mistakes that they made in the campaign mode (currently in Chapter 9) where the character says "Bye" but the voiceline says "Hello". There are many other examples but I just had enough, I do love that that is my only issue with this game rn lol

Great good. Love the game play. Animated girl with big guns win&win. You don't have use real life money to have fun. I 100% love they put "cash shop" tab in the game, no hiding just telling you click it you will spend real life money Instead of pretending to be in game currency but you have spend money on. Some bugs but nothing game breaking. Long way to go will see how future update takes

Excellent graphic, great gameplay, does not make me boring to play... 5/5 but there slightly a problem with the game. The game disconnect me and says "not sync" everytime i finish the stage. Please fix this problem immediately. I fall in love with this game please don't make players down

From the 10 hours I played this game, I enjoyed from the game mechanic system and the story, but there were fatal flaws in the game system such as loading screens that took too long and there were several errors such as freezes after the game stage was over. I hope the developer can resolve this problem, or the developer can include this game as still a beta access or early access game. Thanks 😊

After the recent update, I am not able to download the required files when updating. I always get stuck at 20-50MB, it has always been smooth for me and has nothing to do with internet connexion since other games and updates are working very well. It's been 2 days and the issue has been the same...

I love the use of Live2D for full body models. It makes the game stand out. The intro story made me tear up, and the character writing/VA is pretty good! This game definitely is about hot babes shooting guns, but I'm glad theres more to it in the story and world building. Music is great, esp the vocal stuff. The presentation is just so clean! loading is kinda slow, and I can't switch to another app and come back smoothly. Otherwise still 5 stars.

Lots of unfixed bug like error when playing story event, system error when finishing mission. And the powerspike in the event just way too much even for player who play early when the game released with decent nikke/equipment. It's not possible for F2P/light spender player to finish the event in just a week with how things are right now. Other than that the gameplay is pretty good and the main story/side story writing is good too.

Great, but the problem is hitting the "hard limit" of the day; Meaning, there is physically NOTHING you can do until the next day. Sucks. Each of the Nikke's personalities, even non-main story ones are... adorable. Looking forward to changing the stars in the days to come. Edit: 4 stars as bugs from launch fixed, gameplay loop is, alright in mid-late game; Events and Dailies can take up good chunk of your time but wish more incentive to do Campaign after unlocking everything it offers.

I'll give it points for being original, but this gameplay really doesn't fit with mobile controls. Bullet hell on vertical is a nightmare to deal with, especially when it simultaneously requires you to hold a tap, move it around to aim, but also tap on icons to activate special moves. Also your fingers and hands just get in the way of the aim, and the reticle is never where you want it to be and gets lost in the backgrounds and graphics.

feel there could be a better balance of Nikke models. As it stands, it's like a 3-2-1 ratio. 1 is the "standard" models, followed by about twice as many 2 "rare" models, then by three times as many 3 "super rare" models. it makes it very obvious your wanting people to pay for the SR models, but so many and of course such low odds of getting a particular one makes it a money sink. other than that, the models are exceptionally made, great VAs, the story and world has me curious to reach the end.

I originally gave this game a 5-star despite the issues faced. Still freezing at harmony cube area but at least I can circumvent it. However, I can't circumvent the constant issue after downloading the game and exiting out of the app. As of right now, after extensive searching, I have found no solution to this. The issue is the message "You have not downloaded the required file (0.06MB). Proceed to download?" Every time this happens it crashes. Only fix is to uninstall and reinstall. Plz fix

ONE thing to note is the gacha's lack of pity, which is unfortunate as you need a lot of dupes to build your units for harder content. The game obviously depends on money, so a lot of progression is made easier if you're willing to drop $$$. Those things aside, this game offers everything else to gacha veterans such as myself. Excellent world-building paired with wonderful voice acting, and ZAMN those some models activate my neurons. Spend wisely!

The 'plot' and 'assets' are a lot more distracting than I expected. The game itself is good. The gacha not so much. Have recruited 400 times, for the last 200 or so I may have gotten 1 SSR. Initially was excited for 4% rate but the rate definitely does not feel any better than any other gacha w 2% and much cheaper draws. Conclusion: Good game, pitiful gacha rates. Pity system is around 600 USD to hit and likelihood of any in between in low at best.

Everything was great until Stellar Blade ported to PC offering a new "complete edition," and giving players a free Nikke skin with that purchase. The problem is the many dedicated fans who supported SB on PS5 since the beginning are NOT getting the scarlet skin for free (or at a reasonable price), and have to buy the whole other version of the game. Paying another $80 just for my scarlet skin is sooo stupid and anti consumer. You've lost a loyal supporter Shift Up.

1) The game not allowed me to accept friend request anymore even though I only have 25/30 in my friend list. 2)Some cutscenes from event story are blurry on mobile version. When I tried on PC version, the cutscenes are okay. 3)Please allow us to [advise] characters from the collaboration, it's boring to increase bond through gift only. 4) Add voice/dialog logs for all characters please (R,SR and SSR)

Good and entertaining game, but the the paid aspects of the game (mostly battle passes) cost way too much for what you get (skins for characters you might not have yet). In Canadian dollars they are almost 30$, which is like 20-25$ USD. a battle pass should be around 10$, even less so for a mobile game

The gameplay gets repetitive very quickly, upgrading is clunky and time consuming. Also, how many Fing "Simulation or Challenge rooms" do you need good lord!? Don't get me started on your base, sooo many buildings! WHY!!?? There's just so much fat on this game that sucks up time just for the sake of using up your time.

Game is fun. But it requires lots of patience. Upgrading nikkes is expensive and getting the materials means waiting for the idle aspect of the game to give you enough of them. Ran into A bug where the game doesn't properly register the personal stories with nikkes. I end up having to rewatch stories, get an error message, and repeating the process until I get to the current chapter. It happens every time I load up the game. Hope it gets fixed eventually.

Generally fun combat, but makes up for it by having relentlessly horny character designs, an incredibly aggravating storyline where I'm genuinely rooting for the faceless enemy horde to win, and topping it all off by somehow being sufficiently unstable as to give me 5 crashes in 20 minutes, with each one requiring a full reload including server selection. I'll forgive a lot, but this is too much.

Be prepared to wait for days to make a few minutes of progress. Pure fan service game with terrible game balance. In battle theres only 3 animations 1 Shooting 2 Idle/Not shooting 3 Reloading. Not even an animation for being stunned. The gacha rates are complete Garbage and laughable. There is a paid gems only gacha as well that is purely evil and predatory. They want to attract players off pure lust ignore this game. also had a bug with advise that never let it progress further and would crash

So far the last 3 coop events disconnect after every attempt. I have missed out on all 3 and just feel like giving up. I like the story and gameplay, but when you're always behind because you can't participate in a game mode, I just think of how I'm falling behind.

very good graphics and gameplay. however...the game is a big mess with extremely bad connections and syncing errors. my game gets frozen everytime I opened the harmony cube area which causes another disconnection. damn...it's so frustrating even after the maintenance. no improvement. u guys are obviously not ready for official release. not worth paying to play.

I absolutely love this game. The art style is beautiful to look at, the combat is immersive, and the characters are just so very charming. But the shining star must be the story of the game. The story is compelling and keeps you hooked. This is a perfect example of a post-apocolyptic story with themes of struggle, hope, loss, love, and in parts some horror elements. There are some issues with grammar and spelling, even some text not matching with the voice dialogue. But, overall, a great game.

This game is surprisingly good for appearing to be a simple heavy fan-service gacha: good story, music, art, and unique gameplay. I would rate a 5, but the constant crashing, especially when loading up character profiles, prevent me from doing so. Edit: Does not seem to be happening as recent, I will update the score for now.

The gameplay is pretty fun and the characters and writing are great but there's a ton of bugs that bog down the experience. Most annoying ones are the game not tracking the progress of bond episodes and changing any of the settings causes the game to change your language and forces you to redownload voices. The current event is also poorly designed giving you only a 10% chance to get event points if you don't have any of the featured units.

Concept is nice with great voice acting, execution is okay, the programmers must have been paid, lots of bug fixes. Still, the issues still lay in 50/50 for a reward that is limited. They "listened" to the complaints by changing the rate of the version that is attainable by other means from 60 to 61% and 20 to 21%.

Best free-to-play friendly gacha game balancing fair pull rates, highest quality models, good story, fun and satisfying gameplay, TONS of game modes and opportunities to earn free stuff, AND the waifus actually have interesting and fun personalities. Other gachas might have some of these qualities, but only Nikke ranks so highly across the board. If you've been wanting to try a gacha but weren't sure which one to pick, finish chapter 1 of Nikke and you'll see why it's the best.

One of the dumbest thing this game has aside it's expensive in-game purchase is that they reduce rewards alot the more you progress through the chapters. Which is the OPPOSITE to what other game does. Some of their content design and how they reward players really don't make sense. The bugs are the least of the problem

Still early days but so far very positive. Rates are fair, story is interested, combat are fun and there's a large selection of girls for all tastes. I'm having fun, my only minor complaint is that the extra paid content is quite expensive. There are all the usual weekly/monthly crates but all the extra content like the campaign pass and season pass don't yet feel worth the investment.

This is the most fun I've had in a mobile game. The story is amazing. The gameplay is perfect. I love everything about this exceptional piece of artwork. One huge thing that no one mentions in reviews is how there are no ads <3 my favorite part <3 now lemme pull red hood and you'll keep getting my money 😘

Love this mobile game so much. So far my pulls for characters have been really good, out of all of the events (had to miss two due to no internet) I've pulled the new characters in 10 pulls or less. The story is also very interesting (I usually skip the dialogue in most mobile games due to interest in character design and/or artists involved) I did struggle to level up characters with the available methods but aside from that, I love it. I draw fanart for all the waifus <3

I sadly have to lower my rating. After a year of playing with no issues. Recently when I try and log in the game gets to anywhere between 57% and 69% and freezes. Then when I touch my screen it crashes to the home screen. Once this is resolved I will return my rating to a 5 star

Quite an enjoyable game. Only takes 20 minutes a day to do all the dailys usually, and the new minigames they have been adding to the game have all been enjoyable and allow you to play as much or as little as you want. Highly recommend as the character designs are also amazing. Even the story can be a rollercoaster of emotions which is not what you expect from this booty shooter haha.

Really great game. The voice actresses and actors do a great job. The fanservice is kind of comedic at times, but it's rarely enough to distract from the gameplay. I think the art and animation is also splendid. No, seriously. As an artist myself, I promise you that this sh** is, like, IDEAL for when it comes to animation and art. Gameplay is fun. Dialogue is kind of edgy, right up my alley. BUT, It bothers me that less rare characters show less skin then rarer ones.. what message is that? 🤨

Absolutely love the game, but I've had a few issues with it recently after the new half year update. If I click on a character it will freeze on the character outline and I can't do anything anymore unless I completely restart the game, it's made it very difficult to upgrade or change characters

I'm sorry but there's some bug on my application, on the NIKKE character story, is always reset every day when I logged in. Even thou I already read the character story, is always reset every day. When I played the character story again, there's some error malfunction and then it will return to main screen. I don't know if it's only me or not, but please I need some help for this. But overall it's a good game

This game feels like it was made by people who had a meeting just to decide how to make a game that is not fun boss fights are way to shacky and have to many phases and are unfair. The user interface is God awful you need to go back to the lobby just to level up characters which you need to do constantly because if you are even 50 power bellow recommended they spawn 3 times the enemies and it feels like you are doing no damage. Finally the story is terrible your side is cartoonishly evil.

great game with gorgeous artwork. There are some bug issues that need to be addressed as of writing this but they don't really detract from the overall experience. I do feel like the game will become a grind fest for leveling unless you either take it real slow and build up resources or pay real money for resources, but that is the nature of f2p games in today's market. But the game is fairly new on the market so it's possible for the dev team to make changes.

Lots of potential, got some interesting ideas and battle mechanics. However not playable for F2P, very early one you would find you get stuck with nothing yo do and just waiting on your base yo collect you next round of experience. All the upgrades need material that only comes from using the crystals. Very disappointing

Latest version is still absolutely superb. Although after the update the game suddenly takes time to load the next page now. Getting a bit boring with all the waiting. But still nice graphics and excellent gameplay.and up until now it takes too much time to get to game modes or even just getting rewards only. Please fix this devs.i know your promoting pc version but not all has time to stay on a pc just to play game.you cant carry your pc anywhere unlike the phone.

Enjoyable at the start but once you start going deeper into the game, the more it demends of you. Resources becomes harder to acquire and the diffculty sudden spikes. Such as same as the story, characters and world build is surprisingly very good. Just a bad move on the developer end

Really good story, graphics are good for a mobile game, lots of stuff to do so the UI is a bit cluttered. They even have a feature to reduce RNG when doing recruiting, so that's nice. It also turns my phone into a furnace and loads very slowly on older devices, like my S5E tablet.

The game itself has unique design which combine shooting game with idle game. However, the infrastructure of the game is beyond poorly design. Even the most repetitive command such as viewing your character, or returning from viewing character require a loading screen. It is easier to be interrupted by loading screen than not at every click in the game. Designing as an idle game, Nikke does very poor job on idling part. Even the most repetible task such as daily took time and required attention

the gameplay is fun. power rates are a bit unecessarily high for early content, but if you're a fan of old time crisis gunplay with some great special abilities, play this. the story is good, too. this may be gatcha, but it isnt a lazy card game. I keep having to replay previous encounters with the nikkes. The extra missions require atleast 3-4k more power than is required (nikke levelups) due to autohealing units. Defence missions sorta suck.

One year later it still has so many problems that it still hasn't fixed such as being perpetually stuck on the opening downloading screen (even if I reset my whole computer it still says that its downloading), in game the loading screens being stuck at 90%, and the game just strait up crashing so frequently. Its a really fun game, but all these problems really sour the experience.

Excellent style and animation. Surprisingly endearing writing, and fairly refreshing combat. There's no Stamina system so you're only really slowed down by your party's power level. The big issue right now is that the game is plagued by a slew of bugs in both its UI and gameplay. If they don't get control of things soon, any promise this game has is going out the window.

One of the very few games that is F2P friendly and also very fun! Developers listens to the fan. Numerous events biweekly and the also generous on giving out free pulls and gems needed to pull. Also the pity system in this game is great! You're pity stays with you where you can save it and spend it on a future unit unlike many other games that doesn't allow that. You can see why this game is #1 on the playstore.

So far I love the game. Been on it almost everyday since April last year. Played a year prior when it came out but wasn't nearly as active as I currently am now. I know there is VA drama currently but that is completely irrelevant to the gameplay. As the game stands, I will continue to support it with whatever direction we go from here. There's still alot I want to complete before I ever put this game down. My 5 out of 5 still stands as is and have no plans lowering it anytime soon.

Fun side game to play if you don't have much time to play. It is pretty much an idle game as you sit and wait for resource to pile up to upgrade units. Great art, story, gameplay. Simulation room is a chore and some new bugs get introduce every patch but they fix it asap.

Gameplay is great. Story is great. Music is great. Art is great. Gacha is great. Everything except the launch is great, because Jesus is it buggy. From disconnection issues, to problem claiming reward after reading a character's bond story, even a game breaking bug where the game would freeze mid-boss battle forcing you to restart and redo the entire thing again. It's a good game, truly. Just not a particularly good experience right now. Hell, I can't even login anymore.

Despite the game being heavily marketed as "coomer bait" the gameplay is surprisingly enjoyable/complex, and the story is very well written (everything is voiced, too!) My main gripe with the game is just how many bugs there are. Every time new content releases the, characters don't always work properly, which makes it very difficult to determine if a character is worth pulling for since they may not be functioning properly at time of launch

Has great graphics and game play overall but the music during loading screens is choppy and really wished there is a way to refund resources spent on a character. The reason for why is mostly because at the beginning I was investing on my starters but pulled a Centi later and wished to focus on her instead of relying on sync to boost her levels/skills, while resources are incredibly scare especially in the early-mid game.

I don't understand how most of my time on the app are spent on loading screens and crashed battle encounters where I don't even get to play just look at some blank screen that hasn't loaded properly. Hence why I'm giving it a 2 star because Games should be easy to use not wasting your time loading and crashing.

Uses an energy system so in my opinion not worth your time. The combat itself is accessible while still have depth, but that doesn't make up for it's rather unfun gameplay. Especially since this is a gacha game that relies on your wallet and luck to make significant progress. All in all I don't think it's worth your time.

The game is great. If I'm being honest, I got the game ever since the nier automata event. I'm a huge fan of the game so when I heard 2B and A2 were being added I got the game. Again, the game is great, but I didn't get to limit break 2B or A2 completely. I do hope they reintroduce the event again or at least give me the opportunity to limit break them Nier character since I have them.

Ignoring the sexy anime girls (which is admittedly very important to the game), the gameplay is honestly very solid for a mobile game, but the monetary aspect is too harsh. The most expensive packs barely get you any pulls, let alone good ones. I hope something is done about it, for it doesn't seem like a good investment at the moment to spend on the game.

Good game. I haven't experienced the bugs others mentioned, but that just makes me one of the lucky few. -1star for greed. IAP are way too expensive and it feels a lucky pull is the only way to progress. -1star for poor f2p support there aren't many free draws after a chapter/arc like other gachas. SSR pull rates are super low and more expensive than most gacha. Rewards are low, less draws, less good units + high difficulty curve equals stuck content. Great art and fun characters. Barely 3 star

I got this game cause my boyfriend and some of our good mates have it. While a lot of the designs for the women are clearly oriented for the men, I rather enjoy the game play and storyline thus far. If there's issues, the company tends to get onto fixes when they can and compensate players for inconvenience which I greatly appreciate. I would recommend.

New review, the game's performance is overall better than what it used to be and frequent updates and small fixes are appreciated. My only issue now is whether or not the game could give an option to bring back old voicelines in the game. I play with English voicelines, and hearing Viper's new voice compared to the old one, I prefer the older one. I am midway through the story and hearing Viper's new voice ruined the overall experience for me, hopefully this is added in the future.

The game starts getting repetitive pretty soon and user input seems not adding much difference if the power level difference is less than 1000. Usually you spend more time finding the enemy or your crosshair, the loading time and the multiple pages does not improve the experience. 3 stars for the load of work on the story and graphics

Rewards on the later chapter are very lackluster that it does not reciprocate the effort that the player had done to finish that stage and the overpriced battle pass relative to its rewards. Like bruh, i rather buy genshit battle pass and i dont even play that game. Made it from 1 star to 3 stars and now from 3 stars to 4 as they addressed my other concerns and added various QoL improvements.

Gacha sucks. edit: after awhile of not playing and deciding to come back, I decided to embrace the game once again and it is so much more rewarding to play compared to the first month that I played the game but there are still some problems that I ran into which is leveling up in order to catch up to the campaign.

Has a great potential, but too many letdown. Bugs everywhere that takes too long to be fixed (if it will be), sudden crash in game and connection problems especially on multiplayer event, and some loading error. Also characters designs that got changed from what it should be on release before and after since the launching from CBT

I like the fact that characters can move, I feel that flat unmoving characters from other games will need to be upgraded to not be left behind. The game play is fun and fast, as it should be. Be ready for farming though, and level only a few characters at first.

Came for the booba stayed for the story. You never really know what this game is on the outside unless you truly try this game yourself. I've playing Nikke since the release, the prologue made me feel like i want more about the story than the fanservice itself. It's a masterpiece of a game I've ever played. Especially their music a lot of their music is amazing.

Found the game overall enjoyable and got really engaged with the story plus great music that keeps me vibing. Gameplay I find overall okay, the auto function makes going through story a breeze. Regarding grinding, I am grateful there is no stamina bar so I can keep playing. The main problem as a good number of comments has also been stated, the game crashing on S24 Ultra. Game quality is as low as possible with settings but still occurrs on my device, I tried clearing cache, but no luck.

It's laggy starting from the first day it launched but still playable. Esp after the winter update, it lags so much in my Poco and a while later my phone bricked. So I installed it in my Tab S6 Lite. Graphic, character, world building, story, gameplay, 10/10.
